'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_1o) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Droid]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=2X-3KPR（トゥエックス） |printed_game_text=「夜間状態」の場合、同じ場所の自分の反乱軍、エイリアンは、すべて戦闘力が＋２される。「水耕ステーション」のカードと同じ場所にあると、さらに耐：損耗＜３を得る。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-2x-3kpr-tooex-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''整備点検用の単純作業ドロイド。各所に配備された警戒センサーや非常灯、電磁フェンスなどを遠隔起動させる。レリモア・ドロイズ社製のサーバント・ドロイド。'' |translation='''Title:''' 2X-3KPR (Tooex). '''Card text:''' During night conditions, all your Rebels and aliens at the same location are power +2. At the same location as [[Hydroponics Station|Hydroponics Station]], it also gains immunity to attrition less than 3. '''Lore:''' A simple labor droid used for maintenance and inspection. It remotely activates warning sensors, emergency lights, electromagnetic fences, and similar equipment installed throughout an area. A servant droid manufactured by Lerrimore Droids. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

An ISB spy who secretly watches Imperial officers whose loyalty is in doubt. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. title: A Disturbance In The Force (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=A Disturbance In The Force |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-208o-Video.jpg |lead='''A Disturbance In The Force''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_208o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[A Disturbance In The Force]] (1_208o)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[A Disturbance In The Force (Unlimited)]] (51_208)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_208o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[A Disturbance In The Force (Errata)]] (1_208) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=フォースの騒動 |printed_game_text=配備フェイズに、このカードを裏にして相手のリザーブデッキに入れ、よく切ること。切り終わったら、相手はカードを見ないで1回カットする。このカードがリザーブデッキの一番上にきたら、カードをロストデッキへ送る。そのターン、相手はフォースをそれ以上起動できない（「意識操作」の影響を受けない）。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-208o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''惑星オルデランの破壊は、フォースの流れに大きな乱れを引き起こした。数百万の声が一瞬にして叫び、そして途絶えたのだ。'' |translation='''Title:''' A Disturbance In The Force. '''Card text:''' During your deploy phase, insert this card face down into the opponent's Reserve Deck and shuffle. The opponent then cuts without looking. When this card reaches the top, it goes to the Lost Pile. The opponent may not activate more Force that turn. Immune to Alter. '''Lore:''' The destruction of Alderaan caused a great disturbance in the Force. Millions of voices cried out at once and were suddenly silenced. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 意識操作 for Alter. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[A Disturbance In The Force]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[AT-AT Cannon (V)]] (222_3) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=AT－ATレーザー砲 |printed_game_text=２フォース消費してＡＴ－ＡＴに配備する。同じ位置か隣接位置で戦闘が起きた際に起動できる。隣接位置の目標に対してのみ起動でき、２フォース消費する。運命数を引く。ビークルには運命数＋２＞装甲値か回避値で命中する。宇宙戦闘機には運命数＞３で命中する。キャラクターには運命数＋１＞能力値で命中する。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-AT-AT-Cannon-PSA-150138981.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国軍のウォーカーの頭部には強大な火力を持った可動式のレーザー砲が搭載されている。汎用性が広く、どんな目標に対しても効果的である。'' |translation='''Title:''' AT-AT laser cannon. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on an AT-AT. May fire when a battle occurs at the same or an adjacent site. May fire only at a target at an adjacent site, using 2 Force. Draw destiny. A vehicle is hit if destiny +2 > armor or maneuver. A starfighter is hit if destiny > 3. A character is hit if destiny +1 > ability. '''Lore:''' A movable laser cannon with tremendous firepower is mounted on the head of an Imperial walker. It is versatile and effective against any target. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese fires only at a target at an adjacent site, using 2 Force. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[AT-AT Cannon]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Virtual Modern''' — [[Admiral Motti (V)]] (200_73) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Imperial]] [[Pilot]] [[Warrior]][[:File:Admiral-Motti-Japanese-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=モッティ提督 |printed_game_text=場に帝国軍の宇宙船が２隻以上出ていれば、配備コスト－２となる。モッティと同じ星系にいる反乱軍パイロットは、没収値－１となる。モッティが操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２になる。 |printed_lore=''デス・スターの指揮を任されている帝国宇宙軍司令官。科学技術を過信し、フォースを蔑視する。野心的な帝国軍のリーダー。皇帝の勅命を支持して昇進したが、軍事能力は評価されていない。ベイダーを嫌っている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Admiral Motti. '''Card text:''' If at least two Imperial starships are on the table, deploy cost is −2. Rebel pilots in the same system as Motti have forfeit −1. A starship Motti pilots has power +2. '''Lore:''' An Imperial Navy commander entrusted with command of the Death Star. He puts excessive faith in technology and despises the Force. An ambitious Imperial leader. He was promoted for supporting the Emperor's decree, but his military ability is not highly regarded. He dislikes Vader. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says Motti supported the Emperor's decree, while the English printed lore says he supported the New Order. The Japanese says his military ability is not highly regarded; the English says he was promoted because of his support rather than his military skills. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Admiral Motti]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. '''Virtual Modern''' - [[Admiral Ozzel (V)]] (213_1) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=オゼル提督 |printed_game_text=自分の大型艦は同じ星系に－1で配備できる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。場にベイダーが出ており、相手がオゼルと同じロケーションにリアクションで移動してきたなら、オゼル提督は即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Admiral-Ozzel-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''反乱軍を発見し壊滅させるために皇帝が編成したデス・スコードロンのリーダー。愚鈍で不器用。ダース・ベイダーに失策を露呈したばかりで、もはや失敗は許されない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Admiral Ozzel '''Card text:''' Your capital starships may deploy at -1 to the same system. Adds 2 to the power of the starship he pilots. If Vader is on the table and the opponent moves to Ozzel's location as a react, Admiral Ozzel is immediately lost. '''Lore:''' Leader of the Death Squadron formed by the Emperor to find and destroy the Rebels. Stupid and clumsy. Having just exposed his failure to Darth Vader, he can afford no further failures. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore expresses the English “next-to-last time” joke as allowing no further failures. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Admiral Ozzel]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Advance Preparation (V)]] (1210_144) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=準備万端 |printed_game_text=ユーズド：以下のいずれか1枚のカードを手札から出して、ゲームから除外する。「アタック・ラン」、「邪魔者は片づいたぞ」、「デス・スター：トレンチ」、「反乱軍技師」。代わりに1フォース再使用する。 ロスト：3フォースを使用して、「アタック・ラン」をロストデッキから再使用する。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Advance-Preparation-SWCA-67665.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''相手の動きを素早く察知し、綿密な作戦を立てることによって、反乱軍は作戦行動上の柔軟さを失わず、最善の防御体制で敵を待ち受けることができた。'' |translation='''Title:''' All set. '''Card text:''' USED: Play one of the following cards from hand and place it out of play: Attack Run, You're All Clear Kid, Death Star: Trench, or Rebel technician. Retrieve 1 Force instead. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve Attack Run from the Lost Deck. '''Lore:''' By quickly sensing the opponent's movements and laying careful plans, the Rebellion kept operational flexibility and could wait for the enemy in the best defensive posture. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Advance Preparation]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Card text:''' When you deploy a weapon from hand at the same location as an Advosze, immediately activate 1 Force as a “kickback.” Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. Only one Advosze may be at a location or aboard a starship. '''Lore:''' As is common among male Advosze, Bom Vimdin dislikes his own kind. A pessimist with a strong sense of territory. A lone-wolf smuggler whose best customers are corrupt officials. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese kickback is when you deploy a weapon from hand; the English is a weapon or device. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Advosze]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Virtual Modern''' — [[Attack Pattern Delta (V)]] (222_19) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=アタックパターン・デルタ |printed_game_text=位置カードで戦闘が宣言された直後に使用する。そこにいるＴ－４７を一機、先頭機として選ぶ。そのターンの終わりまで、同じ位置にいる他のＴ－４７はそれぞれ戦闘力＋１、加えて耐：損耗を得、武器の目標とならない。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Attack-Pattern-Delta-PSA-156433120.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''スカイウォーカー中佐と反乱軍の戦術参謀ベリル・シフォナージが考案したスノースピーダー用の攻撃隊形。１列に並び、敵の砲火を先頭機が引き受けて後続機を守る。'' |translation='''Title:''' Attack Pattern Delta. '''Card text:''' Use immediately after a battle is declared at a location. Choose one T-47 there as the lead. Until the end of that turn, each other T-47 at the same location is power +1, immune to attrition, and may not be targeted by weapons. '''Lore:''' A snowspeeder attack formation devised by Commander Skywalker and Rebel tactician Beryl Chiffonage. They line up in single file, and the lead ship draws enemy fire to protect those behind. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese chooses one T-47 there as the lead; the English identifies your lead T-47. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Attack Pattern Delta]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. text:
{{Card |title=Attack Run |side=Light |type=Epic Event |type_display=[[Epic Event]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Attack-Run-SWCA-67653.jpg |lead='''Attack Run''' is a [[Light]] [[Epic Event]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_42o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=0 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Attack Run]] (2_42o)

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_42o), [[A New Hope (Japanese)]], September 1997
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Attack Run (Errata)]] (2_42d)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Attack Run (PC Errata)]]
'''PC Errata 2''' — [[Attack Run (PC Errata 2)]] (2_42) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊アタック・ラン |printed_game_text=「デス・スター：トレンチ」に配備する。自分の移動フェイズに、以下の方法でアタック・ランを試みられる： トレンチへの突入：自分の宇宙戦闘機を最大で3機まで「トレンチ」に移動させる（フォースは不要）。ダークサイドは即座に3機までのタイを追跡に向かわせられる（フォースは不要）。 編隊を組む：宇宙戦闘機のうち1機を先頭機（「プロトン魚雷」*が必要）に指定し、残りがいるなら編隊僚機とする。「ターボレーザー砲塔」および兵器を配備しているタイは、この時点で反乱軍（ライトサイド）の宇宙戦闘機に向けて武器の使用を行う（最初は編隊僚機を狙い、それが全滅してから先頭機を攻撃する）。命中した宇宙戦闘機は即座にロストする。 発射したぞ！：運命数を2つ引く。 逃げろ、引き上げだ：宇宙戦闘機はすべて「デス・スター」星系カード上に移動する（フォースは不要）。 もし、（運命数の合計＋X＋Y－Z）＞15なら、デス・スターは“壊滅”する。 X＝先頭機パイロットの能力値。ただし「照準コンピュータ」が配備されている場合には3。 Y＝反乱軍の基地（ヤヴィン4またはホス）のうち最大のものにある位置カードの合計数。 Z＝その位置にいるタイのパイロットのうち最も能力値の高いものの値。 *アタック・ラン中には「オーバーロード」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Attack-Run-SWCA-67653.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |translation='''Title:''' Attack Run. '''Card text:''' Deploy on Death Star: Trench. During your move phase, you may attempt an Attack Run as follows: Enter the trench: Move up to 3 of your starfighters to the Trench (no Force). The Dark Side may immediately send up to 3 TIEs in pursuit (no Force). Form a squadron: Designate 1 starfighter as the lead (Proton Torpedoes* required); remaining starfighters, if any, are wingmen. Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons now fire at Rebel (Light Side) starfighters (wingmen first, then the lead after those are wiped out). Hit starfighters are immediately lost. It's away!: Draw two destiny. Run, pull up: All starfighters move to the Death Star system card (no Force). If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) > 15, the Death Star is "devastated." X = ability of the lead pilot, or 3 if Targeting Computer is deployed. Y = total location cards at the largest Rebel base (Yavin 4 or Hoth). Z = the highest ability among TIE pilots at that location. *During Attack Run, not affected by Overload. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese 壊滅 is devastated; the English is blown away. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Attack Run]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_32o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Bacta Tank (PC Errata)]] (3_32) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊バクタ・タンク |printed_game_text=４フォース消費して場の自分の側に配備する。ロストした直後のドロイド以外のキャラクターを１名、ロストデッキの代わりにここに移すことができる。１度に１名の“患者”を保持する。自分の配備フェイズにＸフォース消費して“患者”を手札に入れることができる。Ｘ＝“患者”の配備コスト。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Bacta-Tank-PSA-148375108.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''昆虫型種族のヴラティックスが何世紀も以前に発明した画期的な医療技術。ゼラチン状の赤いバクタの粒子が合成溶液中に散在しており、治療用バクテリアの媒介物質となる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Bacta Tank. '''Card text:''' Use 4 Force to deploy on your side of the table. A non-droid character just lost may be moved here instead of the Lost Pile. Holds 1 'patient' at a time. During your deploy phase, you may use X Force to take the 'patient' into hand. X = the 'patient's' deploy cost. '''Lore:''' A revolutionary medical technique invented centuries ago by the insectoid Vratix. Gelatinous red bacta particles are suspended in a synthetic solution and serve as a medium for healing bacteria. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Bacta Tank]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Baniss Keeg |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-PSA-02-Face.jpg |lead='''Baniss Keeg''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_209o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Baniss Keeg]] (1_209o)'''PC Errata''' — [[Baniss Keeg (PC Errata)]] (1_209)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=バニス・キーグ |printed_game_text=どちらか選ぶこと。１：パイロットでないキャラクター（ドロイドを除く）に配備して、パイロット［パイロットアイコン］技能を持たせる。そのキャラクターの操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２になる。２：パイロットキャラクターに配備して、そのキャラクターの操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力をさらに＋１する（「意識操作」の影響を受けない）。 |printed_lore=''デュロスは、優れた宇宙船乗りやエンジニアとして知られた種族で、多くのものが帝国のために働かされている。中にはバニス・キーグのように、深宇宙での任務のために、パイロットたちを訓練しているものもいる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Baniss Keeg. '''Card text:''' Choose one. Deploy on a non-pilot character except a droid to give pilot skill. That character's starship has power +2. Or deploy on a pilot to add 1 more power. (Not affected by Mind Manipulation.) '''Lore:''' Duros are a species known as accomplished spacefarers and engineers, many of whom are forced to work for the Empire. Some, like Baniss Keeg, train pilots for missions in deep space. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese numbers the two options and uses 意識操作 for Alter. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Baniss Keeg]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Bantha (V)]] (1210_79) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Vehicle]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=バンサ |printed_game_text=乗客を2名乗せることができる。バンサの能力値は、1/2である。戦闘やフォース消耗へのリアクションとして、移動範囲内の位置へ移動できる。同じ屋外の位置にいるタスケン・レイダーは、戦闘力＋１になる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-307o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''貨客両用の動物で、さまざまな大きさと色のものがある。体高は約3メートル。水も食料も無しで何週間も動きまわれるので、銀河の各地で飼育されている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Bantha. '''Card text:''' May carry 2 passengers. Bantha ability is 1/2. May move as a react to a battle or Force drain within range. Each Tusken Raider at the same exterior site is power +1. '''Lore:''' A pack and passenger animal in many sizes and colors. About 3 meters tall. Can go weeks without food or water, so it is kept across the galaxy. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Bantha]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. text:
{{Card |title=Beggar |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |language_display=Japanese |label_language=Language |navigation=[[Alter (Light) (Premiere) (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[Beru Lars (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Beggar-Face.jpg |lead='''Beggar''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_44o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Rare1 |rarity_display=Rare1 |publisher=[[Decipher]] / [[Takara]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=3 |icons=[[Effect]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' - [[Beggar]] (1_44)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_44o) |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=BorderBlack FinishNonfoil |printed_title=物乞い（ベガー） |printed_game_text=3フォース消費して、タトゥイーンの屋外の位置に配備する（そこがベガーズ・キャニオンなら配備コスト0）。自分のターンに、相手のフォースデッキのフォースを好きなだけ消費することができる。ただし、1ターンに2フォース以上消費すると、物乞いはロストデッキへ送られる。 |printed_lore=モス・アイズリーでは、詐欺や強盗にあって、全てを失う者が後を絶たない。惑星から出る旅費もなく、路上で暮らし、雑用や物乞いをする。 |translation='''Title:''' Beggar (the parenthetical katakana gives the English word beggar). '''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy at an exterior Tatooine location (deployment costs 0 if it is [[Tatooine: Beggar's Canyon|Beggar's Canyon]]). During your turn, you can use as much Force as you like from the opponent's Force Pile. However, if you use 2 or more Force in one turn, Beggar is sent to the Lost Pile. '''Lore:''' In Mos Eisley, there is no end to those who lose everything through fraud or robbery. Without the fare to leave the planet, they live on the streets, do odd jobs, and beg. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese final sentence says 2 or more Force, without repeating the English qualification that the Force is the opponent's. Two or more and more than 1 express the same numerical threshold. The Japanese uses exterior location where the English says exterior site.[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Beggar-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].[[:File:Premiere-L-beggar.gif|Beggar English printed face]]. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Beggar]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |sources=* [[:File:Premiere-L-beggar.gif|Beggar English printed face]] (comparison). * [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97 (Japanese Premiere checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Beru Lars (V)]] (1210_87) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Rebel]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=ベルー・ラーズ |printed_game_text=オーウェン・ラーズと同じ場所にいるか、水耕ステーションの上にいる場合、没収値に＋２。相手のターンに、ロストデッキへ行った場合、次の自分のターンが終了するまで、ルークの戦闘力に＋３。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-beru-lars-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''オーウェン・ラーズの妻。ルーク・スカイウォーカーの保護者。ルークの帝国アカデミー入学を夫のオーウェンに進言する。ファームの水耕ステーションの管理をしている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Beru Lars. '''Card text:''' Forfeit +2 when at the same location as [[Owen Lars|Owen Lars]] or at [[Hydroponics Station|Hydroponics Station]]. If she goes to the Lost Pile during your opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn. '''Lore:''' [[Owen Lars|Owen Lars]]'s wife and [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]]'s guardian. She urges her husband Owen to let Luke enter the Imperial Academy. She manages the farm's hydroponics station. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Blaster Rack (V)]] (200_104) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ブラスター収納ラック |printed_game_text=場の自分の側に配備する。好きなロケーションにいるキャラクターの持つ武器を１つ、ブラスター収納ラックの上に移すことができる。配備フェイズに、武器の配備コストを支払いなおせば、その武器を任意のキャラクターに配備することができる。 |printed_lore=''デス・スターや帝国軍守備隊基地の補給所には、ブラスター収納ラックがある。ブラスター・ライフルやサーマル・デトネーター（高温弾）など、兵士用の装備が立てかけてある。'' |translation='''Title:''' Blaster storage rack. '''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. You may move one weapon held by a character at any location onto the Blaster Rack. During the deploy phase, if you pay the weapon's deploy cost again, you may deploy that weapon on any character. '''Lore:''' Supply stations on the Death Star and at Imperial garrison bases have blaster storage racks. Equipment for soldiers, such as blaster rifles and thermal detonators, is stored on them. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a weapon held by a character at any location and does not explicitly say it must be yours or specify that the move may be made at any time. The English refers to one of your character weapons at any site and explicitly allows the move at any time. The Japanese says the weapon may be deployed on any character. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Blaster Rack]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=40s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 0:40. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. title: BoShek (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=BoShek |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] - [[Alien|Alien]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Blaster Rifle (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-BoShek-Face.jpg |lead='''BoShek''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien|Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_4o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Uncommon1 |rarity_display=Uncommon1 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=1 |power=2 |ability=4 |deploy=4 |forfeit=3 |landspeed=1[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0#Landspeed|Decipher Rulebook 2.0, Landspeed]]. |label_landspeed=Landspeed |icons=[[Alien]] [[Pilot]][[:File:Japanese-Premiere-BoShek-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' — [[BoShek]] (1_4o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_4o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[BoShek (Errata)]] (1_4)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[BoShek (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)]] (1101_1) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ボシェック |printed_game_text=操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋3。密輸屋ではないが、ケッセル・ランを行える。耐：損耗<3。 |printed_lore=モグリのパイロット。無資格の宇宙船技術者。モス・アイズリーに秘密研究室を持つ。ハン・ソロの持つケッセル・ランの記録を破った豪語した。オビ＝ワンに出会った後、改心する。 |translation='''Title:''' BoShek. '''Card text:''' Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. Although he is not a smuggler, he can make a Kessel Run. Immune to attrition less than 3. '''Lore:''' An unlicensed pilot. An unqualified starship technician. Has a secret laboratory in Mos Eisley. Boasted that he had broken Han Solo's Kessel Run record. Reformed after meeting Obi-Wan. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese explicitly says he is not a smuggler; the English says he may make a Kessel Run in place of a smuggler. The Japanese lore calls him an unlicensed pilot and an unqualified starship technician, rather than the English “Rogue pilot” and “Outlaw starship tech,” and shortens Obi-Wan Kenobi to Obi-Wan.[[:File:Premiere-L-boshek-decipher-archive.gif|BoShek original English printed face]]. |sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97 (Japanese Premiere checklist). |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

{{Card |title=Boosted TIE Cannon |side=Dark |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Starship Weapon]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-313o-Video.jpg |lead='''Boosted TIE Cannon''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Starship Weapon]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_313o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Boosted TIE Cannon]] (1_313o)

'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Boosted TIE Cannon (Errata)]] (1_313) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ブーステッド・タイ・キャノン |printed_game_text=1フォース消費して、タイ・アドバンスト×1に配備する。1フォース使って、起動する。大型艦は、（運命数－1）＞装甲値ならば命中。宇宙戦闘機は、（運命数＋1）＞回避値ならば命中する。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-313o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''強化型タイ・ブラスター・キャノンの試作品。パワーも射程も段違いで、照準プログラムも改良されている。より強力なエネルギー・セルを必要とする。タイ・ファイターの精鋭中隊で実戦テストされている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Boosted TIE Cannon. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on a TIE Advanced x1. Use 1 Force to fire. A capital starship is hit if destiny -1 > armor. A starfighter is hit if destiny +1 > maneuver. '''Lore:''' A prototype enhanced TIE blaster cannon. Far more power and range, with improved targeting. It needs a stronger energy cell. Elite TIE squadrons are testing it. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Boosted TIE Cannon]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. title: Boring Conversation Anyway (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Boring Conversation Anyway |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] — [[Used Interrupt]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Boring-Conversation-Anyway-video.png |lead='''Boring Conversation Anyway''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_235o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |destiny=5 |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Boring Conversation Anyway]] (1_235)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=しどろもどろのソロ |printed_game_text=以下のカードをキャンセルする。「ベイダー卿に報告」、「アクセス・リンク」、「反乱軍参謀」、「反乱軍増援兵」、「師の導き」、「まだ気を抜くな」、「スカイウォーカー（空駆ける者）たち」、「降格」、「共同攻撃」、「急襲」 |printed_lore=''「あ～、ちょっとした武器の故障でして…、しかし万事順調です。こちらは異常なし。全く異常ありません。そちらは？」'' |translation='''Title:''' A flustered Solo. '''Card text:''' Cancel the following cards: Report To Lord Vader, [[Scomp Link Access]], [[Rebel Planners]], [[Rebel Reinforcements]], Gift Of The Mentor, [[Don't Get Cocky]], [[Skywalkers]], [[Demotion]], Combined Attack, and [[Surprise Assault]]. '''Lore:''' “Ah, there was a slight weapons malfunction ... but everything is going smoothly. Nothing is wrong here. Absolutely nothing is wrong. How about you?” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese list omits [[Panic]], which appears in the English list. The Japanese title describes Solo speaking haltingly, rather than referring to a boring conversation. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Boring Conversation Anyway]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=54s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 0:54. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Boring-Conversation-Anyway-video.png|Preserved card frame]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Bowcaster (V)]] (216_22) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ボウキャスター |printed_game_text=Xフォースを使用して任意の戦士に配備する。X＝（7－戦士の戦闘力）である。Xは最低でも1となる。Xフォースを使用して起動する。運命数を引く。キャラクターは運命数＋1＞能力値なら命中する。生物は運命数＋2＞防御値なら即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Bowcaster-PSA-157709610.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ウーキーが好んで使用する手作りの武器。起爆性の“矢”（ブラスターの光弾のように見える）を発射する。使いこなすにはかなりの腕力が必要。予備の弾薬は身体にかけた弾薬帯で持ち運ぶ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Bowcaster. {{Card |title=Caller |side=Light |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-34o-Face.jpg |lead='''Caller''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_34o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=6 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Caller]] (1_34)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_34o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=コーラー |printed_game_text=反乱軍、ジャワに配備できる。自分の支配フェイズに、同じ位置にあって行動規制ボルトにコントロールされているドロイドを１体盗むことができる。ドロイドを盗んだなら、行動規制ボルトは所有者の手札に戻る。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-34o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''行動規制ボルトに命令するための携帯装置。コーラーと行動規制ボルトは１対１で対応している。銀河規模で広く使われており、“行動規制ボルト起動器”とも呼ばれている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Caller. '''Card text:''' May deploy on a Rebel or Jawa. During your control phase, you may steal one droid at the same location that is controlled by a restraining bolt. If you steal the droid, return the restraining bolt to its owner's hand. '''Lore:''' A handheld device for commanding a restraining bolt. Each caller corresponds to one restraining bolt. Widely used across the galaxy, it is also called a restraining bolt activator. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Caller]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Cantina Brawl (V)]] (1210_148) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=カンティーナの乱闘 |printed_game_text=２フォース消費して、カンティーナで乱闘を起こす。両プレイヤーとも、運命数を引く。どちらかの運命数と同じ能力値を持つキャラクターは、失われる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-73o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「気を付けろよ。少々荒っぽい場所だからな…。」モス・アイズリーのカンティーナでは、密輸屋、盗賊、強盗、お尋ね者、傭兵にバウンティ・ハンターと何でも揃える。'' |translation='''Title:''' Cantina Brawl. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to cause a brawl in the Cantina. Both players draw destiny. Characters with ability matching either destiny are lost. '''Lore:''' “Watch yourself. This place can be a little rough…” Mos Eisley’s Cantina has smugglers, thieves, robbers, wanted men, mercenaries and bounty hunters. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Cantina Brawl]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''PC Errata 2''' — [[Captain Khurgee (PC Errata 2)]] |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊カーギー大尉 |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズに、2フォース消費して自分のリザーブデッキの中から「探査部隊」を1枚探しだし、手札に加えることができる。その後デッキはシャッフルし、カットしてもとの位置に置く。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Captain-Khurgee-PSA-157709591.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ドッキング・ベイの保安士官で、リーダー。スター・デストロイヤー・サンダーフレアに乗り込み、シャトル事故の現場から5人の士官を救い出した勇敢な人物として知られる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Captain Khurgee. Scanning Crew is 「探査部隊」. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Captain Khurgee]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. text:
{{Card |title=Captain Lennox |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Captain-Lennox-PSA-160326784.jpg |lead='''Captain Lennox''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_84o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |power=2 |ability=2 |deploy=3 |forfeit=5 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Captain Lennox]] (3_84o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_84o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Captain Lennox (Errata)]] (3_84)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Captain Lennox (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)]] (1104_32)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Captain Lennox (V)]] (1220_5) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊レノックス艦長 |printed_game_text=操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２（艦が「タイラント」なら３）を加える。スター・デストロイヤー上にいるなら、自分の各支配フェイズに１回、その艦の「牽引ビーム」を使用することができる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Captain-Lennox-PSA-160326784.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''インペリアル・スター・デストロイヤー“タイラント”の艦長。有能なリーダー。帝国の将校には珍しく、艦と乗組員に愛情を注いでいる。軍に政治を持ち込むことを極端に嫌う。'' |translation='''Title:''' Captain Lennox. '''Card text:''' Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots (3 if the ship is Tyrant). If aboard a Star Destroyer, once during each of your control phases he may use that ship's Tractor Beam. '''Lore:''' Captain of the Imperial Star Destroyer Tyrant. An able leader. Unlike most Imperial officers, he is devoted to his ship and crew. He strongly dislikes bringing politics into the service. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Captain Lennox]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

title: Captain Piett (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Captain Piett |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Captain-Piett-PSA-145551186.jpg |lead='''Captain Piett''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_85o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |power=2 |ability=3 |deploy=3 |forfeit=4 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Captain Piett]] (3_85o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_85o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Captain Piett (Errata)]] (3_85)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Captain Piett (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)]] (1104_33)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Captain Piett (V)]] (1220_6) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊ピエット艦長 |printed_game_text=ベイダーと同じ位置にいるなら戦闘力＋１。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２（艦が「エグゼクター」なら３）を加える。１フォース消費して自分のリザーブデッキからプローブ・ドロイドを探し出し、手札に入れることができる。その後リザーブデッキはシャッフルし、カットしてもとの所に置く。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Captain-Piett-PSA-145551186.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''エグゼクターの艦長。遠隔域に放ったプローブ・ドロイドの動向を追跡監視している。数々の逮捕や鎮圧活動を行い、矢継ぎ早に昇進を重ねてきた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Captain Piett. '''Card text:''' Power +1 when at the same location as Vader. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots (3 if the ship is Executor). May use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck for a Probe Droid and take it into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace. '''Lore:''' Captain of the Executor. He tracks probe droids sent into remote regions. A string of arrests and suppressions has brought him rapid promotion. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese is power +1 at the same location as Vader; the English at the same site. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Captain Piett]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any Death Star location card except Docking Bay 327. Target one of your spies or leaders who is on the Death Star. When the target reaches the Utinni Effect, draw destiny. Release that many captives from Detention Block Corridor. The Utinni Effect is lost. '''Lore:''' “Aren't you a little short for a stormtrooper?” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese targets a spy or leader on the Death Star; the English targets one not on the Death Star. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Cell 2187]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: Charming To The Last (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Charming To The Last |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Caller (Dark) (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[Chief Bast (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Charming-To-The-Last-Face.jpg |lead='''Charming To The Last''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_236o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Rare2 |rarity_display=Rare2[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97 (Japanese Premiere checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unrestricted |destiny=5 |icons=[[Interrupt]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Charming To The Last]] (1_236)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_236o) |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=Subtype[[Lost Interrupt]] |printed_title=この期に及んでお勇ましい[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Charming-To-The-Last-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=ターキンと、能力値＞2の反乱軍メンバーが同じ戦闘に参加した時に使う。戦闘運命数を1枚多く引ける（反乱軍メンバーがレイア姫なら、2枚多く引ける。）。 |printed_lore=「他愛なく口を割られたな。ダントゥインは遠すぎて、見せしめには使えぬが、それもよかろう。まもなくお仲間の反乱軍を壊滅してみせますぞ。」 |translation='''Title:''' Still Brave at This Late Hour '''Card text:''' Use when [[Grand Moff Tarkin|Tarkin]] and a Rebel with ability > 2 participate in the same battle. You may draw one additional battle destiny (two additional destiny if the Rebel is [[Leia Organa|Princess Leia]]). '''Lore:''' “You gave up the information easily. Dantooine is too far away to serve as an example, but never mind. Soon we shall destroy your Rebel friends.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title describes continued bravery rather than charm. Both game texts require Tarkin and a Rebel with ability > 2 in the same battle and give one additional battle destiny, or two for Leia. The Japanese lore says the information was given up easily and promises to destroy the Rebel friends. The English says “You're far too trusting” and “We will deal with your Rebel friends soon enough.”[[:File:Premiere-D-charmingtothelast.gif|Charming To The Last original English printed face]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Chewbacca (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Chewbacca |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Alien]] / [[Rebel]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Chewbacca-Encyclopedia32-p42-xref2048.jpeg |lead='''Chewbacca''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]] / [[Rebel]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_3o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=1 |power=6 |ability=2 |deploy=4 |forfeit=6 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Chewbacca]] (2_3o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1302_3o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Chewbacca (Errata)]] (2_3)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Chewbacca (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_4)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Chewbacca (V)]] (213_36) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=チューバッカ |printed_game_text=ハンと同じ位置カードにいるなら戦闘力＋1。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。ミレニアム・ファルコンに乗っているならさらに回避値に1を加える。彼と同じ位置カード上のビークルやドロイドは、“命中” しても（ロストデッキのかわりに）ユーズドデッキに行く。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Chewbacca-Encyclopedia32-p42-xref2048.jpeg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''キャッシーク出身のウーキーの密輸屋。200歳を越えている。腕利きの整備士にしてパイロット。ジャバはこの “歩き回るカーペット” にも多額の賞金をかけている。仲間からは “チューイー” とか、“毛むくじゃら” と呼ばれている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Chewbacca. '''Card text:''' Power +1 if at the same location card as Han. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If aboard Millennium Falcon, also adds 1 to maneuver. Vehicles and droids on the same location card as him go to the Used Deck (instead of the Lost Deck) even if they are “hit.” '''Lore:''' A Wookiee smuggler from Kashyyyk. He is over 200 years old. A skilled mechanic and pilot. Jabba has also placed a large bounty on this “walking carpet.” His companions call him “Chewie” or “Fuzzball.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese last sentence names vehicles and droids. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Chewbacca]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Chewie (V)]] (200_5) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=チューイー |printed_game_text=ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。ただし場に敵の単一（＊）キャラクターが3名以上いる場合、配置することができない。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Chewie-Encyclopedia32-p45.jpeg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ハン・ソロ船長の忠実なウーキーの相棒。ミレニアム・ファルコンの副操縦士。レイアいわく “歩き回るカーペット”。'' |translation='''Title:''' Chewie. '''Card text:''' Deploys only on Hoth. After that, he can move anywhere. However, he cannot deploy if three or more of the opponent’s unique (*) characters are on the table. '''Lore:''' Captain Han Solo’s loyal Wookiee companion. Co-pilot of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Leia calls him a “walking carpet.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card uses an asterisk for the uniqueness mark in the title and the corresponding reference in the game text. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Chewie]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. '''Card text:''' At the start of a battle, if aboard a starship, may immediately evacuate (relocate) with one other character to a site in the same system. Power +1 if at the same site as Tarkin. '''Virtual Legacy Errata''' — [[Collateral Damage (V) (Errata)]] (1210_55) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=予期せぬ損傷 |printed_game_text=敵のキャラクターが２名以上、武器が１つ以上配備されている位置での戦闘の開始時に、事故が起こる。運命数を引く。運命数＜その位置の敵キャラクターの人数ならば、その中の１名がロストする（ロストするキャラクターは、敵プレイヤーが選ぶ）。Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Collateral-Damage-video.png|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Collateral Damage (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Collateral-Damage-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ブラスト・ベストとブラスト・シールド付きヘルメットで完全武装の反乱軍兵士も、手榴弾が弾け、パネルが爆発する戦場では、無事ではいられない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Unexpected damage. '''Card text:''' At the beginning of a battle at a location where two or more opposing characters and one or more weapons are deployed, an accident occurs. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than the number of opposing characters at that location, one of them is lost; the opposing player chooses which character. '''Lore:''' Even Rebel soldiers fully equipped with blast vests and helmets with blast shields cannot remain unharmed on a battlefield where grenades burst and panels explode. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a location where opposing characters and weapons are deployed; the English refers to a site where the opponent has those cards. The Japanese title means unexpected damage. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Collateral Damage]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Card text:''' Power +1 when at the same location with Tarkin, Chief Bast, and General Dodonna. '''Lore:''' An Imperial Security Bureau (ISB) officer accompanying Tarkin to provide him with information. He devotes unrivaled loyalty to the Emperor and acts without hesitation to fulfill his wishes. Leader. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card says location where the English says site. The Japanese lists the three characters without an explicit word for “or”; the English says Tarkin, Chief Bast or General Dodonna. The Japanese lore describes Yularen as personally loyal to the Emperor; the English says he is ordered to ensure absolute loyalty to the Emperor. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Colonel Wullf Yularen]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=68s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 1:08. '''Title'''
Luke Skywalker, Lieutenant Colonel
'''Lore'''
Hero of the Battle of Yavin. Over these three years, he gained experience as a soldier of the Alliance, and his current rank is lieutenant colonel. At the Battle of Hoth, he served as the leader of Echo Base's flight squadron.
'''Game text'''
May deploy only on Hoth, but may move anywhere afterward. Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Rogue 1, adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3. All other Rogue Squadron pilots and gunners at the same Hoth location have forfeit +1.
The Japanese title and lore use 中佐, a rank term translated as lieutenant colonel or, in naval usage, commander; the English printing uses Commander. The Japanese game text explicitly says "if piloting Rogue 1"; the English face says "On Rogue 1". Both printed faces give the +3 power bonus to a starship he pilots. The Japanese lore describes three years of military experience and his current rank, rather than the English sentence about promotion in his third year. The final Japanese sentence uses 位置 (location), whereas the original English face specifies a "site".[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[[:File:Hoth-L-commanderlukeskywalker-decipher-archive.gif|Original English card face]]. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Commander Luke Skywalker]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. {{Card |title=Commander Praji |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Commander-Praji-video.png |lead='''Commander Praji''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_167o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=2 |power=1 |ability=2 |deploy=2 |forfeit=3 |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Commander Praji]] (1_167o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing'''
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Commander Praji (Errata)]] (1_167)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Commander Praji (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour)]] (1102_28)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Commander Praji (V)]] (221_12) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Imperial]] [[Pilot]] [[Warrior]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=＊プラージ少佐 |printed_game_text=プラージのいるところでは、Ｃ－３ＰＯとＲ２－Ｄ２は、カードルールの内容を使えない。彼が操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２。デバステーターに乗っている場合、航行速度＋１となる。 |printed_lore=''戦艦デバステーターで、ベイダーの副官を務めた。ベイダーの命により、タトゥイーンでデス・スターの設計図捜索の指揮を執る。カリダにある帝国宇宙軍アカデミーを優秀な成績で卒業している。'' |translation='''Title:''' Major Praji. '''Card text:''' Where Praji is present, C-3PO and R2-D2 cannot use their card rules. Any starship he pilots is power +2. When aboard the Devastator, hyperspeed is +1. '''Lore:''' Served as Vader's aide aboard the warship Devastator. On Vader's orders, directed the search for the Death Star plans on Tatooine. Graduated with excellent results from the Imperial Navy Academy on Carida. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title uses the rank “major” (少佐); the English title uses “commander.” The Japanese text joins C-3PO and R2-D2 with “and,” while the English face uses “or.” |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Commander Praji]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=75s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 1:15. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Commander-Praji-video.png|Preserved card frame]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Original''' — [[Commander Vanden Willard (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_7)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Commander Vanden Willard (V)]] (211_58) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊ヴァンデン・ウィラード少佐 |printed_game_text=自分が支配している戦略司令室に配備されている場合、その星系カード上の反乱軍の宇宙船はそれぞれ戦闘力＋1。1フォースを使用して「操縦ドロイド不足」をキャンセルできる。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Commander-Vanden-Willard-PSA-164793235.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ヤヴィン4における反乱軍のリーダーの一人。かつてはソウルリープ宙域の司令部に所属していた。元老院解散以前の数年間、反乱軍のスパイとしてレイア姫とベイル・オーガナを支援していた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Commander Vanden Willard. '''Card text:''' If deployed at a war room you control, each Rebel starship at that system card is power +1. May use 1 Force to cancel Astromech Shortage. '''Lore:''' One of the Rebel leaders on Yavin 4. Formerly attached to Suolriep sector HQ. For several years before the Senate's dissolution, he aided Princess Leia and Bail Organa as a Rebel spy. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses 操縦ドロイド不足 for Astromech Shortage. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Commander Vanden Willard]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

text:
{{Card |title=Commence Primary Ignition |side=Dark |type=Epic Event |type_display=[[Epic Event]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Commence-Primary-Ignition-PSA-161939281.jpg |lead='''Commence Primary Ignition''' is a [[Dark]] [[Epic Event]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_130o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=0 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Commence Primary Ignition]] (2_130)
'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Commence Primary Ignition (Revised)]] (52_130)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_130o)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7)]] (1271_18o)
'''Virtual Legacy Errata''' — [[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (1271_18)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Commence Primary Ignition (V)]]
'''Virtual Modern Errata''' — [[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Errata)]] (209_45) — current |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=発射準備開始せよ |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズに以下の手順でスーパーレーザーを発射する： 星系を指定する：Xフォース消費してデス・スターが軌道上にいる星系（惑星のみ）を目標に選ぶ。 発射準備よし：運命数を引く。 発射：（運命数＋Y－Z）＞8なら目標の星系は“壊滅”し、このカードはロストデッキ行きとなる。さもなくば、このカードはユーズドデッキに行き、場にいる「デス・スター砲手」が一人ロストする（誰をロストするかは自分で選べる）。 X＝目標星系に配備された位置カードの枚数。 Y＝敵の人員が配備されていないデス・スターの位置カードの枚数。 Z＝敵がどちらかを選ぶ。Xまたは、どこか一箇所の反乱軍基地（「ヤヴィン４」または「ホス」）の位置カードの枚数。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Commence-Primary-Ignition-PSA-161939281.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |translation='''Title:''' Begin firing preparations. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, fire Superlaser by the following steps: Name a system: Use X Force to choose as the target a system (planet only) that the Death Star is orbiting. You may fire when ready: Draw destiny. Fire: If (destiny + Y − Z) > 8, the target system is “blown away” and this card goes to the Lost Deck. Otherwise this card goes to the Used Deck and one Death Star Gunner on table is lost (you may choose which one). X = the number of location cards deployed at the target system. Y = the number of Death Star location cards with no enemy personnel deployed. Z = the opponent chooses either X or the number of location cards at one Rebel Base (Yavin 4 or Hoth). '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 発射準備開始せよ. Japanese Y counts location cards with no enemy personnel. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Commence Primary Ignition]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

text:
{{Card |title=Commence Recharging |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Commence-Recharging-PSA-161939282.jpg |lead='''Commence Recharging''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_31o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Commence Recharging]] (2_31o)
'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Commence Recharging (Revised)]] (52_31)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_31o), [[A New Hope (Japanese)]], September 1997
'''PC Errata''' — [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata)]] (2_31e1)
'''PC Errata 2''' — [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 2)]]
'''PC Errata 3''' — [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 3)]]
'''PC Errata 4''' — [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 4)]] (2_31) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊再充填を開始せよ |printed_game_text=スーパーレーザーに配備する。スーパーレーザーを惑星に対して使用するためには、相手側はまず最初に、ここに8枚のフォースカードを重ねて“充填”を行わねばならない。レーザーが使用された時に、このエフェクトはキャンセルされる。エフェクトがキャンセルされると同時に、重ねてあったフォースはユーズドデッキ行きとなる。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Commence-Recharging-PSA-161939282.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''スーパーレーザー用融合炉のパワー・ジェネレーター回路には巨大な負荷がかかる。装置は未だ十分なテストを受けておらず、システムを再稼働する前には、エネルギーを完全に充填し直さなければならない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Begin recharging. '''Card text:''' Deploy on Superlaser. To use Superlaser against a planet, the opponent must first stack 8 Force cards here and “charge.” When the laser is used, this Effect is canceled. At the same time the Effect is canceled, the stacked Force goes to the Used Deck. '''Lore:''' A huge load falls on the power-generator circuit of the Superlaser's fusion reactor. The device has not yet been fully tested, and energy must be completely recharged before the system can be run again. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 再充填を開始せよ (begin recharging). |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Commence Recharging]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Concussion Grenade (Errata)]] (3_73) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=コンカッション・グレネード |printed_game_text=２フォース消費して任意の戦士に配備する。同じ位置か隣接位置にむかって“投げる”ことができる。運命数を引く。その位置にいる、同じ運命数を持った全てのキャラクター、武器、アイテムはロストする。運命数＝０の場合は、グレネードを投げた自分の戦士だけがロストする。コンカッション・グレネードもロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Concussion-Grenade-PSA-152940012.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ミア＝ランＶ－５９グレネード。破壊力は抜群'' |translation='''Title:''' Concussion grenade. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on any warrior. May 'throw' toward the same or an adjacent location. Draw destiny. All characters, weapons and devices at that location with that destiny number are lost. If destiny = 0, only your warrior who threw the grenade is lost. The concussion grenade is also lost. '''Lore:''' Mier-Lan V-59 grenade. Outstanding destructive power. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says the grenade's destructive power is outstanding; the English lore says it blows stuff up. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Concussion Grenade]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Counter Assault (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)]] (1371_238o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=反撃 |printed_game_text=１フォース消費して、１ヶ所でのフォース消耗をキャンセルできる。その位置にいる敵のキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークルの合計枚数だけ運命数を引く。そして、自分の運命数の合計と、敵の戦闘力の合計を比較し、少ないほうが、その差だけのフォース消耗を受ける。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Counter-Assault-SWCA-100697.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国のストームトルーパーは、奇襲攻撃への対抗策として、即座に部隊を再編成し、一挙に形勢を逆転する訓練を受けている。これにより、ハン・ソロの型破りな追撃を阻止できた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Counter Assault. '''Card text:''' Spend 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at one location. Draw as many destiny draws as there are enemy characters, starships and vehicles at that location. Compare your destiny total with the enemy’s total power. The side with the lower total suffers a Force drain equal to the difference. '''Lore:''' Imperial stormtroopers train to regroup immediately and reverse the situation in one move in response to a surprise attack. This let them stop Han Solo’s unorthodox pursuit. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses フォース消耗 for both the canceled Force drain and the loss applied after comparing totals. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Counter Assault]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. '''Card text:''' Any starship he pilots is power +3. While aboard Black 2, maneuver is +1, and he may draw one battle destiny even if otherwise unable to draw one. '''Lore:''' Pilot DS-61-2. He flies Black 2 as the left wingman in formation with Vader's craft. Specially trained to fight alongside Vader, he normally stands by in reserve. You may use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck for one Lone Pilot and take it into hand. Then shuffle the deck, cut, and replace. '''Card text:''' USED: Cancel Dark Collaboration or Lone Pilot. LOST: If two Imperials with ability > 2 are taking part in the same battle, use 2 Force to draw two destiny. '''Reflections Gold Remastered''' - [[Dark Maneuvers (Reflections Gold Remastered)]] |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=Subtype[[Used Interrupt]] |printed_title=命知らずの戦法[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Dark-Maneuvers-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=このターンの終わりまで、任意の宇宙戦闘機が、回避値＋2、戦闘力＋1となる。さらに、航行速度があれば、航行速度＋2になる（宇宙戦闘機を対象にした運命数が引かれた直後に、すぐにこのインタラプトを使用し、結果を左右することもできる）。 |printed_lore=帝国のタイ・ファイターは、防御力こそ低いものの、速度と機動性に優れている。巧みな捨て身の戦法で、反乱軍のXウイングやYウイングの弱点を突く。 |translation='''Title:''' Reckless Tactics '''Card text:''' Until the end of this turn, any starfighter gains maneuver +2 and power +1. If it has hyperspeed, it also gains hyperspeed +2. You may use this Interrupt immediately after a destiny targeting the starfighter is drawn to affect the result. '''Lore:''' Dark Lord of the Sith. Servant of the Emperor. Clad in armor containing a cybernetic life-support system. Was a pupil of Obi-Wan Kenobi. The best pilot in the galaxy and also a cunning warrior. '''Game text:''' During battle, you may add 1 to each battle destiny number (not 1 to the total, but 1 for each draw). A starship he pilots has power +3. If aboard Vader's Custom TIE, it has power +4 and maneuver +3. Immune to attrition < 5. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text explicitly explains that the bonus applies to each draw rather than the total; the English printed text says it adds 1 to each battle destiny. The Japanese uses 'pilot' where the English lore says 'starpilot.' The conditional wording also says he may add the bonus. |notes='''Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Darth Vader]], released by [[Decipher]] as a case topper for [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. Its checklist rarity is P.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R10. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive]. Each case of six Reflections II booster boxes included one Japanese Darth Vader foil as a case topper. Each box also included one randomly selected foil box topper: [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle]], [[Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol]], [[Leia With Blaster Rifle]] or [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]].[https://store.starwarsccg.org/product/reflections-2-complete-foil-set-105-foils/ Reflections 2 Complete Foil Set], Star Wars CCG Players Committee Store. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210412121344/https://store.starwarsccg.org/product/reflections-2-complete-foil-set-105-foils/ Internet Archive]. |see_also=* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese|Japanese printings]] |see_also_heading=See Also |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-premium.png|20px|link=Premium (icon)]] [[Premium (icon)|Premium]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_242o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Dead Jawa (Errata)]] (1_242) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ジャワの屍体 |printed_game_text=敵のジャワのいる位置で、２名以上のストームトルーパーがいる時に使う。どのジャワを何名対象にするか宣言して、運命数を引く。運命数＞ターゲットの人数ならば、ターゲットは全員ロストする。 |printed_lore=''Ｒ２－Ｄ２の捜索中、多くのジャワがストームトルーパーに殺された。タスケン・レイダーの仕業に見せるためバンサやガッフィの杖が使われたが、オビ＝ワンの目は欺けなかった。'' |translation='''Title:''' Jawa corpse. '''Card text:''' Use when two or more stormtroopers are at a location where the opponent has Jawas. Declare which Jawas and how many to target, then draw destiny. If destiny is greater than the number targeted, all targets are lost. '''Lore:''' During the search for R2-D2, many Jawas were killed by stormtroopers. Banthas and gaffi sticks were used to make it look like the work of Tusken Raiders, but Obi-Wan was not deceived. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to declare which Jawas and how many to target; the English says to target as many Jawas there as desired. The English explicitly says the targeted Jawas are immediately lost; the Japanese does not specify immediately. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Dead Jawa]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=103s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 1:43. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Dead-Jawa-video.png|Preserved card frame]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy on an exterior planet site. Target an opponent's smuggler. Each turn, at the start of the opponent's control phase, the opponent loses 1 Force. When the target reaches the Utinni Effect, the Utinni Effect is canceled and the target is placed in the Used Pile. '''Lore:''' "Living with a death mark is no small thing. Solo, you're an excellent fighter. It hurts to lose you." |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Death Mark]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Death Star Gunner (V)]] (1210_8) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊＊＊デス・スター・ガンナー（砲手） |printed_game_text=デス・スター上にあるならば、「発射準備開始せよ」の合計値に2を加える（累積可能）。自分の支配フェイズに、この砲手をユーズドデッキ行きにし、かわりにリザーブデッキのなかから「スーパーレーザー」を探してきて手札に入れることができる。その後でデッキをシャッフルし、カットしてもとの場所に置く。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Death-Star-Gunner-PSA-160005370.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国軍の砲手の多くは、タイのパイロットを夢見ながらも操縦に必要とされる技量を備えられなかった者たちだ。中にはデス・スターに配属されて主砲の操作を任される者もいる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Death Star Gunner (gunner). '''Card text:''' If on the Death Star, adds 2 to the total of Commence Primary Ignition (cumulative). During your control phase, you may send this gunner to the Used Pile and search the Reserve Deck for Superlaser and take it into hand. Then shuffle the deck, cut, and replace. '''Lore:''' Many Imperial gunners dreamed of being TIE pilots but lacked the skill to fly. Some were assigned to the Death Star and given the main gun. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title includes （砲手）. Japanese does not OR the Superlaser search. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star Gunner]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. title: Death Star Plans (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Death Star Plans |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] - [[Utinni Effect|Utinni Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Dantooine (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[Death Star: Detention Block Control Room (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Death-Star-Plans-Face.jpg |lead='''Death Star Plans''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect|Utinni Effect]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_46o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Rare1 |rarity_display=Rare1 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=6 |icons=[[Effect]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Death Star Plans]] (1_46)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_46o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=デス・スター設計図[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Death-Star-Plans-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=デス・スターの位置カードに配備（ドッキング・ベイを除く）。そこにいない自分のドロイドを対象に選ぶ。対象がこのカードの場所に来たら、設計図を“盗んだ”ことになる。その後、対象がヤヴィン4の位置カードに移動できれば、運命数を3枚引く。合計と同じ枚数のフォースを再使用する。このカードは使用後ロストデッキへ。 |printed_lore=「なにがそんなに大事なんだ？R2は何を運んでる？」「あの宇宙要塞の設計データよ。分析して弱点を発見できればいいけど。」 |translation='''Title:''' Death Star Plans. '''Card text:''' Deploy on a Death Star location card (except a docking bay). Choose one of your droids that is not there as the target. When the target reaches this card's location, it has “stolen” the plans. If the target subsequently moves to a Yavin 4 location card, draw three destiny. Retrieve a number of Force equal to their total. After use, this card goes to the Lost Pile. '''Lore:''' “What's so important? What is R2 carrying?” “The design data for that space fortress. I hope analysis will reveal a weakness.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese target condition says a droid that is “not there”; the English explicitly says “not on Death Star.” The Japanese uses location card where the English specifies site, and names R2 in the lore where the English says “he.”[[:File:Premiere-L-deathstarplans.gif|Death Star Plans original English printed face]]. |sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97 (Japanese Premiere checklist). |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on a Death Star site. While the sentry is present, choose one effect for that site and adjacent sites. Opponent's deploy +1. They also sensor-scan for life forms and weapons. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star Sentry]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. '''Virtual Modern''' — [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian (V)]] (200_10) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊デレク・“ホビー”・キルヴィアン |printed_game_text=ビッグズと同じ位置にいるなら戦闘力＋２。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２（スター・デストロイヤーが同じ場所にいるなら３）を加える。ローグ４を操縦するなら回避値に２を加える。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Derek-Hobbie-Klivian-PSA-164089327.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ビッグズ・ダークライターと共に帝国軍から脱走してきた。輸送船ランド・エクリプティックで反乱を起こしたエクリプティック・イヴエイダーズの一員。ホスの戦いではルークの編隊僚機をつとめた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Derek "Hobbie" Klivian. At the Battle of Hoth he flew as Luke's wingman. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Card text:''' * Ferocity = (power/ferocity of the last character or creature eaten) + destiny. Habitat: exterior Dagobah, Trash Compactor, and Dark Waters. '''Lore:''' A “garbage-dump giant squid” native to Vodran's jungles. Its body color changes with what it ate. When hungry it turns transparent. It eats almost anything. It has a flexible eyestalk and seven tentacles up to 6 m long. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses 「ゴミ圧縮装置」 and 「よどみきった汚水」. Printed subtype is 沼沢地生物. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Dianoga]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_214o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=切断された腕 |printed_game_text=武器を持ったキャラクターが、敵味方共に同じ位置にいる場合に使う。支配フェイズ（敵の支配フェイズでも可）に配備する。敵キャラクターは武器を失い、戦闘力－１になる。さらに、これ以降、武器を配備できなくなる。「意識操作」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-214o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''Ｃ－３ＰＯの腕は、タスケン・レイダーの襲撃でもげてしまった。「これ以上は無理です。行って下さい、ルーク様。私はもうだめです…」'' |translation='''Title:''' Severed Arm. '''Card text:''' Use when both sides have a character with a weapon at the same location. Deploy during either player's control phase. The opposing character loses its weapon, is power −1, and cannot have weapons deployed on it thereafter. Immune to Alter. '''Lore:''' C-3PO's arm came off during a Tusken Raider attack. “I can't go on. Please go, Master Luke. I'm done for…” |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Disarmed (Dark)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_48o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=切断された腕 |printed_game_text=武器を持ったキャラクターが、敵味方共に同じ位置にいる場合に使う。支配フェイズ（敵の支配フェイズでも可）に配備する。敵キャラクターは武器を失い、戦闘力－１になる。さらにこれ以降、武器を配備できなくなる。「意識操作」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-48o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''カンティーナで、Ｄｒ．エヴァザンとポンダ・バーバがルークに絡んだ時、オビ＝ワンはいった。「手を出す価値もない若造だ。」乱闘が始まった。'' |translation='''Title:''' Severed Arm. '''Card text:''' Use when both sides have a character with a weapon at the same location. Deploy during either player's control phase. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_34o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊エコー基地の任務 |printed_game_text=少なくとも３つ以上のエコー基地の位置に自分側が滞在している場合に、メイン・パワー・ジェネレーターに配備する。全ての星系ロケーションで、自分は配備コスト－１、フォース消耗に＋２、戦闘時の合計戦闘力に＋２となる。エフェクトは敵がホスの位置５箇所に滞在した場合にキャンセルされる。「意識操作」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Echo-Base-Operations-PSA-152940006.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ヤヴィンの戦い以降、同盟軍は帝国に反旗を翻そうとする星系からの援助を受けるようになった。エコー基地はそれらの援助を効率的に運用するための司令基地となっている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Echo Base operations. '''Card text:''' Deploy on Main Power Generators if you occupy at least three Echo sites. At every system location, your deploy cost is -1, your Force drains are +2, and your total power is +2 in battles. Canceled if the opponent occupies five Hoth sites. Not affected by Alter. '''Lore:''' After the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance began to receive aid from systems ready to rise against the Empire. Echo Base is the command base that puts that aid to efficient use. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese adds total power +2 in battles; the English adds +3. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Echo Base Operations]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

(V)]] (1240_81) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=脱出せよ！ |printed_game_text=1フォースを使用して、任意の宇宙戦闘機から専属パイロットの強制的な射出排除をこころみる。運命数を引き、運命数＞2なら、宇宙戦闘機上に配備して専属パイロットを取り除く。その戦闘機はパイロットを1名加えられるようになる。戦闘機はパイロットが乗っていないと戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使用することができない。このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Eject-Eject-SWCA-67701.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ガイデンハウザー射出座席は、爆発する宇宙戦闘機から無数のパイロットたちを救い出してきた。しかしながら、装置の故障によって突然パイロットが放り出されてしまう場合もある。'' |translation='''Title:''' Eject! '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to attempt to force-eject a permanent pilot from any starfighter. Draw destiny. If destiny > 2, deploy on the starfighter and remove the permanent pilot. That starfighter may now add 1 pilot. A starfighter with no pilot aboard may not use power, maneuver, or hyperspeed. This Effect is not affected by 'Mind Manipulation'. '''Lore:''' The Guidenhauser ejection seat has saved countless pilots from exploding starfighters. Even so, a fault in the gear has sometimes thrown a pilot out without warning. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses 意識操作 for Alter. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Eject! Eject!]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101.
