'''PC Errata''' — [[Elis Helrot (PC Errata)]] (1_243) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=エリス・ヘルロット |printed_game_text=１つの位置にいるキャラクターを、他の位置に移動させることができる（その位置にいるキャラクターなら、何名でも可）。運命数を引いて、エリスが要求した価格を決定する。運命数と同じだけのフォースを消費すれば、輸送してくれる。フォースを消費しなければ、エリスは消える（ロストする）。 |printed_lore=''ギヴィン人のパイロット。宇宙空間の真空にも耐えられるよう体関節を密封できる。スパイスと奴隷をカラウーンへと送る。彼の宇宙船ヒンスラには、特別な改造が施してある。'' |translation='''Title:''' Elis Helrot. '''Card text:''' You may move characters at one location to another location; any number of characters at that location may go. Draw destiny to determine the price Elis asks. If you use that much Force, he transports them. If you do not use the Force, Elis disappears and is lost. '''Lore:''' A Givin pilot who can seal his body joints to withstand the vacuum of space. He transports spice and enslaved people to Kala'uun. His ship, the Hinthra, has special modifications. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to characters at one location moving to another location; the English specifies your characters and sites. The Japanese says Elis is lost if the Force is not spent; the English describes the player declining transport. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Elis Helrot]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=151s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 2:31. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_49o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=エローズ・マダック |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。１：ドロイドを除く、パイロットでないキャラクターに配備し、パイロット技能［パイロットアイコン］を与える。そのキャラクターが操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力は＋２される。２：パイロットに配備し、キャラクターが操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力にさらに＋１する。（「意識操作」の影響を受けない）[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-49o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''デュロスの常として、マダックも生まれつき操縦、航法術の腕ききだ。昔は偵察員で今はフリーの操縦コーチ。セラノン、バイブローズ、ヤガ・マイナーといった要所を駆けめぐる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Ellorrs Madak. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Deploy on a non-pilot character other than a droid and give that character pilot skill. A starship that character pilots is power +2. 2. Deploy on a pilot and add a further 1 to the power of a starship the character pilots. Immune to Alter. '''Lore:''' Like other Duros, Madak is a natural at piloting and navigation. Formerly a scout, he is now a freelance flight instructor who travels between places such as Seranon, Byblos, and Yaga Minor. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Ellorrs Madak]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Emergency Deployment (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Emergency Deployment |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-244o-Face.jpg |lead='''Emergency Deployment''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_244o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Emergency Deployment]] (1_244o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_244o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=緊急発進 |printed_game_text=敵が、こちらの２倍より大きな戦闘力を持つ場所で戦闘を宣言した時に使う。リザーブデッキからカードを３枚まで引ける。引いたカードが、キャラクター、宇宙船、ビークル、アイテム、武器であれば、コストなしで好きなところに配備する。それ以外のカードの場合、ロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-244o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''タイ・ファイターは、通常はハンガー・デッキの巨大なラックに停泊している。強力なトラクター・ビームで宇宙空間に放出され、素早く展開、交戦できるのだ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Emergency Launch. '''Card text:''' Use when the opponent initiates a battle at a location where their power is more than twice yours. You may draw up to three cards from your Reserve Deck. Deploy any character, starship, vehicle, item, or weapon drawn wherever you choose at no cost. Other cards drawn are lost. '''Lore:''' TIE fighters normally dock in enormous racks on hangar decks. Powerful tractor beams launch them into space so they can deploy and engage quickly. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Emergency Deployment]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

{{Card |title=Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon |side=Dark |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Starship Weapon]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Enhanced-TIE-Laser-Cannon-PSA-159081599.jpg |lead='''Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Starship Weapon]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_158o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon]] (2_158o)
'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon (Revised)]] (52_158)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_158o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon (Errata)]] (2_158)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Black 6]] (202_14) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=改良型タイ・レーザー・キャノン |printed_game_text=1フォース消費してTIEに配備する。大型艦は、（運命数－2）＞装甲値ならば命中。宇宙戦闘機は、運命数＞回避値ならば命中する。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Enhanced-TIE-Laser-Cannon-PSA-159081599.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''サイナー・フリート・システムズの最新試作型レーザー・キャノン。帝国軍タイのほぼ全機種に装備が可能で、戦闘力を向上させるが、モフたちの多くは、大量配備するには費用がかかりすぎると考えている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Improved TIE laser cannon. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on a TIE. A capital is hit if (destiny − 2) > armor. A starfighter is hit if destiny > maneuver. '''Lore:''' Sienar Fleet Systems' latest prototype laser cannon. It can be fitted on almost every Imperial TIE and raises firepower, but many Moffs think it costs too much for mass deployment. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 改良型タイ・レーザー・キャノン (improved TIE laser cannon). |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: Escape Pod (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Escape Pod |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-79o-Video.jpg |lead='''Escape Pod''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_79o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=6 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Escape Pod]] (1_79o)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[Escape Pod (Unlimited)]] (51_79)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_79o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Escape Pod (PC Errata)]] (1_79) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=脱出ポッド |printed_game_text=大型艦がロストした際に使う。大型艦に乗っていた全キャラクター、武器、デバイスは、ロストしない。それらは、好きな惑星上の位置か自分の大型艦に、置きなおす。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-79o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''大型艦には、緊急脱出ポッドが搭載されている。水、食料、照明弾、医療品、狩猟用ブラスター、救助ビーコンを装備。Ｒ２－Ｄ２は、脱出の際、ビーコンを止めた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Escape Pod. '''Card text:''' Use when a capital starship is lost. All characters, weapons, and devices that were aboard are not lost. Relocate them to any planet site or to one of your capital starships. '''Lore:''' Capital starships carry emergency escape pods, stocked with water, food, flares, medical supplies, a hunting blaster, and a rescue beacon. R2-D2 shut the beacon off during the escape. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese relocates them to a planet site or your capital starship; the English relocates them to any planet site. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Escape Pod]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Evacuate? (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Evacuate? |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] — [[Used Interrupt]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Evacuate-video.png |lead='''Evacuate?''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_245o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |destiny=6 |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Evacuate?]] (1_245o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing'''
'''PC Errata''' — [[Evacuate? (PC Errata)]] (1_245) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=退避なされますか？ |printed_game_text=ターキンが乗船していない場合に使える。ロストしたばかりの大型艦に乗っていた全キャラクター、武器、アイテムは、脱出する（ロストしない）。それらは、好きな惑星上の位置か、自分の大型艦に置きなおす。 |printed_lore=''脱出ポッドは、大半の宇宙船に搭載されている。しかし帝国軍将校にとって、脱出は臆病な行為とされている。「敵の攻撃を分析した結果、極めて危険であると判断いたしました。」'' |translation='''Title:''' Will you evacuate? '''Card text:''' May be used if Tarkin is not aboard. All characters, weapons and items aboard a capital starship that was just lost escape and are not lost. Place them at any location on a planet or aboard one of your capital starships. '''Lore:''' Escape pods are carried aboard most starships, but Imperial officers regard escape as a cowardly act. “After analyzing the enemy's attack, we have determined that the danger is extreme.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to items and a location on a planet; the English uses devices and one planet site. The Japanese quotation says the danger is extreme, while the English quotation says there is a danger. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Evacuate?]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=159s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 2:39. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Evacuate-video.png|Preserved card frame]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Legacy Errata 2''' — [[Evacuation Control (V) (Errata 2)]] (1220_121) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=脱出管制 |printed_game_text=自分の戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所に配備する。1ターンに1回、同じ惑星にある自分の「惑星防衛用イオン砲」を自分の移動フェイズに起動できる。加えて、同じ惑星の自分の中型輸送艇はそれぞれ航行速度＋2、耐：損耗＜3となり、フォースを消費せずに移動できる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Evacuation-Control-PSA-89232355.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「全軍に撤退指令を出して……あなたも早く輸送艇に乗りなさい！」'' |translation='''Title:''' Evacuation Control. '''Card text:''' Deploy on your strategic command room or battle command post. Once per turn, your Planet Defender Ion Cannon at the same planet may fire during your move phase. Each of your medium transports at the same planet is hyperspeed +2 and immune to attrition less than 3. They may move without spending Force. '''Lore:''' Issue the withdrawal order to all forces… and you get on a transport quickly too! '''Comparison with the English printing:''' War rooms print as 戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Evacuation Control]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. But I can't leave a friend to die." |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Exhaustion]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. text:
{{Card |title=Expand The Empire |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-215o-Face.jpg |lead='''Expand The Empire''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_215o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Expand The Empire]] (1_215)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_215o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=帝国の拡大 |printed_game_text=任意の位置に配備する。その位置の帝国側のカードルールを、隣接位置のカードルールにも“拡大”してつけ加えることができる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-215o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''皇帝は、帝国議会を“緊急事態の続く間”解散してしまい、絶対的な力を手にした。次のステップは、各惑星を恐怖で屈服させ、その権力を認めさせることである。'' |translation='''Title:''' Expansion of the Empire. His next step was to subjugate the planets through fear and force them to recognize his authority. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Expand The Empire]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. '''Virtual Modern''' — [[Eyes In The Dark (V)]] (223_37) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=闇に光る眼[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Eyes-In-The-Dark-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=いずれかのプレイヤーのロストデッキの隣に配備する。そのデッキは裏向きにされる。そのプレイヤーのライフフォースからロストされたカードは、伏せたままロストデッキに置く。 |printed_lore=「あまり見通しがよくないですね。」 |translation='''Title:''' Eyes Shining in the Dark. '''Card text:''' Deploy beside either player's Lost Pile. That pile is turned face down. Cards lost from that player's Life Force are placed face down in the Lost Pile. '''Lore:''' “The outlook isn't very good, is it?” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese instructs that lost Life Force cards be placed face down in the Lost Pile. '''Card text:''' To start a battle at Trevagg's location, a player must use X Force, where X is the number of dark-side and light-side Force icons there. If a droid is there, this rule does not apply. '''Lore:''' A corrupt male Gotal tax collector and bounty hunter who pursued the bounty on Obi-Wan. He can sense emissions to track droids. He is in love with M'iiyoom Onith. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says he can track droids by sensing emissions, while the English says his ability to sense droid emanations is limited. The Japanese says he is in love with M'iiyoom Onith; the English says he romanced her. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Feltipern Trevagg]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=166s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 2:46. {{Card |title=Fire Extinguisher |side=Light |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Fire-Extinguisher-PSA-161939296.jpg |lead='''Fire Extinguisher''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_25o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Fire Extinguisher]] (2_25o)
'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Fire Extinguisher (Revised)]] (52_25)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_25o), [[A New Hope (Japanese)]], September 1997
'''PC Errata''' — [[Fire Extinguisher (PC Errata)]]
'''PC Errata 2''' — [[Fire Extinguisher (PC Errata 2)]] (2_25) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=消火装置 |printed_game_text=操縦ドロイドに配備する。配備されている場所で、「予期せぬ損傷」、爆発する「プログラム・トラップ」、またはイオン砲の効果をキャンセルできる。R2－D2に配備されたなら、配備された位置カード上での戦闘をキャンセルできるが、その後「消火装置」はロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Fire-Extinguisher-PSA-161939296.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''R2ユニットのようなドロイドの特殊装備の1つとして、気体噴霧式の消火装置があげられる。電子装置が火を吹いた場合以外にも、戦闘中に相手の目をくらます用途にも使用できる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Fire-extinguishing device. '''Card text:''' Deploy on an astromech droid. At the location where it is deployed, it may cancel Lateral Damage, an exploding Program Trap, or the effect of an ion cannon. If deployed on R2-D2, it may cancel a battle at that location card, after which Fire Extinguisher is lost. '''Lore:''' Among the special equipment of droids such as R2 units is a gas-spray fire extinguisher. Besides when electronic gear catches fire, it can also be used to blind the opponent during battle. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese R2-D2 may cancel a battle at that location card. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Fire Extinguisher]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

text:

'''Decipher (Two-Player) (Unlimited)''' — [[Friendly Fire (Premiere Two-Player) (Unlimited)]] (71_80 51_80)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1371_80o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Friendly Fire (Japanese)]] (1301_80o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=同士討ち |printed_game_text=相手のキャラクターが2名以上、武器が1つ以上ある位置で戦闘が起きた場合に使う。運命数を引く。運命数＜（その位置の相手のキャラクターの数）ならば、キャラクターの1名がロストする（相手が選ぶ）。Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-80o-Video.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Friendly Fire (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Friendly-Fire-C1G.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]]. |printed_lore=''狭い場所で多くの銃を乱射すれば、当然、仲間を撃つ可能性も出てくる。だがストームトルーパーは、勝利を得るためには、同士討ちすらいとわない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Friendly fire. '''Card text:''' Use at a battle where the opponent has at least two characters and one weapon. Draw destiny. If destiny < the number of the opponent's characters there, one is lost (opponent's choice). '''Lore:''' Firing many guns in a tight space can hit one's own. Stormtroopers still accept friendly fire if it wins the fight. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Friendly Fire]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Frozen Dinner (V)]] (1240_24) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=冷凍ディナー |printed_game_text=ワンパの雪洞に単独でいる任意のキャラクターに配備する。キャラクターは戦闘力＝０、移動不可となる。その場所に敵のライトセーバーか合計能力値＞４があるとキャンセルされる。キャラクターが生物に食べられたなら、凶暴性に２を加える（累積可能）。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Frozen-Dinner-PSA-147361096.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''フリーズ・ドライですぐに食べられ、味も抜群！ 反乱軍の野郎ども全員を食糧にすれば、ワンパー族全体をまかなえる。人間はガウゥゥゥ、ウ、マ、イ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Frozen dinner. Humans are gr-r-reat. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Frozen Dinner]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. text:
{{Card |title=Full Scale Alert |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-246o-Face.jpg |lead='''Full Scale Alert''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_246o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Full Scale Alert]] (1_246o)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[Full Scale Alert (Unlimited)]] (51_246)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_246o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Full Scale Alert (Errata)]] (1_246) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=厳戒態勢 |printed_game_text=２フォース消費して、運命数を引く。運命数＜場のストームトルーパーの数ならば、このターンが終わるまで敵は移動できなくなる。ただし、密輸屋と彼らの乗っている宇宙船だけは、普通に移動できる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-246o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国のストームトルーパーによる保安態勢は極めて厳重だ。発達した通信網と圧倒的な数の優位によって、反乱軍の帝国領内への移動を抑えこむ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Full Alert. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force and draw destiny. If destiny is less than the number of stormtroopers on table, the opponent cannot move until the end of the turn. Smugglers and the starships they are aboard may still move normally. '''Lore:''' Imperial stormtroopers maintain exceptionally tight security. Advanced communications and overwhelming numbers suppress Rebel movement within Imperial territory. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Full Scale Alert]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Full Throttle |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-81o-Video.jpg |lead='''Full Throttle''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_81o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Full Throttle]] (1_81o)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[Full Throttle (Unlimited)]] (51_81)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_81o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Full Throttle (Errata)]] (1_81) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=フル・スロットル |printed_game_text=パイロット（または専属パイロット）が、単独で星系を防御している場合、戦闘運命数を1枚引いて足す。防御しているのがルークならば、戦闘運命数を1枚引いた上に、戦闘力を＋１できる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-81o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''反乱軍パイロットは、肉眼で状況を判断してセンサーの不備を補う。数で勝る帝国軍に対抗するには、自分の五感こそが頼みの綱なのだ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Full Throttle. '''Card text:''' If a pilot (or permanent pilot) is defending a system alone, add one battle destiny. If that defender is Luke, add one battle destiny and power +1. '''Lore:''' Rebel pilots use the naked eye to make up for incomplete sensors. Against Imperial numbers, their own senses are what they rely on. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese adds power +1 when the lone defender is Luke; the English presents the Luke bonus as a separate OR. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Full Throttle]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Dark) (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Fusion Generator Supply Tanks |side=Dark |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-203o-SWCA.jpg |lead='''Fusion Generator Supply Tanks''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_203o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Dark)|Fusion Generator Supply Tanks]] (1_203o)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Dark) (Unlimited)]] (51_203)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_203o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Dark) (PC Errata)]] (1_203) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=融合ジェネレーター供給タンク |printed_game_text=対応するドッキング・ベイの位置カードが場に出ている星系カードの宇宙船に配備する。航行速度＋１、戦闘力＋１、回避値＋１となる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-203o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''宇宙艦船にパワーを供給するため、帝国内の多くの補給基地に設置されている。亜光速航行やハイパースペース航行に不可欠なエネルギーを供給する。'' |translation='''Title:''' Fusion Generator Supply Tanks. '''Card text:''' Deploy on a starship at a system whose corresponding docking bay site is on table. The starship is hyperspeed, power, and maneuver +1. '''Lore:''' Installed at many Imperial supply bases to power starships. They supply energy essential for sublight and hyperspace travel. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1371_315o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Gaderffii Stick (PC Errata)]] (1_315) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ガダフィの杖 |printed_game_text=２フォース消費して、タスケン・レイダーに配備する。起動にフォースを必要としない。その場で戦闘が始まった場合、即座に運命数を２枚引く。２枚の運命数の合計＞５ならば、敵は武器を“はじき飛ばされて”、この戦闘では使えなくなる。Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-PSA-14-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Gaderffii Stick (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Gaderffii-Stick-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]]. |printed_lore=''“ガッフィ”とも呼ばれる、タスケン・レイダーの好む武器。廃棄された金属などで作られる。相手を脅し、恐怖させるに十分な武器である。'' |translation='''Title:''' Gaderffii staff. '''Card text:''' Spend 2 Force to deploy on a Tusken Raider. No Force is required to activate it. If a battle begins there, immediately draw two destiny. If their total is greater than 5, the enemy's weapons are ‘knocked away’ and cannot be used in this battle. '''Lore:''' A weapon favored by Tusken Raiders, also called a ‘gaffi.’ Made from discarded metal and similar materials, it is sufficient to threaten and frighten an opponent. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says activating it requires no Force; the English says it may target for free. The Japanese describes a battle beginning there, while the English says a battle has just been initiated where the weapon is present. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Gaderffii Stick]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_8o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Garouf Lafoe (Errata)]] (2_8) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊ガルーフ・ラフォー |printed_game_text=操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に1を加える。タトゥイーンの同じ位置カード上にいる自分のすべてのキャラクターは没収値＋1となる。ホスの同じ位置カード上にいる相手のキャラクターはすべて没収値－1となる。徴税人と同じ位置カードにいる場合にはゲームルールを使用できない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Garouf-Lafoe-PSA-164793238.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''自由商人で、タトゥ星系の外星星、オーハンとエイドリアーナの環で採れる氷塊を輸出している。扱うものが氷だけに、帝国に税と賄賂をしぼり取られて、商売の方もお寒い状態が続いている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Garouf Lafoe. '''Card text:''' Adds 1 to the power of a starship he pilots. All of your characters at the same Tatooine location card are forfeit +1. All opponent's characters at the same Hoth location card are forfeit -1. May not use game text if at the same location card as a tax collector. '''Lore:''' A free trader who exports ice chunks from the rings of Ohann and Adriana, outer planets of the Tatoo system. Because ice is all he handles, Imperial taxes and bribes squeeze him, and business stays cold. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Garouf Lafoe]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. A former civilian tactician who advised the House of Organa. The leader of Echo Base, who warns against optimism. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[General Carlist Rieekan]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Card text:''' Rebel Planners is doubled if he is at the same site, otherwise +1. May cancel Wrong Turn. Each Rebel present with him at a Yavin 4 site is power +1. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 行き止まり for Wrong Turn. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[General Dodonna]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. text:
{{Card |title=Ghhhk |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Ghhhk-PSA-163714651.jpg |lead='''Ghhhk''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_132o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=1 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Ghhhk]] (2_132o)
'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Ghhhk (Revised)]] (52_132)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_132o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Ghhhk (PC Errata)]] (2_132) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ギック |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：戦闘に敗北した直後、すべてのカードを没収してさらにダメージが残っている場合に使用する。残りの戦闘ダメージをすべてキャンセルする。このインタラプトは「感知」の影響を受けない。2：「夕暮れ」をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Ghhhk-PSA-163714651.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''デジャリックのホログラムに登場するクラクドアVIIの生物。ギックは日没とともに目覚め、求愛の叫びをあげながらジャングルを徘徊する。地元では皮膚の油分を傷薬として使う。'' |translation='''Title:''' Ghhhk. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Use immediately after losing a battle, if damage still remains after forfeiting all cards. Cancel all remaining battle damage. This Interrupt is not affected by Sense. 2: Cancel Nightfall. '''Lore:''' A creature of Clak'dor VII that appears in Dejarik holograms. Ghhhk wakes at sunset and wanders the jungle while giving mating cries. Locals use the oil of its skin as a wound medicine. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is ギック. The Japanese numbers the two options. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Ghhhk]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: Gift Of The Mentor (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Gift Of The Mentor |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-82o-Video.jpg |lead='''Gift Of The Mentor''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_82o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Gift Of The Mentor]] (1_82)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[Gift Of The Mentor (Unlimited)]] (51_82)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_82o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=師の導き |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：ルークと、オビ＝ワンかヨーダが一緒に戦闘に参加した際に使う。戦闘運命数を2枚引いて足す。2：1フォース消費してリザーブデッキを探し、ライトセーバーのカードを1枚手札に加える。デッキはシャッフルしてカットすること。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-82o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ルークは、オビ＝ワンの知識と導きにより、フォースについて学んだ。年老いたジェダイは、肉体の消滅後もルークを導き続けた。'' |translation='''Title:''' The mentor's guidance. '''Card text:''' Choose one. If Luke and Obi-Wan or Yoda are in a battle together, add two battle destiny. Use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one lightsaber into hand. Shuffle and cut the deck. '''Lore:''' Luke learned the Force from Obi-Wan's knowledge and guidance. The old Jedi kept guiding Luke after the body was gone. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Gift Of The Mentor]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Golan Laser Battery (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Golan Laser Battery |side=Light |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Artillery Weapon]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Golan-Laser-Battery-PSA-160326801.jpg |lead='''Golan Laser Battery''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Artillery Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_75o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |deploy=3 |forfeit=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Golan Laser Battery]] (3_75o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_75o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Golan Laser Battery (Errata)]] (3_75) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ゴラン・レーザー砲塔 |printed_game_text=屋外の惑星位置に配備する。移動不可。同じ場所にいる自分の戦士が、２フォース消費して同じか隣接する位置にいる目標に対して起動できる。運命数を引く。ビークルには運命数＞回避値で命中する。キャラクターには運命数＋１＞能力値で命中する。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Golan-Laser-Battery-PSA-160326801.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ゴラン・アームズＤＦ．９対人砲塔の改造型。制御装置を擁する円形の塔はプロトン・シールドで守られており、その上部に旋回するレーザー砲塔が１門以上付いている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Golan laser turret. '''Card text:''' Deploy on an exterior planet site. Cannot be moved. Your warrior at the same location may fire at a target at the same or an adjacent location, using 2 Force. Draw destiny. A vehicle is hit if destiny > maneuver. A character is hit if destiny +1 > ability. '''Lore:''' A modified Golan Arms DF.9 anti-personnel turret. The round tower that holds the controls is proton-shielded, and one or more rotating laser turrets sit on top. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese hits vehicles on destiny > maneuver and characters on destiny +1 > ability; the English uses armor or maneuver, and destiny +2. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Golan Laser Battery]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

At Renforra Base the same ship was Specter 1. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Gold 1]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Gold 2 (Errata)]] (2_69) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊ゴールド2 |printed_game_text=パイロットと乗客を合計2名まで追加できる。「デス・スター：トレンチ」で命中を受けた他の宇宙戦闘機のかわりに没収することができる。パイロットなしでは戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使用できない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Gold-2-SWCA-67667.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''タイリーがヤヴィンの戦いで搭乗したYウイング。カスタム装備の側面スラスターが運動性能を向上させている。このためゴールド2は相手の砲火をかいくぐるのが得意だ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Gold 2. May not use power, maneuver, or hyperspeed without a pilot. '''Lore:''' The Y-wing Tiree flew at the Battle of Yavin. Custom side thrusters improve its handling, so Gold 2 is good at slipping through enemy fire. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Gold 2]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. title: Grand Moff Tarkin (Japanese Reflections III Foil)
text:
{{Card |title=Grand Moff Tarkin |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] |set=Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty |set_display=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |language=ja |language_display=Japanese |label_language=Printed language |navigation=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |image=Japanese-Grand-Moff-Tarkin-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg |lead='''Grand Moff Tarkin''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]]. |rarity=VR |rarity_display=[[Rarity|VR]] |destiny=1 |power=4 |ability=3 |deploy=4 |forfeit=6 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Grand Moff Tarkin]] (1_179o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Grand Moff Tarkin (Japanese)]] (1301_179o), [[Premiere (Japanese)]], April 1997
'''Decipher (Japanese Reflections III foil)''' — '''this printing'''
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Grand Moff Tarkin (Errata)]] (1_179) |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=FinishFoil |printed_title=グランドモフ・ターキン |printed_game_text=ベイダーと同じ戦闘に参加していれば、敵が運命数を求めて見せた後で、1枚だけキャンセルすることができる。彼が操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋2になる。 |printed_lore=''リーダー。アウターリムの統治者。デス・スター司令官。帝国元老院の解散に功があった。恐怖統治の原則を打ち立てたデス・スターを、皇帝への謀反に使おうと画策していた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Grand Moff Tarkin. '''Card text:''' If participating in the same battle as Vader, may cancel just one card after the enemy reveals it to determine destiny. A starship he pilots gets power +2. '''Lore:''' Leader. Governor of the Outer Rim. Death Star commander. Played a part in dissolving the Imperial Senate. He was plotting to use the Death Star, which established the principle of rule through fear, in a rebellion against the Emperor. |notes='''Grand Moff Tarkin (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Grand Moff Tarkin|Grand Moff Tarkin]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Grand Moff Tarkin (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R12 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[[:File:Japanese-Grand-Moff-Tarkin-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins. |see_also=* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese foils|Japanese foils]] |see_also_heading=See Also |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Grappling Hook |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] ([[Immediate Effect]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Grappling-Hook-PSA-165173155.jpg |lead='''Grappling Hook''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] ([[Immediate Effect]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_33o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Grappling Hook]] (2_33o)

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Grappling Hook (V)]] (221_64) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=グラップリング・フック |printed_game_text=相手がインタラプトを使用した直後に、1フォースを使用して場に配備する。そのインタラプトは通常通りの効果を及ぼすが、その後で“引っかかる”（その場に置かれ、ゲームからは除外される）。同じ名前のインタラプトは今後すべて単一（＊）カードとなる。このエフェクトは「コントロール」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Grappling-Hook-PSA-165173155.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ストームトルーパー・ユーティリティ・ベルトには各種の道具類が入っている。グラップリング・フックは突起に引っかけて使うのが普通だが、逃亡する目標をからめ取ることもできる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Grappling hook. '''Card text:''' Just after the opponent plays an Interrupt, use 1 Force to deploy on table. That Interrupt still has its normal effect, but is then “hooked” (placed here and placed out of play). All Interrupts of the same name are thereafter unique (*) cards. This Effect is not affected by Control. '''Lore:''' Stormtrooper utility belts hold various tools. A grappling hook is usually hooked onto a protrusion, but it can also snare a fleeing target. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Grappling Hook]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Card text:''' Use at Dune Sea, Jundland Wastes, Beggar's Canyon, Lars' Moisture Farm, Jawa Camp or Mos Eisley. Target an opponent's character. Strong winds can lift even stones into the air. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore describes sandstorms and says they can arise without warning; the English says storms strike with little or no warning. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Gravel Storm]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=188s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:08. '''Virtual Modern''' — [[Greedo (V)]] (204_42) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊グリード |printed_game_text=敵の支配フェイズに、同じ位置にいる密輸屋を一人選んで“脅かす”ことができる。敵がフォース・デッキのフォースをすべて消費すれば、この効果はキャンセルされ、自分は同量のフォースを即座に起動する。さもなくば、運命数を引く。運命数＋グリードの能力値＞6なら、密輸屋はロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Greedo-PSA-135901774.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ローディアン男性のバウンティ・ハンター。ジャバの使いでハンを捕えに来た。横柄で自信過剰な態度から、頭の弱さも見てとれる。賞金稼ぎを師事したディズ・ナタズやスパーチ・ゴアからも裏切られ、同族スークーに売り渡されていた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Greedo. '''Card text:''' During the opponent's control phase, you may choose one smuggler at the same location and “threaten” them. If the opponent uses all Force in the Force Deck, this effect is canceled and you immediately activate the same amount of Force. Otherwise, draw destiny. If destiny + Greedo's ability > 6, the smuggler is lost. '''Lore:''' A male Rodian bounty hunter. He came on Jabba's errand to capture Han. His arrogant, overconfident manner also shows a weak mind. Betrayed by the bounty hunters he trained under, Diz Nataz and Spurch Goa, he had been sold to his fellow Thuku. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses フォース・デッキ for Force Pile. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Greedo]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Grimtaash (Errata)]] (2_49) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊グリンタッシュ |printed_game_text=ユーズド：相手が手札を13枚以上持っている時に使用する。8枚（ランダムに選ぶ）を除いてすべてをユーズドデッキに移す。 ロスト：どちらかを選ぶ。1：「モレイトア」をキャンセルする。2：4フォース使用して、相手の手札を公開させる。相手が同じカードを2枚以上持っていたなら、それらはすべてロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Grimtaash-PSA-160117590.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''デジャリックに登場する伝説のモレイトアの守護者。グリンタッシュの魂はオルデランの有力者たちを腐敗や裏切りから護ると伝えられている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Grimtaash. '''Card text:''' USED: Use when the opponent has 13 or more cards in hand. Move all but 8 (chosen at random) to the Used Deck. LOST: Choose one. 1: Cancel Monnok. 2: Use 4 Force to reveal the opponent's hand. If the opponent had two or more of the same card, they are all lost. '''Lore:''' A legendary guardian of Monnok who appears in Dejarik. Grimtaash's spirit protects Alderaan's powerful people from corruption and betrayal. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese Lost text numbers the two options. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Grimtaash]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. {{Card |title=Han Seeker |side=Dark |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] — [[Automated Weapon]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Han-Seeker-video.png |lead='''Han Seeker''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Automated Weapon]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_316o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |destiny=3 |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Han Seeker]] (1_316o)

'''Virtual Original''' — [[Han Seeker (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour)]] (1102_34)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Han Seeker (V)]] (1210_84) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ハン・シーカー |printed_game_text=１フォース消費して、相手側に配備する。ただし、未踏査の位置カードに限る。自分の支配フェイズに、キャラクターと同様にフォースを消費して移動させることができる。ハン・ソロまたは能力値＜３のエイリアンと同じロケーションについたら、そのうち１枚を選んで、ロストさせる。ハン・シーカーもロストする。 |printed_lore=''軍用リモート。特定の個人や、条件を指定しての追跡をプログラムされている。熱光学センサーできわめて正確に対象を追跡する。宇宙船に潜り込ませることもできる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Han Seeker. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on the opponent's side, limited to an unexplored location card. During your control phase, it may move like a character by using Force. When it reaches the same location as Han Solo or an alien with ability less than 3, choose one of them to be lost. Han Seeker is also lost. '''Lore:''' A military remote programmed to track specified individuals or targets meeting specified conditions. Heat and optical sensors track targets with great accuracy. It can also be smuggled aboard a starship. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese describes an unexplored location card for deployment, while the English specifies an unoccupied site. The Japanese names Han Solo; the English says Han. The English explicitly says the chosen target is immediately lost, while the Japanese does not specify immediately. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Han Seeker]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=192s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Han-Seeker-video.png|Preserved card frame]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Card text:''' Once per battle, you may use 1 Force to cancel a destiny just drawn and draw again. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If it is the Millennium Falcon, also add 2 to maneuver and draw one battle destiny if none can otherwise be drawn. '''Lore:''' A smuggler, gambler, and Rebel hero. A skilled Corellian pilot and owner of the Millennium Falcon. His co-pilot Chewbacca owes him a life debt. There is a bounty on his head. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Help-Me-Obi-Wan-Kenobi-7cf786442c8d.jpeg |lead='''Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_86o |label_gemp_id=GEMP ID |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi]] (1_86)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (Unlimited)]] (51_86)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing'''
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (Errata)]]
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (V)]]
'''Virtual Modern Errata''' — [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) (Errata)]] (207_12; current full face)
'''Virtual Modern Errata 2''' — [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) (Errata 2)]] (bottom-only slip; September 2023 edition) |label_versions=Versions |destiny=3[[:File:Japanese-Help-Me-Obi-Wan-Kenobi-7cf786442c8d.jpeg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_title=助けて下さい、オビ＝ワン・ケノービ |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分の支配する位置にオビ＝ワンがいる時に使う。このターンの間、オビ＝ワンの能力値を好きなだけ減らし、減らした分を、任意のロケーションでの戦闘の合計能力値に足せる。2：戦闘が起こった際、隣接した位置に反乱軍がいれば、1名選んで、リアクションとして戦闘が始まった位置に移動できる。 |printed_lore=''レイアは要請をホログラムに託した。「ケノービ将軍、かつてクローン大戦の際、あなたは我が父に仕えてくださいました。帝国軍と戦うため、再びあなたの力が必要なのです。」'' |translation='''Title:''' Help me, Obi-Wan Kenobi. '''Lore:''' Leia entrusted her request to a hologram. ‘General Kenobi, during the Clone Wars you served my father. To fight the Imperial forces, your help is needed again.’ '''Game text:''' Choose one. 1: Use when Obi-Wan is at a location you control. For this turn, you may reduce Obi-Wan's ability by any amount and add the amount reduced to the total ability in battle at any location. 2: When a battle occurs, if a Rebel is at an adjacent location, choose one and move that person as a reaction to the location where the battle began. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English lore says Leia's father asks Kenobi for help in his struggle; the Japanese says help is needed again to fight the Imperial forces. The English game text refers to a site you control, applying ability toward drawing battle destiny at another location, and ability used this way not being usable again that turn. The Japanese text instead refers to a controlled location, adding the reduction to total ability in battle at any location, and does not state the same restriction. The English second option specifies an adjacent battle site; the Japanese uses location. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p.41. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |see_also=* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese|Japanese publications]] |see_also_heading=See Also |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Hem Dazon (V)]] (1210_12) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ヘム・デイゾン |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズに、手札かフォース・デッキからカードを1枚、ヘムの下に伏せて置くことができる。これは“塩の摂取量”を表わす。ヘムがロストした時には、その下にあるカードもロストする。＊戦闘力＝1＋下に置かれたカードの枚数。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Hem-Dazon-PSA-89673865.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''コーナから来た男性の偵察兵。多くのアルコーナ同様、ヘムもまた塩の誘惑に負け、中毒症状に陥って瞳が金色になってしまった。'' |translation='''Title:''' Hem Dazon. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, you may place one card from hand or Force Deck face down under Hem. This represents salt consumption. When Hem is lost, the cards under him are also lost. Power equals 1 plus the number of cards placed underneath. '''Lore:''' A male scout from Cona. Like many Arcona, Hem succumbed to salt, became addicted, and his pupils turned gold. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title transliterates Dazon as デイゾン. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Hem Dazon]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. The Ranat Reegesk snatched the power pack from Het's blaster at the last moment. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Het Nkik]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''PC Errata 2''' — [[Houjix (PC Errata 2)]] (2_50) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=フージックス |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。１：戦闘終了時に、そのロケーションに配備されていたカードをすべて没収して、なおかつダメージが残っていた場合、残ったダメージをすべてキャンセルする。このインタラプトは「感知」の影響を受けない。２：「日没」をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Houjix-SWCA-100665.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''デジャリックに登場するホログラム・クリーチャー。凶暴な外見をした獣だが、性質はおとなしく、飼い主に忠実である。グランの出身星キニヤンではしばしば番犬がわりやペットとして飼われている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Houjix. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: At the end of battle, forfeit all cards that were deployed at that location. If damage remains, cancel all remaining damage. This interrupt is not affected by Sense. 2: Cancel Sunsdown. '''Lore:''' A hologram creature that appears in dejarik. The beast looks ferocious but is gentle and loyal to its owner. On Kinyen, homeworld of the Gran, they are often kept as watchdogs or pets. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese numbers the modes after どちらかを選ぶ and uses 戦闘終了時に plus forfeit-all as the first mode, not “if you just lost a battle and after. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Houjix]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''PC Errata 2''' — [[Houjix (PC Errata 2)]] (2_50) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=フージックス |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：戦闘終了時に、そのロケーションに配備されたカードをすべて没収して、なおかつダメージが残っていた場合、残ったダメージをすべてキャンセルする。このインタラプトは「感知」の影響を受けない。2：「日没」をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Houjix-SWCA-67704.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''デジャリックに登場するホログラム・クリーチャー。凶悪な外見をした獣だが、性質はおとなしく、飼い主に忠実である。グランの出身星キニエンではしばしば番犬がわりやペットとして飼われている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Houjix. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: At the end of a battle, if after forfeiting all cards deployed at that location damage still remains, cancel all remaining damage. This Interrupt is not affected by Sense. 2: Cancel Sunsdown. '''Lore:''' A hologram creature from dejarik. The beast looks fierce, but it is gentle and loyal to its owner. On Kinyen, the Gran homeworld, it is often kept as a watchdog or pet. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese cancels remaining damage at the end of a battle; the English only if you just lost. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Houjix]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. title: How Did We Get Into This Mess? (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=How Did We Get Into This Mess? |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-PSA-09-Face.jpg |lead='''How Did We Get Into This Mess?''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_87o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Premiere Limited''' (1995, black border) — [[How Did We Get Into This Mess?]]
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=一体全体どうして、こんな羽目になるのかね |printed_game_text=自分のドロイドが「大砂原」もしくは「アクセス・リンク」のある位置にいる時に使う。１フォース消費して、手札を全部ユーズドデッキに捨てる。同じ枚数のカードをリザーブデッキから引いて手札にする。ドロイドがＣ－３ＰＯかＲ２－Ｄ２ならば、引くカードの枚数に１枚足せる。 |printed_lore=''大砂原に不時着した後、Ｒ２－Ｄ２は人間の居住区のありそうな峡谷へ向かうと主張した。Ｃ－３ＰＯは、反対だった。'' |translation=
'''Title:''' How Did We Get Into This Mess? '''Card text:''' Use when your droid is at the ‘Great Desert’ or a location with an ‘access link.’ Spend 1 Force to discard your entire hand to the Used Pile. Draw the same number of cards from the Reserve Deck into your hand. If the droid is C-3PO or R2-D2, you may add one to the number of cards drawn. '''Lore:''' After making an emergency landing in the great desert, R2-D2 insisted on heading toward a canyon that would contain human settlements. C-3PO disagreed.
'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses ‘Great Desert’ for the location called the Dune Sea in English and ‘access link’ where the English says Scomp link. The Japanese says one card may be added to the draw if the droid is C-3PO or R2-D2; the English says to draw one extra card. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[How Did We Get Into This Mess?]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_10o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊ハンチバック |printed_game_text=相手が、ハンチのいるロケーションに隣接した位置でフォース消耗を宣言した直後に使用する。1フォースを使用し、相手のフォースデッキを見る。名前に“バック／帰還／背（中）”が含まれているカードを1枚選んでゲームから除外できる。その後フォースデッキはシャッフルし、カットしてもとの場所に置くこと。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Hunchback-PSA-156625020.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''どうしたんだ、その背中のコブ？'' |translation='''Title:''' Hunchback. '''Card text:''' Use immediately after the opponent declares a Force drain at a location adjacent to Hunch's location. Use 1 Force to look at opponent's Force Pile. You may choose one card whose name includes "back / return / spine (hump)" and place it out of play. Then shuffle and cut the Force Pile and return it. '''Lore:''' What's with that hump on your back? '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese looks for バック, 帰還, or 背（中） in the title; the English looks for back. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Hunchback]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: Hydroponics Station (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Hydroponics Station |side=Light |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-37o-Face.jpg |lead='''Hydroponics Station''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_37o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Hydroponics Station]] (1_37o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_37o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=水耕ステーション |printed_game_text=１フォース消費して、タトゥイーンの屋外の位置に配備する。フォースを起動する際、最初の１枚を直接手札にすることができる。場にヴァーポレーターがあれば、２枚目も手札に加えることができる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-37o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''非常に効率よく水を使い、野菜や果物を栽培する。地下式の場合もある。栽培したものは食用にするが、余ったら市場で売られることもある。'' |translation='''Title:''' Hydroponics Station. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy at an exterior location on Tatooine. When activating Force, you may take the first card directly into hand. If a Vaporator is on table, you may take the second card into hand as well. '''Lore:''' Uses water very efficiently to grow vegetables and fruit. Some stations are underground. The produce is grown for food, with any surplus sometimes sold at market. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Hydroponics Station]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Hyper Escape (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Hyper Escape |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-88o-Video.jpg |lead='''Hyper Escape''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_88o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Hyper Escape]] (1_88o)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[Hyper Escape (Unlimited)]] (51_88)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_88o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ハイパー・エスケープ |printed_game_text=星系で戦闘が宣言された時に使う。通常と同じフォースを消費して、自分の宇宙船を全部移動させることができれば、戦闘はキャンセルされる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-88o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「ハイパースペースへ突入しちまえば、安全だ。」ビーコンでも取り付けられていない限り、ハイパースペースに入った宇宙船を追跡する手段はない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Hyper Escape. '''Card text:''' Use when a battle is declared at a system. If you can move all of your starships away, using Force as usual, the battle is canceled. '''Lore:''' “We'll be safe enough once we jump to hyperspace.” Unless a beacon is planted, there is no way to track a starship that has entered hyperspace. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese cancels the battle if you can move all your starships away; the English cancels by moving them away. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Hyper Escape]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Hyperwave Scan |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Hyperwave-Scan-SWCA-67748.jpg |lead='''Hyperwave Scan''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_120o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Hyperwave Scan]] (2_120)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_120o)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_34)

'''Virtual Legacy Errata''' — [[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (2210_1037)
'''Virtual Legacy Errata 2''' — [[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 2)]] (2210_2037)
'''Virtual Legacy Errata 3''' — [[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]] (1210_37)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Hyperwave Scan (V)]] (221_22) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ハイパーウェーブ・スキャン |printed_game_text=場の自分の側に配備する。「探査部隊」が「感知」の影響を受けなくなる。敵が13枚以上の手札を持っている時に「探査部隊」を使用したなら、敵は通常の効果に加えて、手札の中の、カード名に「反乱軍」が含まれるすべてのカードをロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Hyperwave-Scan-SWCA-67748.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国軍は完全を期す場合、全スペクトル探知器、高感度エネルギーセンサー、クリスタル式重力場感知器、ハイパーウェーブ信号傍受装置等を総動員してスキャンを行う。'' |translation='''Title:''' Hyperwave Scan. '''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. Scanning Crew is no longer affected by Sense. If you use Scanning Crew when the opponent has 13 or more cards in hand, the opponent also loses every card in hand whose title contains Rebel. '''Lore:''' When the Empire wants a complete scan, it mobilizes full-spectrum detectors, high-sensitivity energy sensors, crystal gravfield sensors, hyperwave signal interceptors, and similar devices. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text names Scanning Crew 「探査部隊」 and Sense 「感知」, and loses hand cards whose title contains 「反乱軍」. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Hyperwave Scan]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: Hypo (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Hypo |side=Dark |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] ([[Item]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Hypo-PSA-97065196.jpg |lead='''Hypo''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] ([[Item]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_112o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Hypo]] (2_112o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_112o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Hypo (PC Errata)]] (2_112) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ハイポ |printed_game_text=ＩＴ－Ｏに配備する。自分の支配フェイズに捕虜と同じ位置にあれば、どちらかの効果を選ぶ。1：敵に、敵の手札について1つだけ、“はい”か“いいえ”で答えられる質問をする。敵は正直に答えるか、回答を拒否して1フォースを失う。2：フォース消耗を＋1する。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Hypo-PSA-97065196.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''バーヴォ6のような自白剤には、尋問への抵抗力を弱める効果がある。巨大な注射針を相手に向ける心理的効果は抜群で、尋問の効率も上がる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Hypo. '''Card text:''' Deploy on IT-O. If at the same location as a captive during your control phase, choose one effect. Ask your opponent one yes-or-no question about their hand. They must answer truthfully or refuse and lose 1 Force. Alternatively, increase the Force drain by 1. '''Lore:''' Truth drugs such as Bavo Six weaken resistance to questioning. Pointing an enormous needle at the subject adds psychological pressure and makes the interrogation more effective. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The original English strip reads Device. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Hypo]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing (V)]] (1200_2) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=信念への中傷は不愉快だ |printed_game_text=１フォース消費して、自分のダーク・ジェダイに配備する。その場に敵ジェダイがいないならば、敵の能力値の合計は－２される。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-217o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ダース・ベイダーは、自分の気分を害した者を、敵味方の区別をつけず、フォースを使って容赦なく打ち倒す。指一本触れないで、犠牲者の首を締めるのだ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Slander against the faith is unpleasant. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on one of your Dark Jedi. If no opposing Jedi is there, the opponent's total ability is reduced by 2. '''Lore:''' Darth Vader uses the Force to strike down anyone who offends him, friend or foe, without mercy. He can choke a victim without laying a finger on them. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' If no opposing Jedi is there, the opponent's total ability is -2. The English reduces total ability at the same location by 2 unless an opponent's Jedi is also present. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-I-Have-A-Very-Bad-Feeling-About-This-PSA-173318901.jpg |lead='''I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_51o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This]] (2_51)
'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This (Revised)]] (52_51)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_51o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=なんだか嫌な予感がする |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：このターンに相手が4人以上のキャラクターを同じ位置に配備した場合に使用する。それらのキャラクターは全員、このターンの間は戦闘を行えない。2：相手が戦闘に対して“リアクション”を行った直後に使用する。その戦闘をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-I-Have-A-Very-Bad-Feeling-About-This-PSA-173318901.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「あの小型機、小さな月に向かってるよ」「月ではない。あれは宇宙ステーションだ」オビ＝ワンの言葉を聞いてルークは胸騒ぎを覚えた。'' |translation='''Title:''' I have a somehow unpleasant premonition. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Use if the opponent deployed 4 or more characters to the same location this turn. Those characters may not battle for the rest of this turn. 2: Use immediately after the opponent “reacts” to a battle. Cancel that battle. '''Lore:''' “That small craft is heading for a small moon.” “That is not a moon. It is a space station.” Hearing Obi-Wan's words, Luke felt a pang of unease. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is なんだか嫌な予感がする. The Japanese numbers the two options. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[I Have You Now (V)]] (218_11) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=とどめを刺すぞ |printed_game_text=ダーク・ジェダイと能力値＞２の反乱軍キャラクターが同じ戦闘に参加している時に使う。戦闘運命数をもう１枚引いて足す（反乱軍キャラクターがルークなら、２枚引ける）。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-248o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「本隊から離脱したやつらを追うぞ。」ダース・ベイダーは、トレンチを進む反乱軍パイロットに、自機のブラスター・キャノンの照準を定めた。'' |translation='''Title:''' I'll finish them off. title: I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-I-Thought-They-Smelled-Bad-On-The-Outside-PSA-157878138.jpg |lead='''I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_43o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=7 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside]] (3_43o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_43o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside (PC Errata)]] (3_43) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=臭いのは外側だけじゃなかったのか |printed_game_text=自分の乗用生物を一匹犠牲にする（ロストする）。同じ位置にいるキャラクターを１人選ぶ。キャラクターはこのターンの間、「凍死」、「雪嵐」、「凍傷」、「砂岩嵐」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-I-Thought-They-Smelled-Bad-On-The-Outside-PSA-157878138.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「我慢しろよ、ルーク。臭いかもしれんが……シェルターをたてるまで……この中ならあったまる」'' |translation='''Title:''' So it didn't smell bad only on the outside. '''Card text:''' Sacrifice (lose) one of your creature vehicles. Choose one character at the same location. That character is immune to Exposure, Ice Storm, Frostbite and Gravel Storm this turn. '''Lore:''' "Hang on, Luke. It may smell, but… until I get a shelter up… you'll stay warm in here." '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese immunizes one character and has no Ronto extra or Tzizvvt power option. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

text:
{{Card |title=I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese) |set_display=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Id-Just-As-Soon-Kiss-A-Wookiee-SWCA-100675.jpg |lead='''I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1363_127o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee]] (3_127o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1363_127o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee (Errata)]] (3_127-DE) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ウーキーとキスする方がましだわ |printed_game_text=相手がカードを配備した直後に使用する。３フォース消費してそのカードを相手の手札に戻させる。そのカードを配備するのに消費したフォースは消費されたままとなる。次の相手のターンに、そのカードは不可能でない限り、必ず同じロケーションに配備されなければならない。この際、配備にフォースは消費しない。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Id-Just-As-Soon-Kiss-A-Wookiee-SWCA-100675.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「まあせいぜい楽しみな。お熱いやつをな」'' |translation='''Title:''' I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee. '''Card text:''' Use immediately after the opponent deploys a card. Spend 3 Force to return that card to the opponent's hand. Force spent to deploy that card remains spent. On the opponent's next turn, that card must be deployed to the same location if possible. That deployment costs no Force. '''Lore:''' “Well, enjoy yourself as much as you like. A hot one.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore is Han’s line about enjoying a hot kiss, not English “I can arrange that. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

text:
{{Card |title=I'm On The Leader |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Im-On-The-Leader-SWCA-67723.jpg |lead='''I'm On The Leader''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_133o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[I'm On The Leader]] (2_133o)

'''Decipher Errata''' — [[I'm On The Leader (Errata)]] (2_133)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[I'm On The Leader (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_35) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=先頭機は任せろ |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：「アタック・ラン」を行っている宇宙戦闘機を1機、目標として選ぶ。運命数を引き、デス・スター上にあるTIEの1機につき、1を加える。合計の値＞目標の回避値なら、宇宙戦闘機はロストする。2：このターンの終了時まで、任意の1機の宇宙戦闘機の武器運命数にそれぞれ1を加える。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Im-On-The-Leader-SWCA-67723.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ヤヴィンの戦いにおけるデス・スターの防衛戦で、ダース・ベイダーはブラック2とブラック3を従え、3機編隊の先頭にたって攻撃を行った。'' |translation='''Title:''' I'm On The Leader. '''Card text:''' Choose one. Target one starfighter making an Attack Run. Draw destiny and add 1 for each TIE on the Death Star. If the total exceeds the target's maneuver, the starfighter is lost. Until the end of this turn, add 1 to each weapon destiny of any one starfighter. '''Lore:''' In the Death Star defense at the Battle of Yavin, Darth Vader took Black 2 and Black 3 and attacked at the head of a three-ship formation. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title is 先頭機は任せろ. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[I'm On The Leader]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}
