title: I've Got A Problem Here (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=I've Got A Problem Here |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] — [[Lost Interrupt]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Ive-Got-A-Problem-Here-video.png |lead='''I've Got A Problem Here''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_253o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |destiny=4 |versions='''Decipher''' — [[I've Got A Problem Here]] (1_253o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing'''
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[I've Got A Problem Here (Errata)]] (1_253d)
'''PC Errata''' — [[I've Got A Problem Here (PC Errata)]] (1_253) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=トラブルが発生した |printed_game_text=１フォース消費して、戦闘が終わったばかりの星系にいる敵の宇宙戦闘機を対象にする。運命数を引く。運命数＞回避値ならば、その宇宙戦闘機は即座にロストする。 |printed_lore=''飛散物の破片が、ジェック・ポーキンズのＸウィングにダメージを与えた。そのため、コンピュータと操縦管制装置がいかれてしまった。'' |translation='''Title:''' Trouble has occurred. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to target an opponent's starfighter at a system where a battle has just ended. Draw destiny. If destiny is greater than maneuver, that starfighter is immediately lost. '''Lore:''' Flying debris damaged Jek Porkins' X-wing, causing its computer and flight control equipment to fail. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title describes trouble occurring; the English title is a first-person statement. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[I've Got A Problem Here]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=199s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:19. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Ive-Got-A-Problem-Here-video.png|Preserved card frame]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_218o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=Ｒ２をやられた！ |printed_game_text=１フォース消費して、宇宙船の操縦ドロイドかナビコンの破壊を試みる。運命数を引く。運命数＞１ならば、宇宙船に配備し、その宇宙船の航行速度は０になる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-218o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''操縦ドロイドが断末魔の叫びを上げた。'' |translation='''Title:''' They Got R2! '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_93o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (PC Errata)]] (2_93)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_37)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (V)]] (1210_14) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ＩＴ－Ｏ（アイティー・オー） |printed_game_text=支配フェイズに「監房ブロック回廊」にいるなら、その位置での自分のフォース消耗に＋Ｘ。Ｘ＝その場にいる捕虜の人数、である。このドロイドは「行動規制ボルト」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-IT-O-Eyetee-Oh-PSA-89673866.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''浮遊式の捕虜尋問用ドロイド。注射針で自白剤を投与し、診断器具で“手術”を施す。センサーで、対象がどの程度の苦痛に耐えられるか、真実を話しているかなどを判断できる。'' |translation='''Title:''' IT-O (Eyetee-Oh). '''Card text:''' If at Detention Block Corridor during the control phase, your Force drains there are +X. X equals the number of captives present. This droid is not affected by Restraining Bolt. '''Lore:''' A floating prisoner interrogation droid. It gives truth drugs with a syringe needle and performs surgery with diagnostic tools. Sensors can judge how much pain the subject can endure and whether the subject is telling the truth. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The power line prints 尋問用ドロイド instead of ability. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[IT-O (Eyetee-Oh)]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. text:
{{Card |title=Ice Storm (Dark) |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] ([[Mobile Effect]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Ice-Storm-Dark-PSA-148375098.jpg |lead='''Ice Storm (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Mobile Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_104o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Ice Storm]] (3_37)
'''Decipher''' — [[Ice Storm (Dark)]] (3_104)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Ice Storm (Japanese)]] (1303_37o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_104o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊雪嵐 |printed_game_text=最も外側のマーカーに配備する。同じ屋外の位置では、その場所にいるすべてのキャラクターが行方不明となる。各ターン、自分の支配フェイズに、嵐は隣のマーカーに移動する。最も内側のマーカーに到達したなら、進行方向が変化する。可動エフェクトは最も外側のマーカーを超えて移動したなら、ロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Ice-Storm-Dark-PSA-148375098.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ホスの苛酷な自然環境の中でも最大の危険は、頻繁に発生し素早く移動する雪嵐だ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Snow storm. '''Card text:''' Deploy at the outermost marker. At the same exterior site, all characters there become missing. Each turn, during your control phase, the storm moves to an adjacent marker. If it reaches the innermost marker, its direction reverses. The Mobile Effect is lost if it moves beyond the outermost marker. '''Lore:''' The greatest danger in Hoth's harsh environment is the frequent, fast-moving ice storm. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Ice Storm (Dark)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_11o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊イッカベル・ゴント |printed_game_text=相手は隣接する位置カードでフォース消耗を行う場合には、Xフォースを支払わなければならない。X＝イッカベルと同じロケーションにいるミュージシャンの人数である。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Ickabel-Gont-PSA-164793240.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ビス男性のミュージシャン。お気に入りの曲は“アクアナの涙”（たぶん自分のファンファーレの聞かせどころがあるから）。'' |translation='''Title:''' Ickabel G'ont. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Imperial Barrier (Errata)]] (1_249) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=完全防備の壁 |printed_game_text=相手がキャラクターか宇宙船を配備した直後に使用する。１フォース消費すること。そのキャラクターまたは宇宙船は、このターンの間中、戦闘と移動を行うことができない。Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Imperial-Barrier-video.png|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Imperial Barrier (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text. '''Virtual Modern''' — [[Imperial Code Cylinder (V)]] (213_21) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=帝国軍コード・シリンダー |printed_game_text=帝国軍のリーダーが、アクセス・リンクのある位置にいる時に使う。どちらかを選ぶ。１：どちらのリザーブデッキでも、２０秒間見る。デッキをシャッフルしなおす。２：さらにデス・スターの位置にいるなら、「アクセス・リンク」「ガベージ・シュートに飛び込んで！」をキャンセルする。 |printed_lore=''帝国軍将校は、アクセス・リンクを使うためのコード・シリンダーが給付されている。各人の保安レベルに合わせてシリンダーが設定されており、引き出せる情報が異なる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Imperial Code Cylinder. '''Card text:''' Use when an Imperial leader is at a location with a Scomp link. Choose one: (1) Look at either Reserve Deck for 20 seconds, then reshuffle it. (2) If also at a Death Star location, cancel [[Scomp Link Access]] and [[Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]]. '''Lore:''' Imperial officers are issued code cylinders for using Scomp links. Each cylinder is set to its owner's security level, determining what information can be retrieved. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese specifies a location and a Death Star location; the English specifies presence with a Scomp link and a Death Star site. The Japanese lists the two cards to cancel without an explicit “or”; the English says to cancel one or the other. The Japanese says to reshuffle the Reserve Deck; the English says to shuffle, cut and replace it. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Code Cylinder]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=213s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:33. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Imperial-Code-Cylinder-video.png|Preserved card frame]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Original''' — [[Imperial Reinforcements (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour)]] (1102_37) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=帝国軍増援部隊 |printed_game_text=相手の場のカードのキャラクターと宇宙船の数の合計が、自分のよりも多いとき、１フォース消費して運命数を引く。その数の分の「ストームトルーパー」または「タイ・ファイター」をロストデッキから取り戻して再使用できる。Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Imperial-Reinforcements-video.png|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Imperial Reinforcements (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Imperial-Reinforcements-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国軍のストームトルーパーは、１個分隊８～１０名で構成されている。作戦行動を取る場合は、増援部隊から人員を補充するのが、通常の手順である。'' |translation='''Title:''' Imperial reinforcement unit. '''Card text:''' When the opponent has more characters and starships in play in total than you do, use 1 Force and draw destiny. You may retrieve that number of Stormtroopers or TIE fighters from the Lost Deck for reuse. '''Lore:''' Imperial stormtrooper squads consist of eight to ten soldiers. During operations, the usual procedure is to replenish personnel from reinforcement units. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese connects Stormtroopers and TIE fighters with “or”; the English says “and/or.” The Japanese lore describes replenishing personnel from reinforcement units, while the English says reinforcements are typically held in reserve. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Reinforcements]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Imperial Squad Leader |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) |set=Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese) |set_display=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Imperial-Squad-Leader-SWCA-100659.jpg |lead='''Imperial Squad Leader''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1362_92o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=1 |power=1 |ability=1 |deploy=2 |forfeit=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Imperial Squad Leader]] (2_92o)
'''Decipher (ESB Two-Player)''' — [[Imperial Squad Leader (ESB Two-Player)]] (62_92o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1362_92o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Imperial Squad Leader (Japanese)]] (1302_92o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Imperial Squad Leader (Errata)]] (2_92) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=帝国軍分隊指揮官 |printed_game_text=きっちり３人の兵員／トルーパーからなる“分隊”とともに移動する場合、１フォースで４人全員が移動できる。同じ位置カード上の兵員／トルーパーはそれぞれ没収値＋１。「帝国軍警備兵員」は分隊指揮官と一緒であれば移動可能となる（フォースは通常通り消費する）。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Imperial-Squad-Leader-SWCA-100659.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''モッド・テリック大尉は、デザート・サンズ・サンドトルーパー部隊のごく典型的な士官である。勇敢で忠誠心が強い。必要とあらば、兵員たちを犠牲にすることも厭わない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Imperial Squad Leader. '''Card text:''' When moving with a “squad” of exactly three troopers, all four may move for 1 Force. Troopers at the same location card are each forfeit +1. Imperial Trooper Guards may move if they are with the squad leader, using Force as usual. '''Lore:''' Captain Mod Terrik is a typical officer of the Desert Sands sandtrooper unit. He is brave and loyal. If necessary, he does not hesitate to sacrifice his troops. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses 位置カード where the English uses site, and 兵員／トルーパー for troopers. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Squad Leader]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Imperial Squad Leader (Errata)]] (2_92) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=帝国軍分隊指揮官 |printed_game_text=きっかり3人の兵員／トルーパーからなる“分隊”とともに移動する場合、1フォースで4人全員が移動できる。同じ位置カード上の兵員／トルーパーはそれぞれ没収値＋1。「帝国軍警備兵員」は分隊指揮官と一緒であれば移動可能となる（フォースは通常通り消費する）。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Imperial-Squad-Leader-PSA-90960097.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''モッド・テリック大尉は、デザート・サンズ・サンドトルーパー部隊のごく典型的な士官である。勇敢で忠誠心が強い。必要とあらば、兵員たちを犠牲にすることも厭わない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Imperial Squad Leader. '''Card text:''' When moving with a squad of exactly three personnel or troopers, all four may move for 1 Force. Personnel or troopers on the same location card are each forfeit +1. Imperial Trooper Guards can move if they are with the squad leader. Force is used as usual. '''Lore:''' Captain Mod Terrik is a very typical officer of the Desert Sands sandtrooper unit. He is brave and loyal. If necessary, he does not hesitate to sacrifice his troops. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 兵員／トルーパー and 位置カード, does not say your troopers, and names Imperial Trooper Guards 「帝国軍警備兵員」. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Squad Leader]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

text:
{{Card |title=Imperial Supply |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Imperial-Supply-PSA-86099789.jpg |lead='''Imperial Supply''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_128o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Imperial Supply]] (3_128)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_128o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=帝国軍補給物資 |printed_game_text=ユーズド：1フォース失って2フォース起動する。ロスト：1フォース失って4フォース起動する。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Imperial-Supply-PSA-86099789.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国は恐怖を原動力として軍事物資を効率的に供給する。紛争が起こる地域に次々と武器や装備を移し替え、戦術的に重要な拠点に物資を最大限に集中させるのだ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Imperial Supply. '''Card text:''' USED: Lose 1 Force to activate 2 Force. LOST: Lose 1 Force to activate 4 Force. '''Lore:''' The Empire uses fear as a driving force to supply military goods efficiently. It shifts weapons and equipment to conflict regions and concentrates supplies on tactically important bases. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Used and Lost numbers match the English face. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Supply]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_75o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=インコムT－16スカイホッパー |printed_game_text=乗客を1名追加できる。能力値1の専属パイロットが乗っている。“リアクション”として移動できる。＊移動力＝4。または、その位置カード上から宇宙船に、あるいは宇宙船からその位置カード上に、キャラクターを1名フォースを使用せずに、乗り降りさせられる。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Incom-T-16-Skyhopper-PSA-157709608.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''輸送用の密閉型ビークルだが、スピード狂たちのお気に入りでもある。E－16/x型イオン・エンジンを搭載。T－16は最高時速1200kmを誇る。'' |translation='''Title:''' Incom T-16 Skyhopper. '''Card text:''' May add 1 passenger. Has a permanent pilot of ability 1. May move as a “react.” * Landspeed = 4. Or one character may shuttle to or from a starship at that location card for free. '''Lore:''' An enclosed transport vehicle, but also a favorite of speed freaks. It carries an E-16/x ion engine. The T-16 boasts a top speed of 1200 km/h. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is シャトル・ビークル. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Incom T-16 Skyhopper]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. text:
{{Card |title=Infantry Mine (Dark) |side=Dark |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Automated Weapon]]) |set=Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese) |set_display=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Infantry-Mine-Dark-SWCA-100676.jpg |lead='''Infantry Mine (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Automated Weapon]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1363_160o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Infantry Mine (Dark)]] (3_160o)
'''Decipher (ESB Two-Player)''' — [[Infantry Mine (Dark) (ESB Two-Player)]] (63_160o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1363_160o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Infantry Mine (Dark) (Japanese)]] (1303_160o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Infantry Mine (Dark) (PC Errata)]] (3_160) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=対人地雷 |printed_game_text=自分の地雷敷設ドロイドの１体と同じ屋外の位置に配備する。キャラクターがその位置に配備されるか移動してきたなら“爆発”する。ただし、ビークルや宇宙戦闘機を使用して移動してきた場合には爆発しない。運命数を引く。運命数＋２＞能力値なら、キャラクターはロストする。対人地雷もロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Infantry-Mine-Dark-SWCA-100676.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''強力な爆発物を内蔵している。反乱軍のスパイや工作員たちの侵入を阻むため、戦術的に重要な拠点や高度の警備を要する施設の防衛線にしばしば配備される。'' |translation='''Title:''' Infantry Mine (Dark). '''Card text:''' Deploy at the same exterior location as one of your mine-laying droids. It “explodes” if a character deploys or moves there. It does not explode if that movement used a vehicle or starfighter. Draw destiny. The character is lost if destiny plus 2 exceeds ability. The Infantry Mine is also lost. '''Lore:''' It contains a powerful explosive. To block Rebel spies and operatives, it is often placed on the defensive line of tactically important bases or high-security facilities. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore leads with a built-in explosive and uses 防衛線 for perimeter. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Infantry Mine (Dark)]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

If destiny + 2 is greater than the target's armor or maneuver, all of the target's weapons are lost, and its armor, maneuver, and travel speed all become 0. '''Lore:''' Fires ionized energy. It can cause extensive damage to an enemy target's weapons, engines, computers, and other systems. Disables defenses against tractor beams. The Japanese wording says to spend 1 Force to activate the weapon; the English says it may target using 1 Force. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Ion Cannon]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Jawa Blaster (Errata)]] (2_159) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ジャワのブラスター |printed_game_text=任意のジャワにフォースを消費せずに配備する。フォースを消費せずに起動する。運命数を引く。キャラクターには、運命数－1＞能力値なら命中する。運命数＝0なら「ジャワのブラスター」は爆発し、このカードと使用したキャラクターはロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Jawa-Blaster-PSA-159081614.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ジャワのブラスターは廃品から組み上げるため、およそ標準的な設計とはかけ離れた作りになる。銃床に「ダーティーニー・グレッブ・ズルーム」という警告が刻まれている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Jawa's blaster. The warning “datinni greb zroom” is etched on the stock. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is ジャワのブラスター. Lore Huttese is ダーティーニー・グレッブ・ズルーム. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Jawa Blaster]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Jawa Ion Gun (Errata)]] (2_78) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ジャワのイオン化銃 |printed_game_text=1フォースを使用して任意のジャワに配備する。あるいは3フォースを使用して任意の戦士に配備する。1フォースを使用して起動する。運命数を引く。ドロイドは運命数＋1＞没収値なら即座に“盗まれる”。ドロイド以外のキャラクターは運命数＝能力値なら、その戦闘から除外される。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Jawa-Ion-Gun-SWCA-67707.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''廃品のパワー・セルとドロイド行動規制ボルト、イオン加速装置を寄せ集めて作った武器。イオン・エネルギーの奔流を撃ち出す。動けなくなるのはドロイドだけだが、その他の者も撃たれて良い気分はしない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Jawa Ion Gun. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any Jawa. Or use 3 Force to deploy on any warrior. Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A droid is immediately stolen if destiny plus 1 exceeds forfeit. A non-droid character is excluded from that battle if destiny equals ability. '''Lore:''' A weapon cobbled together from scrap power cells, droid restraining bolts, and an ion accelerator. It fires a torrent of ion energy. Only droids are immobilized, but anyone else who is hit does not feel good either. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title is ジャワのイオン化銃. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Jawa Ion Gun]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_155o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ジェダイ・ライトセーバー |printed_game_text=任意の戦士にＸフォース消費して配備する。Ｘは、（７－キャラクターの能力値）である。キャラクターがいるロケーションは、フォース消耗に＋１される。Ｘフォース消費して起動する。運命数を２枚引き、キャラクターには、合計＞能力値で命中する。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-155o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''純粋エネルギーの優雅な剣。「これこそジェダイ・ナイトの武器だ。ぶしつけであてにならぬブラスターとはわけが違う。」慣れない者が使うと危険である。'' |translation='''Title:''' Jedi Lightsaber. '''Card text:''' Use X Force to deploy on any warrior, where X is 7 minus the character's ability. The location where the character is present is Force drain +1. Use X Force to fire. '''Virtual Modern''' — [[Juri Juice (V)]] (221_24) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊ジュリ・ジュース |printed_game_text=「カンティーナ（酒場）」「モス・アイズリー」「ジャバのセイル・バージ」のいずれかが場に出ている時に使う。好きなエイリアンに配備する。そのエイリアンは、戦闘の際に特殊能力を使えない（カーベに配備したなら、“盗む”こともできなくなる）。このカードをキャンセルするためには、そのエイリアンを上記以外の位置に、自分でビークルを“運転”せずに移動させる必要がある。 |printed_lore=''酒場の定番の飲料。多くの種族に酔わせる効果がある。モス・アイズリーの盗賊カーベやチャドラ＝ファンの好物。'' |translation='''Title:''' Juri Juice. '''Card text:''' Use when Cantina, Mos Eisley or Jabba's Sail Barge is on the table. Deploy on any alien. That alien cannot use special ability in battle; if deployed on Kabe, she also cannot steal. To cancel this card, the alien must move to a location other than those listed above without personally driving a vehicle. '''Lore:''' A standard cantina beverage that intoxicates many species. A favorite of Kabe, a Mos Eisley thief, and Chadra-Fan. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to cancel the card by moving the alien to a location other than those listed above; the English says to move that alien to one of those sites. The Japanese lore names Kabe and Chadra-Fan as fans of the drink; the English describes Kabe as a Chadra-Fan thief. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Juri Juice]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=239s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:59. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Juri-Juice-video.png|Preserved card frame]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Alien]][[:File:Japanese-Premiere-PSA-Kabe-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=カーベ |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズに、同じ位置にいる相手の武器かアイテムを対象に選ぶ。運命数を引き、運命数＜対象の運命数ならば、盗んだことになる。アイテムならそのまま使え、武器ならば同じ位置にいる戦士に渡す（コスト０で配備する）ことができる。 |printed_lore=''チャドラ・ファンの少女盗賊。マフタックが保護者。奴隷商人にタトゥイーンに捨てられた。ジュリ・ジュースが好物。モス・アイズリーのジャバ・ザ・ハットの別宅を荒らす。'' |translation='''Title:''' Kabe. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, choose an opponent's weapon or item at the same location as a target. Draw destiny; if it is less than the target's destiny number, it is stolen. An item can be used as it is; a weapon can be handed to a warrior at the same location, deploying it at zero cost. '''Lore:''' A young Chadra-Fan thief whose guardian is Muftak. Abandoned on Tatooine by slavers. Fond of juri juice. Robs Jabba the Hutt's residence in Mos Eisley. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to an opponent's weapon or item at the same location; the English names a weapon or device at the same site. The Japanese lore says Kabe robs Jabba's residence; the English says she once robbed it. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Kabe]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Kessel Run (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Kessel Run |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] - [[Utinni Effect|Utinni Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Kessel (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[K'lor'slug (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Kessel-Run-Face.jpg |lead='''Kessel Run''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect|Utinni Effect]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_52o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Rare2 |rarity_display=Rare2 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=5 |icons=[[Effect]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Kessel Run]] (1_52)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_52o)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Kessel Run (V) (Virtual Block 8)]] (1283_26)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Kessel Run (V)]] (213_46) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ケッセル・ラン[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Kessel-Run-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=ケッセルに配備する。他の星系にいる自分の密輸屋を対象にする。この時、二つの星系のパーセク距離をXとする。対象がケッセルについたら、相手は運命数を引く。0なら宇宙船はロストする。そうでなければ、最初にいた星系に戻り、Xフォースを再使用する。ウーティーニー・エフェクトをロストする。 |printed_lore=惑星ケッセルには、悪名高いグリッタースティム・スパイスの鉱山がある。密輸屋や宇宙海賊がいち早く到達するには、ケッセル・ランという険しく危険なハイパースペース航路を通らねばならない。 |translation='''Title:''' Kessel Run. '''Card text:''' Deploy on Kessel. Target one of your smugglers at another system. At this time, let X be the parsec distance between the two systems. When the target reaches Kessel, the opponent draws destiny. If it is 0, the starship is lost. Otherwise, return to the original system and retrieve X Force. Lose the Utinni Effect. '''Lore:''' The planet Kessel has notorious glitterstim spice mines. To arrive quickly, smugglers and space pirates must travel a rugged and dangerous hyperspace route called the Kessel Run. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Both printed faces instruct the player to lose the Utinni Effect after the retrieval. The Japanese lore describes a rugged, dangerous route that allows a quick arrival; the English describes a long, dangerous route that must be traveled quickly.[[:File:Premiere-L-kesselrun.gif|Kessel Run original English printed face]]. |sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 99 (Japanese Premiere checklist). |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

The English uses the term regenerate and specifies retrieving the character closest to the top of your Lost Pile. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Kintan Strider]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Labria (V)]] (1210_16) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Alien]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=ラプリア |printed_game_text=毎ターン1回、自分の支配フェイズに、自分のリザーブデッキの一番上のカードを公開できる。カードがビークルか宇宙船であれば、即座にロストする。それ以外のカードであれば、リザーブデッキ、フォースデッキ、ユーズドデッキのいずれかの一番上に戻すこと。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-184o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''情報屋にしてスパイ。デヴァロニアンの男は放浪好きである。やましい過去を背負い、やむなく孤独に暮らしている。悪魔のような姿から、人々に迫害されている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Labria. People persecute him for a devilish appearance. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Labria]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. {{Card |title=Laser Gate |side=Dark |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] ([[Item]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Laser-Gate-PSA-97065197.jpg |lead='''Laser Gate''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] ([[Item]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_113o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |uniqueness=Restricted |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Laser Gate]] (2_113o)

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Laser Gate (V)]] (1240_18) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=レーザー・ゲート |printed_game_text=任意の2枚の、移動要塞の屋内の位置カードの境界に配備する。ここを通るためには、各キャラクターは（戦闘力＋能力値）＞4であるか、「リフト・チューブ」を使用する必要がある。それ以外のビークルはすべて移動を妨げられる。レーザー・ゲートは装甲値＝3。両側の位置カードから個人用兵器の目標とすることができる。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Laser-Gate-PSA-97065197.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''保安区画の回廊には多数のレーザーが装備されている。必要に応じてこれを格子状に張りめぐらせて、重要区画への敵の侵入を阻止する。'' |translation='''Title:''' Laser Gate. '''Card text:''' Deploy at the boundary between any two interior location cards of a mobile fortress. To pass, each character must have combined power and ability greater than 4 or use Lift Tube. All other vehicles are blocked. Laser Gate has armor 3. A personal weapon can target it from a location card on either side. '''Lore:''' Security corridors are equipped with many lasers. They can form a grid to keep enemies out of sensitive areas when necessary. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face says “interior location cards of a mobile fortress” and “personal weapon.” |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Laser Gate]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_319o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=レーザー・グリッド |printed_game_text=２フォース消費して屋内の位置カードに配備する。移動はできない。フォース消費なしで起動できる。運命数を引く。キャラクターなら、運命数－１＞能力値で、シーカーなら運命数＞２で命中する。他の武器でレーザー・グリッドを狙うこともできる。その場合、運命数＞１で命中する。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-319o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''警備兵の緊急信号によって作動するレーザー・システム。警備上の重要地点や監房ブロックの制御室で使用されている。照準はドロイドの操作中枢を転用している。'' |translation='''Title:''' Laser Grid. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy at an interior site. Cannot move. May fire at no cost. Draw destiny. Hit a character if destiny −1 exceeds ability, or a seeker if destiny exceeds 2. Another weapon may target the laser grid and hit it if destiny exceeds 1. '''Lore:''' A laser system triggered by a guard's emergency signal. Used at important security points and in detention block control rooms. Its targeting system is adapted from a droid control center. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Laser Projector]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_222o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=予期せぬ損傷[[WED-9-M1 'Bantha' Droid (Japanese)#Card Text|Japanese WED-9-M1 game text]] names the card it cancels. |printed_game_text=任意の星系カードに配備する。相手の宇宙船１隻を対象に選ぶ。対象は戦闘力＝０、没収＝０となる。対象がこのカードと同じ場所に移動したなら、相手は運命数を引く。運命数＞２なら、このカードはキャンセルされる。そうでなければ、次の移動フェイズにもう一度運命数を引く。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-222o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''宇宙船は時として、戦闘でダメージを受け、修理と補給を受けるまで使用不能となる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Unexpected Damage. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any system. Target one opposing starship. The target's power and forfeit become 0. When it moves to the same location as this card, your opponent draws destiny. If it exceeds 2, cancel this card. Otherwise, your opponent draws destiny again during the next move phase. '''Lore:''' Starships can take damage in combat and remain unusable until repaired and resupplied. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The opponent draws destiny when the target moves to the same location as this card. The English has the target draw destiny when it reaches the [[Utinni Effect]]. The Japanese cancels this card; the English cancels the [[Utinni Effect]]. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Lateral Damage]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Card text:''' During your control phase each turn, use 1 Force to select a card from your opponent's hand and predict its card type. Reveal the card. If your prediction is correct, the card is lost. '''Lore:''' Leesub is a near-human Qiraash who was raised as a slave. She has a limited ability to foresee the future. Imperial High Inquisitor Tremayne recognized her as an adept of the Force, but she escaped and went into hiding in Mos Eisley. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Leia Organa (V)]] (202_1) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=レイア・オーガナ |printed_game_text=デス・スターで、彼女と同じ位置にいる反乱軍の戦闘力に＋１。外交特権により、耐：損耗＜２。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-leia-organa-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''意志の強いオルデランのプリンセス。史上最年少の帝国元老院議員。外交特権を使って反乱軍のスパイをする。ラルティアの反乱活動を支援した。天性のリーダー。'' |translation='''Title:''' Leia Organa. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_156o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=レイアの護身用ブラスター |printed_game_text=１フォース消費して、レイアに配備する。２フォース消費して、それ以外の戦士に配備する。起動にフォースを消費しない。運命数を引く。キャラクターなら、運命数－１＞能力値で、ビークルなら運命数－１＞回避値か装甲値で命中する。レイアが命中させた場合、対象の没収値は０になる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-156o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ドリアリアン・ディフェンス・コングロマリット製の、護身狩猟ブラスター。護身及び、小規模の狩猟用。射程が短くパワーも低い。５０発分のエネルギーを内蔵。'' |translation='''Title:''' Leia's Self-Defense Blaster. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on Leia, or 2 Force to deploy on another warrior. Fire at no Force cost. Draw destiny. Hit a character if destiny −1 exceeds ability, or a vehicle if destiny −1 exceeds maneuver or armor. If Leia hits the target, its forfeit becomes 0. '''Lore:''' A defense and hunting blaster made by the Drearian Defense Conglomerate. Intended for self-defense and small-scale hunting. It has short range, low power, and energy for 50 shots. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Leia's Sporting Blaster]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Card text:''' Starship weapons may be deployed at deploy cost −1 on a starship he pilots. A starship he pilots has power +2 but maneuver −1. '''Lore:''' A former fighter pilot relieved of flight duties after an injury. He is a tactical officer on the Death Star, a skilled strategist who specializes in directing Imperial starfighters. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text applies the maneuver reduction to a starship he pilots. The English printed card applies it to a starfighter he pilots. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Lieutenant Tanbris]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Light Repeating Blaster Rifle (Errata)]] (1_320) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=連射式軽ブラスター・ライフル |printed_game_text=２フォース消費して任意の戦士に配備する。パワー・ドロイドか「融合ジェネレーター供給タンク」がある時のみ、２フォースで起動できる。運命数を引くこと。運命数＋１＞能力値で命中する。ビークルなら運命数＋１＞回避値／装甲値なら命中する。２フォース消費するごとに、何回でも起動できる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-320o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ブラステック・モデルＴ－２１連射式軽ブラスター。強力で射程も長い。２５発分のエネルギーを内蔵。パワー・ジェネレーターに接続すれば、無限に撃ち続けることができる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Light Repeating Blaster Rifle. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on any warrior. May fire for 2 Force only when a power droid or Fusion Generator Supply Tanks is present. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny +1 exceeds ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny +1 exceeds maneuver or armor. May fire any number of times for 2 Force each. '''Lore:''' A BlasTech model T-21 light repeating blaster. Powerful and long-ranged, with enough internal energy for 25 shots. Connected to a power generator, it can keep firing indefinitely. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Light Repeating Blaster Rifle]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. '''PC Errata''' — [[Lightsaber Proficiency (PC Errata)]] (1_54) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ライトセーバー修得 |printed_game_text=能力値＞2でライトセーバーを持つキャラクターに配備する。キャラクターは、戦闘力が＋3され、いるロケーションのフォース消耗に＋1される。キャラクターがライトセーバーをなくせば、このエフェクトはロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-54o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ジェダイが学ぶのは、ただライトセーバーを振るうだけでなく、フォースを通わせて技を磨き、セーバーの威力を制御することである。'' |translation='''Title:''' Lightsaber Proficiency. '''Lore:''' A Jedi learns more than how to swing a lightsaber. The Force hones the skill and controls the blade. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese adds power +3 and Force drain +1; the English is power +3 in battles or Force drain +1. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Lightsaber Proficiency]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. '''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[Limited Resources (Unlimited)]] (51_255)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_255o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Limited Resources (Errata)]] (1_255) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=物資の不足 |printed_game_text=敵が手札を2枚以下しか持っていない時に使う。敵は即座に2フォース（こちらのターンなら4フォース）を失う。敵が宇宙船に「融合ジェネレータ供給タンク」を乗せている場合、失うフォースは2減る。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-255o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国は各種資源を軍の統制下においている。倹約につとめる反乱軍だが、補給士官たちが必死で蓄えた緊急用備蓄を吐き出さざるを得ない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Limited Resources. '''Card text:''' Use when the opponent has two cards or fewer in hand. The opponent immediately loses 2 Force (4 Force if it is your turn). If the opponent has 融合ジェネレータ供給タンク aboard a starship, the loss is reduced by 2. '''Lore:''' The Empire keeps resources under military control. The Rebellion is thrifty, but supply officers still have to dump emergency stores. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 融合ジェネレータ供給タンク for Fusion Generator Supply Tanks. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Limited Resources]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:

'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Lirin Car'n (Revised)]] (52_94)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_94o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Lirin Car'n (PC Errata)]] (2_94) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊ライリン・カーン |printed_game_text=他の音楽家と同じ位置カード上にいるなら、ライリンは“用心棒代”を徴収することができる。そこにいる本人以外の音楽家一人につき、キャラクターをその位置に配備したり、移動させるコストに1を加える。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Lirin-Carn-PSA-160005372.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ビス男性の傭兵。フィグリン・ダンのバンドの控えのクルー・ホーンのプレイヤーでもある。ドイック以外で唯一、楽器の所有権をフィグリンに奪われていないミュージシャンである。'' |translation='''Title:''' Lirin Car'n. '''Card text:''' If at the same location card as other musicians, Lirin may collect a “bodyguard fee.” For each musician there other than himself, add 1 to the cost for a character to deploy to or move to that location. '''Lore:''' A male Bith mercenary. He is also the backup Kloo Horn player in Figrin D'an's band. Besides Doikk, he is the only musician who has not lost ownership of his instrument to Figrin. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese cover charge is 用心棒代. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Lirin Car'n]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Local Trouble (V)]] |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=SubtypeLost Interrupt |printed_title=地元のいざこざ |printed_game_text=自分の戦闘フェイズの最初に１フォース消費して使う。カンティーナにいるストームトルーパーを２名選び、相手のキャラクターを１名選んで戦闘させられる。戦闘運命数を１回引くことができる。そのターンには、カンティーナでは他の戦闘は起こらない。 |printed_lore=''「どうやらさっきのあんたの腕前に気をひかれた奴がいるようだぜ」帝国軍のストームトルーパーは、地元の住民に反乱分子逮捕への協力を強要する。'' |translation='''Title:''' Local trouble. '''Card text:''' Spend 1 Force to use at the beginning of your battle phase. Choose two Stormtroopers in the Cantina and one opposing character and make them battle. You may draw one battle destiny. No other battles occur in the Cantina that turn. '''Lore:''' ‘It looks like someone has taken an interest in your handiwork just now.’ Imperial Stormtroopers compel local residents to help arrest Rebel elements. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says you may draw battle destiny once; the English says you may add one battle destiny. Both refer to choosing two Stormtroopers in the Cantina and one opposing character. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Local Trouble]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Logistical Delay (V)]] (1210_131) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=遅延連鎖 |printed_game_text=3フォース使用して場の相手の側に配備する。相手のタイはすべて配備コスト＋1となる。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Logistical-Delay-SWCA-67686.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''皇帝の強大な殺人兵器は、あらゆる段階で微妙な調整を必要としている。どこかの行程で思わぬ手違いが起これば、配備計画全体が大幅に遅れる事態を招きかねない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Logistical Delay. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 遅延連鎖 (delay chain). |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Logistical Delay]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. text:
{{Card |title=Lone Rogue |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese) |set_display=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Lone-Rogue-SWCA-97594.jpg |lead='''Lone Rogue''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1404_2o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Lone Rogue]] (104_2o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1404_2o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Lone Rogue (PC Errata)]] (104_2)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Lone Rogue (V)]] (222_24) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=孤高のローグ |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分のパイロットがホスの屋外位置にいる場合に使用する。2フォース消費して自分のリザーブデッキのなかからＴ－４７を1枚探してきて、手札に入れることができる。その後デッキをシャッフルし、カットして元の場所に置く。2：任意の位置において、パイロットの搭乗しているＴ－４７が単独で戦闘を防衛しているなら、戦闘運命数を1枚加える。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Lone-Rogue-SWCA-97594.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ホスの反乱軍基地では、パイロットたちは帝国軍の動きに素早く対応できるよう訓練を受けている。反乱軍の多くは、自分一人で帝国軍を全滅させるくらいの意気込みで戦いに挑んでいる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Lone Rogue. '''Card text:''' Choose one. (1) If your pilot is at an outdoor Hoth location, spend 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck for one T-47. Put it into your hand, then shuffle, cut and replace the deck. (2) If a piloted T-47 is defending a battle alone at any location, add one battle destiny. '''Lore:''' At the Rebel base on Hoth, pilots train to respond quickly to Imperial moves. Many Rebels go into battle with the determination to defeat the Imperial forces on their own. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 位置 (location). |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Lone Rogue]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-premium.png|20px|link=Premium (icon)]] [[Premium (icon)|Premium]] }}

'''Virtual Legacy Errata 3''' — [[Look Sir, Droids (V) (Errata 3)]] (1210_64) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ドロイドです！ |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。１：１フォース消費して、相手のユーズド・デッキを見て、ドロイドがあればすべてロスト・デッキに移動させることができる。２：配備コストと同じだけのフォースを消費して、場に出ている任意のドロイドを１体破壊することができる。 |printed_lore=''トルーパー１１２４、デイヴィン・フェルスは、Ｒ２－Ｄ２とＣ－３ＰＯが脱出ポッドから出る時に落とした部品を発見した。'' |translation='''Title:''' It's a droid! '''Card text:''' Choose one. (1) Use 1 Force to look through the opponent's Used Deck; if there are droids, you may move all of them to the Lost Deck. (2) Use Force equal to its deploy cost to destroy any one droid in play. '''Lore:''' Trooper 1124, Davin Felth, discovered a part dropped by R2-D2 and C-3PO as they left their escape pod. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says all droids found may be moved, while the English says any droids found may be moved. The Japanese lore calls the object a part; the English identifies it as droid plating. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Look Sir, Droids]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=288s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 4:48. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Look-Sir-Droids-video.png|Preserved card frame]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

Pol Treidum (V)]] (201_26) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ポル・トライダム中尉 |printed_game_text=「ドッキング・コントロール・ルーム327」にいる場合、「ドッキング・ベイ327」における自分の戦闘力の合計に２を加える。自分の各支配フェイズに１回だけ、もし潜伏中のスパイと同じ位置にいるなら、運命数を引ける。運命数＝スパイの能力値なら、スパイは“正体を現す”。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Lt-Pol-Treidum-SWCA-100660.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ドッキング・ベイ内の管制ガントリーに配属された士官。磁気フィールドの開閉、空気の安定供給、保安体制の維持などを担当する。ラルティアの作戦以来、反乱軍スパイの侵入に対して神経質になった。'' |translation='''Title:''' Lt. Pol Treidum. '''Card text:''' While at Docking Control Room 327, add 2 to your total power at Docking Bay 327. Once during each of your control phases, if at the same location as an undercover spy, you may draw destiny. If destiny equals the spy’s ability, the spy’s cover is broken. '''Lore:''' An officer assigned to the docking bay control gantry. He handles opening and closing the magnetic field, a stable air supply, and security. Since the Ralltiir mission, he has grown nervous about Rebel spy infiltration. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore names gantry duties (magnetic field, air supply, security) and ラルティア. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Lt. Pol Treidum]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Lt. Shann Childsen (Revised)]] (52_96)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_96o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊シャン・チルドセン中尉 |printed_game_text=「監房ブロック回廊」か「監房ブロックコントロールルーム」にいるなら、戦闘力＋2。また、敵のエイリアンが同じ場所にいるなら戦闘力＋2。そのエイリアンがウーキー、タルズ、イウォークのいずれかであるなら、＋2ではなく＋3。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Lt.-Shann-Childsen-PSA-160005374.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''上官が事務手続きの失敗を告発し、降格させられた。同僚からは、意地の悪いいじめ屋だと思われている。エイリアンの無条件従属をうたう皇帝の勅令の、熱狂的な支持者である。'' |translation='''Title:''' Lt. Shann Childsen. '''Card text:''' Power +2 if at Detention Block Corridor or Detention Block Control Room. Also power +2 if an opponent's alien is at the same place. If that alien is a Wookiee, Talz, or Ewok, +3 instead of +2. '''Lore:''' Demoted after a superior blamed him for a clerical error. Fellow officers think him a mean bully. A fanatical supporter of the Emperor's edict of unconditional alien subjugation. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is シャン・チルドセン中尉. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Lt. Shann Childsen]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. text:
{{Card |title=Lucky Shot |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Lucky-Shot-PSA-91317477.jpg |lead='''Lucky Shot''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_45o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Lucky Shot]] (3_45)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_45o)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Lucky Shot (V)]] (1274_21) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ラッキー・ショット |printed_game_text=戦闘用ビークルを目標として起動している場合に、武器運命数にXを加える。実際に武器運命数を引く前に使用すること。ユーズド：X＝1。ロスト：X＝3。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Lucky-Shot-PSA-91317477.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''AT－ATの装甲に歩兵用火器は通用しないが、ごく稀にブラスターの光弾が装甲板の隙間を貫くこともある。非常に分の悪い賭だが、反乱軍にとってはいつものことだ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Lucky Shot. '''Card text:''' When activating a weapon targeting a combat vehicle, add X to the weapon destiny. Use this before the weapon destiny is drawn. Used: X equals 1. Lost: X equals 3. '''Lore:''' Infantry weapons cannot pierce AT-AT armor, but a blaster bolt rarely hits a gap in the plating. It is a very poor bet, but such odds are nothing new for the Rebellion. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 起動する for targeting and writes USED/LOST as ユーズド／ロスト. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Lucky Shot]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1401_2o)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Luke (V) (Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology)]] (1110_5)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Luke (V)]] (1210_104) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ルーク |printed_game_text=必ずタトゥイーンに配備する。その後の移動は自由。場に敵の単一（＊）キャラクターが二人以上配備されていると、配備できない。ルークと同一か、隣接した位置カードにいる君の戦士は、没収値＋１となる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Luke-SWCA-97587.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''オーウェン＆ベルー・ラーズ夫妻のもと、タトゥイーンのモイスチャー・ファームで育った。幼馴染みのケイミーとフィクサーには“ワーミー”（弱虫）と呼ばれている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Luke. '''Card text:''' Must deploy on Tatooine. Moves freely after that. May not deploy if two or more of the opponent's unique (＊) characters are deployed. Your warriors at the same or an adjacent site as Luke are forfeit +1. '''Lore:''' Raised by Owen and Beru Lars on a Tatooine moisture farm. His childhood friends Camie and Fixer call him “Wormie” (weakling). |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Luke]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Luke Seeker (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Luke Seeker |side=Dark |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-321o-Face.jpg |lead='''Luke Seeker''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_321o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Luke Seeker]] (1_321o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_321o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ルーク・シーカー |printed_game_text=１フォース使用して、未踏査の位置カードの、相手側に配備できる。自分の支配フェイズに、キャラクターと同じようにフォース消費して移動させることができる。ルークまたは能力値＜３のパイロットと同じ場所についたら、そのうち１枚を選んで、ロストさせる。ルーク・シーカーもロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-321o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''軍用リモート。特定の個人や、条件を指定しての追跡をプログラムされている。熱光学センサーできわめて正確に対象を追跡する。宇宙船に潜り込ませることも可能。'' |translation='''Title:''' Luke Seeker. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy to your opponent's side of an unoccupied site. During your control phase, you may use Force to move it like a character. If it reaches the same location as Luke or a pilot with ability below 3, choose one such card to be lost. Luke Seeker is also lost. '''Lore:''' A military remote programmed to track particular people or pursue targets that meet specified conditions. Thermo-optical sensors let it track a target with great precision. It can also be slipped aboard a starship. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Luke Seeker]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Luke Skywalker (Japanese Reflections III Foil)
text: {{Card |title=Luke Skywalker |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] |set=Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty |set_display=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |language=ja |language_display=Japanese |label_language=Printed language |navigation=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |image=Japanese-Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg |lead='''Luke Skywalker''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]]. |rarity=SR |rarity_display=[[Rarity|SR]] |destiny=1 |power=3 |ability=4 |deploy=3 |forfeit=7 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions={{Card versions/Luke Skywalker (Premiere)}} |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=FinishFoil |printed_title=ルーク・スカイウォーカー |printed_game_text=タトゥイーン以外のロケーションにルークがいる場合、毎ターン、フォースを1多く起動できる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋3。レッド5を操縦する場合、さらに回避値に＋2。耐：損耗＜3。 |printed_lore=''アナキン・スカイウォーカーの息子。オビ＝ワン・ケノービの弟子。Ｔ－16スカイホッパーに乗って、ベガーズ・キャニオンのウォンプ・ラットを狙い撃ちして操縦技能を磨いた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Luke Skywalker. '''Card text:''' If Luke is at a location other than Tatooine, he may activate 1 additional Force each turn. Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. When piloting Red 5, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3. '''Lore:''' Son of Anakin Skywalker. Pupil of Obi-Wan Kenobi. He honed his piloting skill by shooting womp rats in Beggar's Canyon from a T-16 skyhopper. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says he honed his piloting skill by shooting womp rats in Beggar's Canyon; the English lore says his father trained him to fly T-16s there. |notes='''Luke Skywalker (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Luke Skywalker (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R58 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R58. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[[:File:Japanese-Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins. |see_also=* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese foils|Japanese foils]] |see_also_heading=See Also |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Luke Skywalker (Japanese)
text: {{Card |title=Luke Skywalker |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |language_display=Japanese |label_language=Printed language |navigation=[[LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay) (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[Luke's Back (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-luke-skywalker-Face.jpg |lead='''Luke Skywalker''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Luke Skywalker]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4046). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |gemp_id=1301_19o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |edition=Limited, black border, nonfoil |destiny=1 |power=3 |ability=4 |deploy=3 |forfeit=7 |uniqueness=Unique (one asterisk) |icons=[[Rebel]] [[Pilot]] [[Warrior]] |label_icons=Icons |versions={{Card versions/Luke Skywalker (Premiere)}} |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ルーク・スカイウォーカー |printed_game_text=タトゥイーン以外のロケーションにルークがいる場合、毎ターン、フォースを１多く起動できる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋３。レッド５を操縦する場合、さらに回避値に＋２。耐：損耗＜３。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-luke-skywalker-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''アナキン・スカイウォーカーの息子。オビ＝ワン・ケノービの弟子。Ｔ－１６スカイホッパーに乗って、ベガーズ・キャニオンのウォンプ・ラットを狙い撃ちして操縦技能を磨いた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Luke Skywalker. '''Card text:''' While Luke is at a location other than Tatooine, you may activate 1 additional Force each turn. Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. When he pilots Red 5, also add 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition less than 3. '''Lore:''' Anakin Skywalker's son and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s apprentice. He honed his piloting skills by shooting womp rats in Beggar's Canyon from his T-16 skyhopper. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Luke's Cape |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Lukes-Cape-PSA-89673879.jpg |lead='''Luke's Cape''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_35o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Luke's Cape]] (2_35o)

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_35o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Luke's Cape (Errata)]] (2_35d)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Luke's Cape (PC Errata)]]
'''PC Errata 2''' — [[Luke's Cape (PC Errata 2)]] (2_35) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ルークのケープ |printed_game_text=2フォース使用して任意の反乱軍かエイリアンに配備する。そのキャラクターは耐：損耗＜3を得る。加えて、「ルークのケープ」がタトゥイーン以外の位置カード上に配備されているなら、毎ターン余分に1フォース起動できる。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Lukes-Cape-PSA-89673879.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ルークがパイロットとしてこれから繰り広げる冒険と、迫り来る運命を象徴するかのようにはためくケープ。「おまえは今、新たな世界への一歩を踏み出したのだ」'' |translation='''Title:''' Luke's Cape. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on any Rebel or alien. That character gains immunity to attrition less than 3. If Luke’s Cape is deployed at a location card other than Tatooine, you may also activate one extra Force each turn. '''Lore:''' Luke’s cape billows as if to symbolize his future adventures as a pilot and the destiny approaching him. “You have now taken a step into a new world.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face describes Luke’s Cape as deployed at a location card other than Tatooine. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Luke's Cape]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: Luke's Hunting Rifle (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Luke's Hunting Rifle |side=Light |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Lukes-Hunting-Rifle-SWCA-67669.jpg |lead='''Luke's Hunting Rifle''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_79o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Luke's Hunting Rifle]] (2_79o)
'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Luke's Hunting Rifle (Revised)]] (52_79)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_79o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Luke's Hunting Rifle (Errata)]] (2_79)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Luke's Hunting Rifle (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)]] (1115_19)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Luke's Hunting Rifle (V) (Virtual Block 1)]] (1210_172)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Luke's Hunting Rifle (V)]]
'''Virtual Modern Errata''' — [[Luke's Hunting Rifle (V) (Errata)]] (207_19; current full face)
'''Virtual Modern Errata 2''' — [[Luke's Hunting Rifle (V) (Errata 2)]] (bottom-only slip; September 2023 edition) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ルークの狩猟用ライフル |printed_game_text=1フォースを使用してルークかオーウェン・ラーズに配備する。あるいは3フォース使用してドロイド以外のキャラクター（戦士でなくともよい）に配備する。1フォースを使用して起動する。運命数を引く。キャラクターは運命数－1＞能力値なら命中する。生物は運命数＋2＞防御値なら即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Lukes-Hunting-Rifle-SWCA-67669.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''シザーカ6-2オーグ2型。その長銃身を生かして高価なレーザー・スコープなしでも遠距離の目標を狙撃できる。堅牢な作りだが、タスケン・レイダーの使うガダフィの杖ほどの頑丈さはない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Luke's Hunting Rifle. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on Luke or Owen Lars. Or use 3 Force to deploy on a non-droid character (even if not a warrior). Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny minus 1 exceeds ability. A creature is immediately lost if destiny plus 2 exceeds defense value. '''Lore:''' Czerka 6-2Aug2 type. Its long barrel lets it snipe distant targets without an expensive laser scope. The build is sturdy, but not as tough as a Tusken Raider's gaffi stick. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore transliterates Czerka as シザーカ and gaderffii as ガダフィの杖. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Luke's Hunting Rifle]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Card text:''' May carry 3 passengers. Moves for 0 if Luke is aboard. May move as a react to a battle or Force drain within range. '''Lore:''' Skywalker's open SoroSuub speeder. Top speed 250 km/h. Repulsorlift keeps it a meter off the ground, moving or still. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Luke's X-34 Landspeeder]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. text:
{{Card |title=Luke? Luuuuke! |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] — [[Utinni Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Luke-Luuuuke-video.png |lead='''Luke? Luuuuke!''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_223o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=4 |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Luke? Luuuuke!]] (1_223)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊ルーク？どこにいるの、ルーク！ |printed_game_text=任意のタトゥイーンの位置カードに配備する。反乱軍を１つ選んで対象とする。対象は戦闘力と没収値が－１（対象がルークなら－３）される。没収値が０以下になったならそのカードはロストする。対象がこのカードのいる位置に到着すれば、このカードはキャンセルされる。 |printed_lore=''「わかった、今いくよ、ベルー叔母さん」'' |translation='''Title:''' Luke? Where are you, Luke! '''Card text:''' Deploy on any Tatooine location card. Choose one Rebel as a target. The target's power and forfeit are reduced by 1, or by 3 if the target is Luke. If its forfeit becomes 0 or less, the card is lost. This card is canceled when the target reaches its location. '''Lore:''' “All right, I'm coming now, Aunt Beru.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese permits deployment on a Tatooine location card; the English says a Tatooine site. The Japanese says the target is lost if its forfeit becomes zero or less; the English says it is lost if its forfeit reaches zero. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Luke? Luuuuke!]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=292s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 4:52. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Luke-Luuuuke-video.png|Preserved card frame]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: M'iiyoom Onith (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=M'iiyoom Onith |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Miiyoom-Onith-video.png |lead='''M'iiyoom Onith''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_187o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=3 |power=1 |ability=1 |deploy=3 |forfeit=3 |versions='''Decipher''' — [[M'iiyoom Onith]] (1_187o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing'''
'''PC Errata''' — [[M'iiyoom Onith (PC Errata)]] (1_187) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Alien]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=＊ミーユム・オニス |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズに、Ｘフォース消費して、相手の手札をすべて公開させることができる。Ｘ＝相手の手札の枚数である。その中に反乱軍の男性の単一カード（＊）かエイリアンの男性の単一カード（＊）があれば、それらのカードはすべてロストする。 |printed_lore=''ヘネムスィの女性。連れ合いを儀式的に殺す習慣を持つ。航行税で難癖をつけられ、タトゥイーンに足止めをくらっている。舌鋒は鋭く、その名は「夜の百合」を意味する。'' |translation='''Title:''' M'iiyoom Onith. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, you may use X Force to make the opponent reveal their entire hand, where X is the number of cards in that hand. If it contains unique male Rebel or unique male alien cards, all those cards are lost. '''Lore:''' A female H'nemthe, whose kind ritually kills their mates. Held up on Tatooine by an objection over a passage tax. Her tongue is sharp, and her name means “night lily.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore describes an objection over a passage tax, while the English calls the tax questionable. The two game texts both cause the specified unique male Rebel and alien cards in the revealed hand to be lost. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[M'iiyoom Onith]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=295s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 4:55. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Miiyoom-Onith-video.png|Preserved card frame]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] — [[Droid]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-MSE-6-Mouse-Droid-Face.jpg |lead='''MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_188o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |destiny=0 |power=0 |deploy=0 |forfeit=0 |versions='''Decipher''' — [[MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid]] (1_188o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing'''
'''PC Errata''' — [[MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid (PC Errata)]] (1_188) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Droid]][[:File:Japanese-Premiere-MSE-6-Mouse-Droid-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=ＭＳＥ－６ “マウス” ドロイド |printed_game_text=ウーティーニー・エフェクトの対象となっている任意のキャラクターに配備する。キャラクターの代わりに“マウス”ドロイドを移動させて、ウーティーニー・エフェクトを持ち帰ったり、同じ場所に移動して、キャンセルしたりすることができる。移動速度＝３。ウーティーニー・エフェクトを運んだ後、“マウス”ドロイドは手札に戻る。 |printed_lore=''外見から、マウスと呼ばれている。各種命令や重要書類を届けるのが役目。収納式のマニピュレータ内蔵。レバックサン・コルムーニ製。気が小さく、臆病なドロイド。'' |translation='''Title:''' MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any character targeted by an Utinni Effect. Instead of the character, move the 'mouse' droid to bring back the Utinni Effect, or move it to the same place to cancel it. Landspeed = 3. After carrying the Utinni Effect, the 'mouse' droid returns to your hand. '''Lore:''' Called 'mouse' because of its appearance. Its job is to deliver various orders and important documents. Contains retractable manipulators. Made by Rebaxan Colmuni. A timid, cowardly droid. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese describes bringing back the Utinni Effect or moving to the same place to cancel it. The English says to bring it back to be fulfilled or canceled. The Japanese lore calls the droid timid and cowardly; the English describes it as easily frightened. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Macroscan (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)
text:
{{Card |title=Macroscan |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |lead='''Macroscan''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1371_224o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Macroscan]] (1_224)
'''Decipher (Two-Player) (Unlimited)''' — [[Macroscan (Premiere Two-Player) (Unlimited)]] (71_224 51_224)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1371_224o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=望遠スキャン |printed_game_text=２フォース消費して、相手のリザーブデッキのそばに配備する。１フォース消費して、好きなときにそのデッキの一番上のカードを見ることができる。場のどこかに“夜間状態”になっているカードがあれば、１枚ではなく上から３枚のカードを見ることができる。Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-PSA-17-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Macroscan (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Macroscan-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]]. |printed_lore=''電子双眼鏡の映像。目標の方位、高さ、距離が正確に表示される。暗視機能を内蔵する。'' |translation='''Title:''' Long-range scan. '''Card text:''' Spend 2 Force to deploy beside the opponent's Reserve Deck. You may spend 1 Force at any time to look at the top card of that deck. If a card anywhere on the table is in ‘nighttime conditions,’ you may look at the top three cards instead of one. '''Lore:''' An electrobinocular image. The target's direction, height and distance are displayed accurately. It has built-in night vision. text:
{{Card |title=•Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde (as printed) |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] |set=Oversized cards |set_display=None; promotional 5×7 ([[Oversized cards]]) |category_override=[[Category:Cards]][[Category:Light]][[Category:Character]][[Category:2001]] |language=en |navigation=[[Oversized cards]] |hatnote=This is a 5×7 promo with no regular-size version.
