It shows Mara Jade, [[Corran Horn]], and [[Talon Karrde]] together in a single photograph. It was given to customers who spent $20 or more at the Decipher store at conventions.[https://boardgamegeek.com/filepage/33565/star-wars-ccg-complete-card-list-42 Star Wars CCG Complete Card List 4.2], Whaleyland, BoardGameGeek (22 August 2012).[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 108, "Irregularly sized cards". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Wayback, 9 October 2026]. Unlike the other [[Oversized cards|oversized cards]] it has no regular-size counterpart: the Collecting Encyclopedia describes it as a "5” x 7” card, not available as a standard sized card." |size=5×7 inches |year=2001 |destiny=3 |power=8 |ability=5 |deploy=8 |forfeit=9 |icons=[[Pilot]] [[Warrior]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Oversized promo''' — this page |label_versions=Printings |likeness=[[Shannon Baksa]] (Mara Jade); Michael A. Stackpole (Corran Horn); Timothy Zahn (Talon Karrde) |extra_info=Versionprinted |game_text=The game-text box is blank. Decipher's announcement listed it as "No Game Text (you'll need room for autographs!)"[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Yaruas_RFD_Report_622628_72011.asp Yarua's RFD Report (6.22–6.28)], TheForce.net (23 June 2001), quoting Radio Free Decipher (22 June 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150215035122/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/yaruas_rfd_report_622628_72011.asp Wayback, 15 February 2015]. |lore=Each driven by a dubious past, these scoundrels now plan for the greater good of the New Republic. Found in the strangest places. |notes=* '''Stats.''' Destiny 3, Power 8, Ability 5, Deploy 8, Forfeit 9, with Pilot and Warrior icons and Force-Sensitive on the printed card. Radio Free Decipher gave the same numbers in its announcement. * '''Announcement.''' Radio Free Decipher (22 June 2001), reported the next day by Yarua on TheForce.net, said Decipher would make the card available at its summer 2001 convention appearances (Origins, San Diego, GenCon, Wizard World, and DragonCon) so fans could get autographs from [[Shannon Baksa]] (Mara Jade), Michael A. Stackpole (Corran Horn), and Timothy Zahn (Talon Karrde). It listed the card as "Corran Horn & Mara Jade & Talon Karrde". * '''Photography.''' The three had been shot together when Decipher photographed the individual [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] cards, including the [[Corran Horn]] and [[Talon Karrde]] premiums. The Mara Jade side of the shoot is covered at [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]]. * '''Back.''' Rebel Alliance symbol, decipher.com, and starwars.com.[https://www.nobleknight.com/P/2148343730/Oversized-Promo---Mara-Jade-and-Corran-Horn-and-Talon-Karrde Oversized Promo - Mara Jade & Corran Horn & Talon Karrde], Noble Knight Games (5×7×0.1 in). The Star Wars Collectors Archive lists it as item 11260, "CCG, Show Premium, 5x7", year 2001, licensee Decipher.[http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11260 Premium Oversize Card, Mara Jade, Corran Horn & Talon Karrde], Star Wars Collectors Archive. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130621235647/http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11260 Wayback, 21 June 2013]. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon (Errata)]] (3_77-DE) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=中型連射ブラスター・キャノン |printed_game_text=任意の位置に配備する。1フォース余分に支払うことにより、2名の戦士で移動させることができる。同じ場所にいる自分の戦士が、2フォース消費して同じか隣接する位置にいる2名のキャラクターを目標として起動できる。運命数を2枚引く。運命数＞能力値の合計で、両方のキャラクターに命中する。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Medium-Repeating-Blaster-Cannon-PSA-80497042.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''マーソン・マークII連射式ブラスター。様々な種類の動力源を使用できるため、補給物資に事欠く反乱軍にとっては使い勝手がよい。'' |translation='''Title:''' Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon. Draw two destiny. Both characters are hit if destiny exceeds total ability. '''Lore:''' A Merr-Sonn Mark II repeating blaster. It can use many kinds of power sources, so it is convenient for Rebels who often lack supplies. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 固定兵器. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. text:
{{Card |title=Merc Sunlet |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Merc-Sunlet-SWCA-67708.jpg |lead='''Merc Sunlet''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_36o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Merc Sunlet]] (2_36o)

'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Merc Sunlet (Errata)]] (2_36)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Merc Sunlet (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_15) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=マーク・サンレット |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：盗賊以外のキャラクターに配備して盗賊の能力を与える。自分の支配フェイズに、同じ位置カード上にあるアイテムを1つ目標にできる。運命数を引く。運命数＜目標の運命数なら、それを“盗む”。2：武器か兵器に配備して、盗まれるのを防ぐ。（このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない）[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Merc-Sunlet-SWCA-67708.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ティラック・ムンダ出身、頭が切れて気の良い泥棒。金持ちに雇われて、財産を護るための助言を与えることも多い。旅なれており、さまざまな言語に精通している。'' |translation='''Title:''' Merc Sunlet. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Deploy on a non-thief to give thief skill. During your control phase, may target one Item at the same location card. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than the target's destiny, it is stolen. 2: Deploy on a weapon to prevent theft. This Effect is not affected by Alter. '''Lore:''' A clever, good-natured thief from Tirac Munda. The wealthy often hire him to advise on protecting property. He is well traveled and skilled in many languages. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses numbered choose-one. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Merc Sunlet]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_107o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=隕石でも落ちたのかな？ |printed_game_text=2フォース消費して屋外の惑星位置に配備する。同じ惑星上のキャラクターを1人目標とする。キャラクターは惑星から離れたり、ウーティーニー・エフェクトから遠ざかることができない。目標がウーティーニー・エフェクトに到着したらウーティーニー・エフェクトはロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Meteor-Impact-Category1Games-820s.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「近くに隕石が落ちたみたいだ。調べてから帰るよ。すぐ済むと思う」'' |translation='''Title:''' Meteor Impact?. '''Card text:''' Spend 2 Force to deploy to an outdoor planet location. Target one character on the same planet. The character cannot leave the planet or move farther away from the Utinni Effect. When the target reaches the Utinni Effect, the Utinni Effect is lost. '''Lore:''' “It looks like a meteorite fell nearby. I’ll check it out before coming back. I don’t think it’ll take long.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses “outdoor planet location” and ロストする (“is lost”) for the arrival sentence. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Meteor Impact?]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Virtual Modern''' — [[Millennium Falcon (V)]] (220_7) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Starship]] [[Nav Computer]] [[Scomp Link]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=ミレニアム・ファルコン |printed_game_text=パイロットを2名、乗客を2名まで乗せられる。ハン、チューイーかランドが操縦していれば、耐：損耗<5を得る。ドッキング能力を持つ。パイロットがいなければ、戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使えない。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Millennium-Falcon-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''YT-1300貨物船の改造版。ランド・カルリシアンがサバックの賭で負けて、ハンに譲った。全長26.7メートル。「見てくれは悪いが、中身はすごいんだぜ！」'' |translation='''Title:''' Millennium Falcon '''Card text:''' May carry 2 pilots and up to 2 passengers. If Han, Chewie or Lando is piloting, gains immunity to attrition <5. Has docking capability. Without a pilot, cannot use power, maneuver or hyperspeed. '''Lore:''' A modified YT-1300 freighter. Lando Calrissian lost a sabacc bet and handed it over to Han. Overall length 26.7 meters. "It may look bad, but it's amazing inside!" '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese calls the docking capability ドッキング能力. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Millennium Falcon]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. '''Virtual Original''' — [[Molator (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour)]] (1102_42)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Molator (V)]] (1210_46) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=モレイトア |printed_game_text=場の自分の側に配備する。戦闘の際、能力値があるカードを何枚か選ぶ。カード一枚につき合計戦闘力に＋１の修正を得る。それぞれに１フォースを消費する。この効果のために使ったカードの能力値は、運命数を引く際に数えない。 |printed_lore=''デジャリック・ホロゲームに登場する、オルデランの伝説上の動物。伝承によれば、モレイトアは強力な魔力を持ち、オルデラン諸国の王や王女を護衛したという。'' |translation='''Title:''' Molator. '''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. During battle, choose some cards with ability. For each card, gain a +1 adjustment to total power. Use 1 Force for each. The ability of cards used for this effect does not count when drawing destiny. '''Lore:''' A legendary animal of Alderaan appearing in the dejarik hologame. According to tradition, molators possessed powerful magic and guarded the kings and princesses of Alderaan's nations. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card describes choosing cards with ability and gaining +1 power per card; the English describes gaining +1 for each unit of ability present. The Japanese lore describes kings and princesses; the English says kings and queens. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Molator]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_20o) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Alien]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=モモー・ネイドン |printed_game_text=支配フェイズに、同じ位置にいる動物（バンサ、デューバック、ワンパ、ランコア、ブーボ、ドラゴンスネーク）を罠にかける（盗む）ことができる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-momaw-nadon-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''樹木を愛し、ハンマー・ヘッド（カナヅチ頭）と蔑称されるアイソリアンの男性。動植物の繁殖、栽培の名手。栽培船の元指揮官。反乱軍のスパイ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Momaw Nadon. '''Card text:''' During the control phase, he may trap, or steal, an animal at the same site: a bantha, dewback, wampa, rancor, Bubo, or dragonsnake. '''Lore:''' A tree-loving male Ithorian derogatorily called Hammerhead. An expert in breeding animals and cultivating plants. Former commander of a cultivation ship. A Rebel spy. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Card text:''' When opponent loses Force by Force drain at Mosep's location or an adjacent location, the Force must be lost from Reserve Deck. '''Lore:''' A Nimbanel who keeps Jabba's books. Through inside contacts he disrupts the cash flow of the Hutt's enemies. He takes to heart that if he fails, he will be the next “write-off.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese フォース消耗 is Force drain. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Mosep]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Will not forgive anyone who calls him “one-eye.” |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Myo]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_97o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ネイブラン・リーズ |printed_game_text=ネイブランを雇って、ある位置カードにいる自分のキャラクターの中から好きなだけ、他の位置カードに移動させることができる。ネイブランの要求額を決定するため運命数を引く。その分のフォースを払えば引き受ける。払わねばネイブランは離れる（ロストデッキへ）。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-97o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''四本腕の密輸屋で、雇われパイロット。モアシーリアンの男性。メタンを呼吸する。元戦闘機パイロット。値段次第でどこにでも連れていってくれる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Nabrun Leids. He will take you anywhere for the right price. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Nabrun Leids]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Narrow Escape (Errata)]] (1_98) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=九死に一生 |printed_game_text=能力値＞２の反乱軍がいる位置カードで、戦闘が始まった直後なら、そこにいる自分のキャラクターを全員移動させることにより（移動コストは通常どおり）、戦闘をキャンセルできる。全員を移動させられる場合にしか使用できない。Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-98o-Video.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Narrow Escape (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Narrow-Escape-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]]. |printed_lore=''戦闘時、外壁破損の際、あるいは保安上の判断で、ブラスト・ドアは区画を封鎖する。厚いドアはブラスター・ライフルの銃火を寄せ付けない。'' |translation='''Title:''' A narrow escape. Use only if all of them can move. '''Lore:''' Blast doors seal off compartments in battle, when the hull is breached, or for security. Thick doors stop blaster-rifle fire. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese may be used only if all of those characters can move. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Narrow Escape]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. text:
{{Card |title=Nevar Yalnal |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] — [[Lost Interrupt]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Nevar-Yalnal-Face.jpg |lead='''Nevar Yalnal''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_261o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |destiny=6 |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Nevar Yalnal]] (1_261o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing'''
'''PC Errata''' — [[Nevar Yalnal (PC Errata)]] (1_261) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ネヴァー・ヤルナル |printed_game_text=双方のプレイヤーが同じ位置カード上にスパイを配備している時に使う。相手のスパイは運命数を引き、運命数＞２ならロストする。スパイが潜伏しているなら、運命数＞０でロストする。 |printed_lore=''アラリア出身のラナットとしては大柄の死体あさり。金次第で誰にでもつき、部族から追放された。狡猾なスパイで、追放者。サウリンのドロイド商人、ハーチェクに雇われている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Nevar Yalnal. '''Card text:''' Use when both players have a spy deployed on the same location card. The opponent's spy draws destiny and is lost if destiny is greater than 2. If the spy is undercover, it is lost if destiny is greater than 0. '''Lore:''' A scavenger from Aralia who is large for a Ranat. Sides with anyone for money and was exiled from his tribe. A cunning spy and an outcast. Employed by Hrchek, a Saurin droid trader. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text says the same location card, while the English specifies the same site. Its wording makes the opponent's spy the grammatical subject of drawing destiny; the English simply directs the player to draw destiny. The Japanese lore adds that he was exiled from his tribe. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Nevar Yalnal]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Ng'ok |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Ngok-SWCA-67788.jpg |lead='''Ng'ok''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_136o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Ng'ok]] (2_136o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_136o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Ng'ok (PC Errata)]] (2_136) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ヌゴック |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：このターンに相手が4人以上のキャラクターを同じ位置に配備した場合に使用する。それらのキャラクターは全員、このターンの間は戦闘を行えない。2：相手が戦闘に対して“リアクション”を行った直後に使用する。その戦闘をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Ngok-SWCA-67788.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''デジャリックのホログラムに登場する戦闘獣ヌゴック。ねじけた気性でいつも機嫌が悪い。カミソリのように鋭い鉤爪は伸縮自在。あちこちの星系で番犬がわりに使用されている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Ng'ok. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Use if opponent deployed four or more characters at the same location this turn. Those characters cannot battle this turn. 2: Use just after opponent reacted to a battle. Cancel that battle. '''Lore:''' Ng'ok war beast from a dejarik hologram. Its twisted temper leaves it always in a bad mood. Razor-sharp retractable claws. Used as a watchdog in various star systems. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses numbered choose-one and 位置. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Ng'ok]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. text:
{{Card |title=Nightfall |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Narrow Escape (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[Noble Sacrifice (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Nightfall-Face.jpg |lead='''Nightfall''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_56o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Uncommon1 |rarity_display=Uncommon1 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unrestricted |destiny=3 |icons=[[Effect]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Nightfall]] (1_56)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_56o)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Nightfall (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour)]] (1102_15)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Nightfall (V)]] (1210_132) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=夕暮れ[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Nightfall-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=任意の星系カード（惑星）に配備することで、その星系の位置カードを“夜間状態”にする。戦闘が起こった場合、運命数1枚を引いて戦闘力に足すこと。これは、普通の戦闘運命数とは別であり、損耗には足されない。“夜間状態”にある場所には、スパイを配備コストなしに配備できる。 |printed_lore=タトゥイーンの双子の太陽、タトゥIとタトゥIIは、過酷な砂漠の世界を創り出したが、壮観な日没も与えてくれた。夜には、影の中から多くの危険が現れる。 |translation='''Title:''' Dusk. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any system card (planet) to put that system's location cards under “nighttime conditions.” When a battle occurs, draw one destiny and add it to power. This is separate from ordinary battle destiny and is not added to attrition. Spies can deploy without deployment cost to locations under “nighttime conditions.” '''Lore:''' Tatooine's twin suns, Tatoo I and Tatoo II, created a harsh desert world, but also provide spectacular sunsets. At night, many dangers emerge from the shadows. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese explicitly explains that the extra destiny is separate from ordinary battle destiny and does not add to attrition. It does not explicitly say “both sides,” as the English printing does. The Japanese title means “Dusk.”[[:File:Premiere-L-nightfall.gif|Nightfall original English printed face]]. |sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 99 (Japanese Premiere checklist). |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

{{Card |title=Obi-Wan's Lightsaber |side=Light |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-157o-Face.jpg |lead='''Obi-Wan's Lightsaber''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_157o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=1 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Obi-Wan's Lightsaber]] (1_157o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_157o)
'''Decipher (Japanese Reflections III foil)''' — [[Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (Japanese Reflections III Foil)]] |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=オビ＝ワンのライトセーバー |printed_game_text=オビ＝ワンにのみ配備できる（フォース不要）。次の二つの効果がある。今いる場所のフォース消耗に＋１できる。フォース消費無しで起動する。運命数を２枚引き、キャラクターには、合計運命数＞能力値ならば、命中したことになり、命中したキャラクターの没収値を０として扱う。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-157o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「知恵の支配した時代にこそなじむ洗練された武器だ。」小型パワーセルのエネルギーを希少なクリスタルで収束し、光の刃を生成する。このセーバーは、オビ＝ワンの自作である。'' |translation='''Title:''' Obi-Wan's Lightsaber. '''Card text:''' Deploy only on Obi-Wan at no Force cost. It has two effects. You may add 1 to the Force drain at his current location. Fire at no Force cost and draw two destinies. If total destiny exceeds the target character's ability, the character is hit and its forfeit is treated as 0. '''Lore:''' “A refined weapon suited to an age ruled by wisdom.” A rare crystal focuses energy from a small power cell to form a blade of light. Obi-Wan built this saber himself. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Obi-Wan's Lightsaber]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Observation Holocam (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Observation Holocam |side=Dark |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-204o-Face.jpg |lead='''Observation Holocam''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_204o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Observation Holocam]] (1_204o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_204o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=監視用ホロカメラ |printed_game_text=任意の位置カード上に配備する。移動はできない。その場所および隣接する位置に、自分の自動化兵器が配備されていれば、すべてその武器運命数に１を加えることができる。また、ホロカメラを配備した位置カードにおける戦闘の際、隣接する君が支配している位置カードにキャラクターがいれば、１名を選んで、その戦闘力を加えることができる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-204o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ドロイド操作用の補助保安システムを応用した遠隔監視ビューアー。必要に応じて警報や自動化兵器を作動させ、その地点に増援を向かわせる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Surveillance Holocam. '''Card text:''' Deploy at any site. Cannot move. You may add 1 to the weapon destiny of each of your automated weapons deployed here or at an adjacent site. In a battle at this site, you may choose one character at an adjacent site you control and add that character's power. '''Lore:''' A remote viewer adapted from an auxiliary droid-operated security system. It activates alarms or automated weapons as needed and directs reinforcements to the location. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Observation Holocam]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

One asterisk precedes the printed title. |printed_game_text=操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。デス・スターの位置カード上にいるなら、帝国軍の宇宙船は"リアクション"としてデス・スターの星系カードに移動できる。 |printed_lore=帝国軍情報部に属するリーダーで、反乱軍艦隊の進路を予想する正確な追跡情報を握っている。彼は巧みな宇宙船配備及び移動計画で、多くの基地の弱点を補ってきた。 |translation='''Title''' — [[Officer Evax]]. '''Lore''' — This Imperial Intelligence leader holds accurate tracking data that predicts Rebel fleet courses. With skillful starship deployment and movement plans, he has covered the weaknesses of many bases. '''Game text''' — Add 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If he is at a Death Star location card, Imperial starships may move to the Death Star system card as a “react.” |translation_note=位置カード vs site, 星系カード vs system, and "リアクション" vs 'react'. Lore says he holds tracking data and has covered base weaknesses, not that he saved vulnerable bases.[[:File:ANH-D-officerevax-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Officer Evax]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

[[File:Japanese-Hoth-Oh-Switch-Off-PSA-93899909.jpg|thumb|center|340px|Japanese Oh, Switch Off printing.]] |gemp_id=1303_130o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Common2 |rarity_display=Common2 |edition=[[Hoth (Japanese)]] |border_finish=Black border / nonfoil |release=September 1998 |destiny=6 |uniqueness=No printed uniqueness marker |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Oh, Switch Off]] (3_130o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this page''' (1303_130o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Oh, Switch Off (PC Errata)]] (3_130) |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=Printed subtypeユーズド・インタラプト Subtype[[Used Interrupt]] Copyright year1998 |printed_title=スイッチよ、切れてしまえ！. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title. |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分のドロイド1体が、破壊、捕獲、または盗まれる時に使う。その効果をキャンセルする。ターンの終わりまでドロイドはこれらの効果の対象にならない。2：このターンの終わりまで “バイナリ” ドロイドのスイッチをオフにする。 |printed_lore=そんな機能を持ち合わせぬR2に、あまりにごむたいな3POのお言葉… |translation='''Title''' — [[Oh, Switch Off]]. '''Lore''' — Such outrageous words from 3PO to R2, who has no such function. '''Game text''' — Choose one. Use when one of your droids would be destroyed, captured, or stolen. Cancel that effect. Until the end of the turn, the droid is not a target of those effects. Until the end of this turn, switch off a “binary” droid. |translation_note=The title ends with an exclamation. Lore is about 3PO’s outrageous words to R2, not the English grease line. Game text numbers two choices and says the droid is not a target of those effects.[[:File:Hoth-D-ohswitchoff-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Oh, Switch Off]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''PC Errata''' — [[Old Ben (PC Errata)]] (1_100) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ベン翁 |printed_game_text=君のキャラクターのどれか（除くオビ＝ワン）がタトゥイーン位置カードから没収された際、１フォース消費すれば、謎の“狂える魔術師”が立ち寄って復活させてくれる。フォースを消費せずに、同じ場所に再配備すること。Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-100o-Video.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Old Ben (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Old-Ben-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「あの老いぼれは、気のふれた魔術師にすぎぬ」オビ＝ワンは何年もの間、タトゥイーンの砂漠で生活していた……来るべき時のために。'' |translation='''Title:''' Old Ben. '''Card text:''' When one of your characters (except Obi-Wan) is forfeited from a Tatooine site, use 1 Force and a mysterious “crazy wizard” steps in and revives that character. Re-deploy to the same site without using Force. '''Lore:''' “That old man's just a crazy wizard.” Obi-Wan lived in Tatooine's deserts for years… ready for the right moment. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Old Ben]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_101o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=絶体絶命 |printed_game_text=１フォース消費して、能力値＞２の反乱軍の一人（場のカード）を選ぶ。１から６の中から数字を一つ選ぶ。引いた運命数＞選んだ数なら、ロストデッキから選んだ数と同じ枚数だけフォースを再使用できる。失敗したら、選んだ反乱軍はロストデッキへ。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-101o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ルークとレイアは、ストームトルーパーから逃れようとして、デス・スター中心部にかけられた収納された橋の終端から危うく落ちかけた。トルーパーの追撃がドアの向こうに迫る。'' |translation='''Title:''' On the edge. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_137o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ウータ、グータ、ソロ？ |printed_game_text=いずれかを選ぶ。1：ネイブラン・リーズがキャラクターを移動させた直後に2フォース消費して使用する。ネイブランはロストし、移動した反乱軍は捕まる。このインタラプトは「感知」の影響を受けない。2：配備された直後の密輸屋に対して使用する。その密輸屋はこのターンに移動を行えない。3：「ケッセル・ラン」をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Oo-ta-Goo-ta-Solo-SWCA-67789.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''グリード、チェスポコトウータ、クリース、ルヤ、ソロ。ホコ、ヤニー、ブパ、ガシュ、カンティーナ。チーコ、ワ、ソロズ、アナイ、ニュマ、グリード、ヴァキー。ジャバ、カル、スティーカ、アッツアツァンパ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?. This Interrupt is not affected by Sense. 2: Use on a just-deployed smuggler. That smuggler may not move this turn. 3: Cancel Kessel Run. '''Lore:''' Greedo, Chespokotouta, Klees, Ruya, Solo. Hoko, Yanee, Bupa, Gashu, Cantina. Cheeco, Wa, Soloz, Anai, Nyuma, Greedo, Vakee. Jabba, Kal, Steeka, Attsatsanpa. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore is a katakana reading of the English Huttese, with Japanese commas. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. text:
{{Card |title=Organa's Ceremonial Necklace |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-PSA-13-Face.jpg |lead='''Organa's Ceremonial Necklace''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_226o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Organa's Ceremonial Necklace]] (1_226)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing'''
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Organa's Ceremonial Necklace (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)]] (1116_60)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Organa's Ceremonial Necklace (V)]] (1210_47) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=オーガナ家の式典用ネックレス |printed_game_text=任意のヤヴィン４の位置カードに配備する。帝国軍カードを１つ対象に選ぶ。このカードと同じ位置に着けば、ネックレスを“盗んだ”ことになる。以後、ネックレスがある位置では、フォース消耗を＋１できる。さらに、隣接している位置カードを支配していれば、そこへコストなしで移動させ、フォース消耗に＋１できる。以降、繰り返し。 |printed_lore=''レイア姫がヤヴィンの戦勝祝典でつけていたネックレス。オルデランの統治者に何十世代も伝わる力を秘めた工芸品。'' |translation='''Title:''' The Organa family's ceremonial necklace. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any Yavin 4 location card. Choose an Imperial card as the target. When it reaches the same location as this card, the necklace is ‘stolen.’ Thereafter, at the location where the necklace is, you may add 1 to the Force drain. In addition, if you control an adjacent location card, you may move it there at no cost and add 1 to the Force drain. Repeat thereafter. '''Lore:''' The necklace Princess Leia wore at the Yavin victory celebration. A crafted object with hidden power, passed down among Alderaan's rulers for dozens of generations. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a Yavin 4 location card and an Imperial card; the English specifies a Yavin 4 site and targets an Imperial. The Japanese says the drain may be increased at the necklace's location and describes moving it to an adjacent controlled location. The English describes passing it to an adjacent controlled site during Force drains. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Organa's Ceremonial Necklace]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Card text:''' Deploy on Alderaan. Target a Rebel on Tatooine. When the target reaches this Utinni Effect, retrieve 1 Force for each of your Force-attuned characters on table, or 2 for each Force-sensitive character or Jedi. Send the Utinni Effect to the Lost Pile. '''Lore:''' Following her adoptive father Bail Organa's instructions, Leia hid the Death Star plans inside R2-D2, hoping Obi-Wan Kenobi would deliver them safely to Alderaan. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Our Most Desperate Hour]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_103o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=パニック |printed_game_text=相手が２倍以上の合計戦闘力を持っている位置カードで、相手が戦闘を宣言したら、直後に使用する。君のリザーブデッキから最大で３枚のカードを引ける。引いたカードがキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークル、武器のいずれかであれば、どこに配備してもよい（コスト不要）。その他のカードならロストデッキへ。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-103o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国軍兵士によって追いつめられた時、ハンのギャンブラーならではの条件反射が働いた。先手必勝だ！こっちから急襲すれば、不意をつける……かもしれない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Panic. '''Card text:''' Use immediately after the opponent initiates a battle at a site where the opponent has at least double your total power. Draw up to 3 cards from your Reserve Deck. Deploy any of those that are characters, starships, vehicles, or weapons anywhere for free. The rest go to the Lost Pile. '''Lore:''' Cornered by Imperial troops, Han's gambler reflexes kicked in. Strike first! A sudden attack might catch them off guard. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese may deploy characters, starships, vehicles, or weapons; the English also allows devices. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Panic]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. It is the strongest of the Rebellion’s surface artillery weapons. Because few exist, it can be deployed only at tactically important facilities. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 固定兵器. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Planet Defender Ion Cannon]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on any combat vehicle or shuttle vehicle. Use 1 Force to activate targeting an AT-AT or AT-ST. Draw destiny. The target “crashes” if destiny plus the vehicle’s maneuver is greater than 8. Your vehicle “crashes” if destiny equals 0. '''Lore:''' A powerful harpoon with a fusion-disk tip, attached to a cable with a retractor. Beryl Chiffonage designed it as a reserve weapon against AT-ATs. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is ビークル用兵器. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Power Harpoon]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_97o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Probe Antennae (Errata)]] (3_97) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=プローブ・アンテナ |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：任意のプローブ・ドロイドに配備する。Xの値に2を加える。2：1フォース消費してそれ以外の自分のドロイドの1体に配備する。自分が支配している位置にいるなら、毎ターン1回、自分の支配フェイズに、相手の手札から無作為に1枚選んで見ることができる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Probe-Antennae-PSA-88099869.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''プローブ・ドロイドはメッセージを暗号化しスクランブルをかけた後に、アンテナを伸ばしてハイパー・スペースに向けて送信する。'' |translation='''Title:''' Probe Antennae. '''Card text:''' Choose one. Deploy on any Probe Droid. Add 2 to X. Use 1 Force to deploy on one of your other droids. If at a location you control, once each turn during your control phase, you may look at one card chosen at random from opponent’s hand. '''Lore:''' A probe droid encodes and scrambles a message, then extends its antenna and transmits it toward hyperspace. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is プローブ・アンテナ (singular). |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Probe Antennae]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Virtual Original''' — [[Probe Droid (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)]] (1104_43)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Probe Droid (V)]] (1220_15) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=プローブ・ドロイド |printed_game_text=場にスター・デストロイヤーが出ていないと配備できない。自分の支配フェイズにＸフォース消費して相手の手札から無作為にＸ枚のカードを選んで見ることができる。Ｘ＝同じ位置のライトサイド・フォースアイコンの数である。フォース消耗を行い、戦闘を宣言し、また宣言されることができる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Probe-Droid-PSA-84363906.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''アラキッド製ヴァイパー・プローブ・ドロイド。反乱軍の活動の痕跡を探知するための特製センサーを装備。自爆装置付。耐衝撃性に優れるスパイ・ドロイド。'' |translation='''Title:''' Probe Droid. '''Card text:''' May not deploy unless a Star Destroyer is on table. During your control phase, you may spend X Force to look at X cards chosen at random from the opponent’s hand. X equals the number of Light Side Force icons at the same location. May Force drain, initiate battle, and be battled. '''Lore:''' An Arakyd Viper probe droid. Equipped with special sensors to detect traces of Rebel activity. Has a self-destruct device. A durable spy droid. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 位置 for the icon count. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Probe Droid]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. {{Card |title=Probe Droid Laser |side=Dark |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Probe-Droid-Laser-PSA-88099887.jpg |lead='''Probe Droid Laser''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_161o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Probe Droid Laser]] (3_161o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_161o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Probe Droid Laser (Errata)]] (3_161) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=プローブ・ドロイド・レーザー |printed_game_text=任意のプローブ・ドロイドに配備する。フォースを消費せずに起動する。運命数を引く。目標がキャラクターなら運命数＞能力値で命中する。目標が固定兵器なら運命数＞5で即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Probe-Droid-Laser-PSA-88099887.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''プローブ・ドロイドは相手に見つからないことを第1とするが、多くのモデルにはレーザーを装備することができ、戦闘力や秘密工作活動の能力を向上させられる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Probe Droid Laser. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any Probe Droid. Activate without spending Force. Draw destiny. A character target is hit if destiny is greater than ability. An artillery weapon target is immediately lost if destiny is greater than 5. '''Lore:''' A probe droid’s first concern is not being found, but many models can mount a laser, improving combat power and sabotage ability. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 個人用兵器, not Character Weapon. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Probe Droid Laser]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Probe Telemetry |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Probe-Telemetry-PSA-86099790.jpg |lead='''Probe Telemetry''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_132o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Probe Telemetry]] (3_132)

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Probe Telemetry (V) (Virtual Block 2)]] (1220_63)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Probe Telemetry (V)]] (223_21) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=プローブ・ドロイド遠隔通信 |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：2フォース消費して任意のロストデッキから、X枚の単一ではないカードを探してきて除外カードとする。X＝場に出ているプローブ・ドロイドの数である。2：特定の惑星上にいる自分のキャラクターがプローブ・ドロイドだけであった場合に使用する。このターンの終わりまで、同じ惑星の位置には自分のカードを－1で配備できる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Probe-Telemetry-PSA-86099790.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''プローブドロイドは電磁波、振動、音波、嗅覚、視覚の全センサーを有している。これらの装置が収集した情報は全信号形態の基準統一コードで送信される。'' |translation='''Title:''' Probe Telemetry. '''Card text:''' Choose one. Use 2 Force to search any Lost Pile and place X non-unique cards out of play. X is the number of Probe Droids on table. Use if your only character on a given planet is a Probe Droid. Until the end of this turn, your cards may deploy −1 to locations on the same planet. '''Lore:''' Probe droids have electromagnetic, vibration, acoustic, olfactory, and visual sensors. Data they collect is sent in an all-signal-form standard unified code. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is プローブ・ドロイド遠隔通信, adding ドロイド. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Probe Telemetry]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

title: Program Trap (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Program Trap |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Program-Trap-SWCA-67752.jpg |lead='''Program Trap''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_124o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Program Trap]] (2_124o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_124o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Program Trap (PC Errata)]] (2_124)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Program Trap (V)]] (1262_10) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=プログラム・トラップ |printed_game_text=2フォース消費して敵のドロイドに配備する。あるいは1フォース消費して自分のドロイドに配備する。R2-D2とC-3POには配備できない。その後、いずれかのプレイヤーが、ドロイドと同じ位置にいるキャラクターの人数と同じ数の運命数を引いたら、ドロイドが爆発する。一緒にいるすべてのキャラクターはロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Program-Trap-SWCA-67752.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国軍のコンピュータ技術者は、ドロイドの基本動作プログラムに秘密の指令を潜ませる。定められた条件が生じると過負荷がかかり、ドロイドもろとも周囲のものを破壊するのだ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Program Trap. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on an opponent's droid, or 1 Force to deploy on your droid. Cannot deploy on R2-D2 or C-3PO. After that, if either player draws a destiny equal to the number of characters at the droid's location, the droid explodes. All characters with it are lost. '''Lore:''' Imperial computer technicians hide a secret command in a droid's basic operating program. When a set condition arises, overload destroys the droid and everything around it. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text splits the 2-Force and 1-Force costs into two sentences and uses 位置 instead of site. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Program Trap]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: Prophetess (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Prophetess |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-PSA-19-Face.jpg |lead='''Prophetess''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_191o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |power=1 |ability=4 |deploy=3 |forfeit=2 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Prophetess]] (1_191)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing'''
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)]] (1101_12)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Prophetess (V)]] (1210_17) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Alien]][[:File:Japanese-Premiere-PSA-19-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=女予言者 |printed_game_text=女預言者のいる場所で戦闘を宣言した場合、戦闘を開始する前に、どちらが勝つかを予測して相手に告げる（必ず行うこと）。戦闘の結果が予測どおりなら、君はロストしたカードを無作為に１枚、再使用できる。予測がはずれたなら、１フォースを失う。耐：損耗＜３。 |printed_lore=''名高い超能力者。凶運を察知する女性。タトゥイーンの統治者アリオンの使者。ハン・ソロに会うため、ドッキング・ベイ94に向かったジャバと手下どもの後をつけた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Prophetess. '''Card text:''' If you declare a battle where the Prophetess is, predict which side will win and tell the opponent before the battle starts; you must do this. If the outcome matches your prediction, you may randomly reuse one lost card. If the prediction is wrong, lose 1 Force. Immune to attrition < 3. The English requires a prediction and says to randomly retrieve one lost card. The Japanese lore says Jabba's party went to meet Han; the English says they confronted him. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Prophetess]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |translation=English reading aid translated from the Japanese face; AI translation independently checked against the Japanese face. Title: R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) Lore:
A small-bodied droid brimming with energy, loyal to his master and brave. A Rebel spy who is strong in adversity. Though 3PO derided him as a “cold-hearted philosopher,” his personality is rather the opposite. He is somewhat restless and sometimes acts unexpectedly.
Card text:
Adds +2 to the power, maneuver and hyperspeed of the starfighter he is aboard (+3 if Red 5). When he is at a place with an access link and the opponent draws destiny, activate 1 Force if it is 1–3. If it is 4–6, draw the top card of the Reserve Deck and add it to your hand.
=== Comparison with the English printing === The Japanese lore says that 3PO derided R2-D2 as a “cold-hearted philosopher”; the English face instead calls R2-D2 the “Incorrigible counterpart of a mindless philosopher.” The Japanese game text uses アクセス・リンク (access link) for the English Scomp link and states the two results directly, without words corresponding to the English “you may.” It expressly adds the drawn Reserve Deck card to the hand. The printed numerical statistics match the inspected English face. Neither inspected face prints a Nav Computer symbol; a later rule-derived capability must not be presented as a printed icon.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. The comparison uses the [[:File:ANH-L-r2d2.gif|original English card face]]. |see_also=* [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)|English counterpart]] * [[A New Hope (Japanese)#Card list|Japanese A New Hope card list]] * [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese|Japanese printings]] |see_also_heading=See also |has_refs=1 |extra_sections=

Statistics

The printed values and symbols are shown above. The face prints one Droid symbol and the subtype 操縦ドロイド (astromech droid). It has no printed ability number and no printed Nav Computer, Pilot or Warrior symbol. Its lore identifies a Rebel spy.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. Base landspeed is 1 under the character movement rule; this is a rule-derived value, not a printed statistic.[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0#Landspeed|Rulebook 2.0, Landspeed]]: “Characters have landspeed of 1.” The 1998 Glossary states that astromech droids provide nav computers. This is a rule-derived capability, separate from the absence of a printed Nav Computer symbol on this face.[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary (1998)]], pp. 15 and 94, “astromech” and “nav computer icon”. The same Glossary gives droids no ability and gives droids without armor a defense value of zero.[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary (1998)]], p. 52, “droid”. |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Virtual Original''' — [[Reactor Terminal (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_42) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=反応炉制御盤 |printed_game_text=１フォース消費して、場の自分の側に配備する。自分の支配フェイズに、手札の中からカードを好きな枚数だけ選び、自分のユーズド・デッキの一番上にもどすことができる。 |printed_lore=''デス・スターには主反応炉から分岐した制御盤がいくつもあり、巨大なスペース・ステーションの動力供給を制御している。'' |translation='''Title:''' Reactor control panel. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on your side of the table. During your control phase, you may choose as many cards as you like from your hand and return them to the top of your Used Pile. '''Lore:''' The Death Star has many control panels branching off from the main reactor, controlling the power supply of the immense space station. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese spells out choosing any desired number of cards from the hand; the English says any cards from your hand. Both specify a cost of 1 Force to deploy, the control phase, and the top of the Used Pile. The Japanese title and lore call the terminal a control panel.[ Japanese and English printed faces], swccgBoosterBreaks, 5:50. |sources=* [ Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [ original Reactor Terminal photograph]. * [ Reactor Terminal Japanese and English printed faces], swccgBoosterBreaks. * [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 99 (Japanese Premiere checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Legacy Errata''' — [[Rebel Tech (V) (Errata)]] (1210_110) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=反乱軍技師 |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：戦闘指揮所に配備されている場合、「アタック・ラン」の合計値に＋1（累積可能）。2：自分の支配フェイズに、この技師をユーズドデッキに送る。リザーブデッキから、「デス・スター：トレンチ」を探して手札に入れる。その後でリザーブデッキをシャッフルし、カットして元の場所に置く。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Rebel-Tech-PSA-164793246.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''デル・ゴーレンは通信とスキャナー妨害の専門家で、同盟軍の高等司令部に所属する以前は、反乱軍の民間型武装コルベット船、スパイラルの乗組員であった。'' |translation='''Title:''' Rebel Tech. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: If deployed at a war room, add 1 to the Attack Run total (cumulative). 2: During your control phase, send this technician to the Used Pile. Search the Reserve Deck for Death Star: Trench and take it into hand. Then shuffle, cut, and replace. '''Lore:''' Del Goren is an expert in communications and scanner jamming. Before he belonged to Alliance High Command, he was a crewman on the Rebel privateer corvette Spiral. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese numbers two choose-one options. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Rebel Tech]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_72o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=レッド6 |printed_game_text=パイロットを1名追加できる。レッド6に対して「トラブルが発生した」を使用する場合、相手は運命数に2を加えられる。パイロットなしでは戦闘力、回避力、航行速度を使用できない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Red-6-PSA-90960110.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ヤヴィンの戦いでジェック・ポーキンズが搭乗したＸウイング。デス・スター攻撃に使用された。コンピュータと飛行システムの最終点検を受けていない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Red 6. '''Card text:''' May add 1 pilot. When A Problem Occurred is used against Red 6, the opponent may add 2 to destiny. Without a pilot, power, maneuver, and hyperspeed cannot be used. '''Lore:''' X-wing that Jek Porkins flew at the Battle of Yavin. It was used in the Death Star attack. It did not receive the final inspection of its computer and flight systems. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore says the X-wing was used in the Death Star attack, not that it was instrumental in strafing success. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Red 6]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_29o) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Rebel]] [[Pilot]] [[Warrior]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=レッド・リーダー |printed_game_text=彼が操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋2。レッド1に乗っていれば、さらに回避値＋1し、戦闘運命数が引けない場合に、1枚だけ引ける。同じ位置にいるレッド中隊の他のパイロットは全員没収値に＋1。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-29o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''Xウイングのパイロット、ガーヴェン・ドライス。ヤヴィンの戦いでレッド中隊を率い、デス・スターの排熱孔に一発打ち込んだが、外れた。ダントウイン反乱軍基地に勤務していた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Red Leader. '''Card text:''' A starship he pilots is power +2. If aboard Red 1, also maneuver +1, and he may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Each other Red Squadron pilot at the same location is forfeit +1. '''Lore:''' X-wing pilot Garven Dreis. Led Red Squadron at Yavin and fired on the Death Star exhaust port, but missed. Served at the Dantooine Rebel base. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Red Leader]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Reegesk (V)]] (1210_18) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=リージェスク |printed_game_text=毎ターン、自分の支配フェイズに、1度だけ、1フォース消費して敵のロスト・デッキか「墜落記念碑」をあさり、ビークル、ドロイド、武器、アイテムのいずれかを1枚、自分の手札にいれて、自分のカードとして使用できる。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Reegesk-PSA-93071762.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''アラリア出身のラナットの盗賊にして廃品あさり。ジャワとの取引が多い。持ち主が気付かぬうちに品物を盗む。ガラクタだろうがなんだろうが、どんなものでも盗みたがる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Reegesk. '''Card text:''' Once each turn during your control phase, spend 1 Force to rummage the opponent's Lost Pile or Crash Site Memorial. Take one vehicle, droid, weapon, or device into hand and use it as your own. '''Lore:''' A Ranat thief and scavenger from Aralia. He often trades with Jawas. He steals goods before the owner notices. He wants to steal anything, even junk. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese spends 1 Force; English loses 1 Force. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Reegesk]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. {{Card |title=Remote |side=Light |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Remote-SWCA-67714.jpg |lead='''Remote''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_28o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Remote]] (2_28o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_28o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Remote (PC Errata)]] (2_28) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=リモート |printed_game_text=1フォースを使用して任意の位置カード上に配備する。キャラクターと同様にフォースを使用して移動できる。自分の支配フェイズに、以下のどちらかを選べる。1：同じ場所にいるキャラクターを一人選び、そのターンの終わりまでの間、戦闘力と没収値を＋1する。2：2フォースを使用して、同じ場所にいるシーカーを1つキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Remote-SWCA-67714.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''シュー。シュー。バシッ！「ふん、リモートと戦えたからって、生身の相手に通用するわけじゃないぜ」'' |translation='''Title:''' Remote. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any location card. May move using Force like a character. During your control phase, choose 1: until the end of the turn, one character at the same place is power and forfeit +1. Or 2: use 2 Force to cancel one seeker at the same place. '''Lore:''' Shoo. Shoo. Bash! Hmph, just because you could fight remotes doesn't mean it works against a living opponent. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Onomatopoeia is シュー／バシッ, not Tshhhh/Zap. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Remote]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Reserve Pilot (V)]] (1210_19) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=予備パイロット |printed_game_text=操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋1。ブラック2、ブラック3、またはブラック4に乗っているなら、回避値＋1となる上に、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、1枚引ける。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Reserve-Pilot-PSA-90960099.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''戦闘による負傷で第一線を退いたベイダー配下の精鋭タイ・パイロット。彼は交代要員として待機しており、いつでも死傷したパイロットの代わりを勤められる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Reserve Pilot. '''Card text:''' Adds 1 to the power of any starship he pilots. If aboard Black 2, Black 3, or Black 4, also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw 1 battle destiny if otherwise unable. '''Lore:''' An elite TIE pilot under Vader who left the front line because of combat injuries. He waits as a replacement and can take the place of a dead or wounded pilot at any time. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore says he left the front line from combat injuries and can replace dead or wounded pilots. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Reserve Pilot]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. text:
{{Card |title=Responsibility Of Command |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Responsibility-Of-Command-PSA-82917272.jpg |lead='''Responsibility Of Command''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_109o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Responsibility Of Command]] (3_109o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_109o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Responsibility Of Command (Errata)]] (3_109) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=司令官の責任 |printed_game_text=2フォース消費して反乱軍基地の戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所上に配備する。没収値＞4の反乱軍か相手のリーダーを目標とする。相手は目標のいる場所では、戦闘を宣言できずフォース消耗も行なえない。目標がウーティーニー・エフェクトに到達したならウーティーニー・エフェクトはキャンセルされる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Responsibility-Of-Command-PSA-82917272.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「本部所属の者は、司令センターに報告を行なえ」'' |translation='''Title:''' Responsibility Of Command. '''Card text:''' Spend 2 Force to deploy to the strategy room or battle command post of a Rebel base. Target a Rebel with forfeit greater than 4 or one of the opponent’s leaders. The opponent cannot initiate a battle or Force drain where the target is. Cancel the Effect when the target reaches it. '''Lore:''' “Headquarters personnel, report to the command center.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses the paired terms 戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Responsibility Of Command]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Restraining Bolt (Japanese ESB Two-Player)]] (1361_38o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=行動規制ボルト |printed_game_text=任意の位置カード上の好きなドロイドに配備する。そのドロイドは移動できず、カードルールを使用できない。同じ位置に別のドロイドがいれば、自分の支配フェイズに行動規制ボルトを（フォースを消費せずに）そのドロイドへ再配備できる。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Restraining-Bolt-Dark-SWCA-100702.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''融合溶接器を使ってドロイドが内包する専用ソケットに固定接続する。ボルトはドロイドの回路を支配し、命令に逆らった場合にはその動きを停止させる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Restraining Bolt (Dark). '''Card text:''' Deploy on any droid you choose at any location card. That droid cannot move or use its card rules. If another droid is at the same location, you may redeploy the Restraining Bolt to that droid during your control phase without spending Force. '''Lore:''' It is fixed to a special socket built into a droid using a fusion welder. The bolt controls the droid’s circuits and stops its movement if it disobeys orders. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Transfer is during 支配フェイズ (control phase), not the deploy phase, and is 再配備. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Restraining Bolt (Dark)]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Restraining-Bolt-Dark-Video-20261106.png|Full-size Japanese and English printed faces]] |lead='''Restraining Bolt''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_205o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Common2 |rarity_display=[[Rarity|Common2]] |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |destiny=6 |uniqueness=Unrestricted |icons=[[Device]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Restraining Bolt]] (1_38)

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_205o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=行動規制ボルト |printed_game_text=任意の位置カード上の好きなドロイドに配備する。そのドロイドは移動できず、カードルールを使用できない。同じ位置に別のドロイドがいれば、自分の支配フェイズに行動規制ボルトを（フォースを消費せずに）そのドロイドへ再配備できる。 |printed_lore=''融合溶接器を使ってドロイドが内包する専用ソケットに固定接続する。ボルトはドロイドの回路を支配し、命令に逆らった場合にはその動きを停止させる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Behavior-restriction bolt. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any droid you choose at any site card. That droid cannot move or use its game text. If another droid is at the same site, you may redeploy the Restraining Bolt to that droid during your control phase (without using Force). '''Lore:''' Fixed to the special socket built into a droid using a fusion welder. The bolt controls the droid's circuits and stops its movement if it disobeys orders. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese printed text specifies your control phase (支配フェイズ) for the free transfer. The English printed text specifies your deploy phase. Both prevent the affected droid from moving or using its game text, and require the other droid to be at the same site.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=352 Japanese and English printed faces], swccgBoosterBreaks, 5:52. text:
{{Card |title=Restraining Bolt |side=Light |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-38o-Face.jpg |lead='''Restraining Bolt''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_38o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=6 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Restraining Bolt]] (1_38)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_38o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Restraining Bolt (Japanese ESB Two-Player)]] (1361_38o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=行動規制ボルト |printed_game_text=任意の位置カード上の好きなドロイドに配備する。そのドロイドは移動できず、カードルールを使用できない。同じ位置に別のドロイドがいれば、自分の支配フェイズに行動規制ボルトを（コストなしで）そのドロイドへ移動できる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-38o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ドロイドの行動を制限し、命令に従わせるためのボルト。体表に露出する専用ソケットに接着する。“コーラー”による遠隔操作が可能。'' |translation='''Title:''' Restraining Bolt. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any droid at any location. That droid cannot move or use its game text. During your control phase, you may move the restraining bolt to another droid at the same location at no cost. '''Lore:''' A bolt that limits a droid's actions and makes it obey orders. It attaches to a dedicated socket exposed on the droid's body. A caller can control it remotely. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Restraining Bolt]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Restricted Deployment (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Restricted Deployment |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Restraining Bolt (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[Return Of A Jedi (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Restricted-Deployment-Face.jpg |lead='''Restricted Deployment''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_61o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Uncommon1 |rarity_display=Uncommon1 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=3 |icons=[[Effect]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Restricted Deployment]] (1_61)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_61o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=限定配備[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Restricted-Deployment-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=3フォース消費して相手側の場のカードに配備する。相手の全ての戦士に配備コスト＋1。 |printed_lore=軍規に行動を制限されがちな帝国軍は、よほど自軍に有利な情勢でない限り、的確な派兵を行えない。一方、銀河を股にかけた反乱軍の行動は、帝国の勢力を分断させている。 |translation='''Title:''' Restricted Deployment. '''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy on a card on the opponent's side of the table. All the opponent's warriors have deployment cost increased by 1. '''Lore:''' The Imperial military, whose actions tend to be constrained by military regulations, cannot deploy troops effectively unless circumstances strongly favor it. Meanwhile, Rebel activity throughout the galaxy divides the Empire's forces. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to deploy on a card on the opponent's side of the table. The English says to deploy on the opponent's side of the table, without specifying a card.[[:File:Premiere-L-restricteddeployment.gif|Restricted Deployment original English printed face]]. |sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 100 (Japanese Premiere checklist). |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Retract The Bridge (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Retract The Bridge |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Retract-The-Bridge-PSA-135901776.jpg |lead='''Retract The Bridge''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_138o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Retract The Bridge]] (2_138)
'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Retract The Bridge (Revised)]] (52_138)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_138o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=橋を収納せよ |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分の配備フェイズに、Xフォースを使用してデス・スターの屋内の位置カードの順番を入れ替える。X＝それらの位置カードの合計枚数、である。各位置カード上にあるカードは、位置カードとともに移動する。2：「絶体絶命」をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Retract-The-Bridge-PSA-135901776.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''戦術に応じて橋を収納することにより、敵を混乱させ、通常の作戦行動を不可能にする。'' |translation='''Title:''' Retract the bridge. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: During your deploy phase, use X Force to rearrange interior Death Star location cards. X = the total number of those location cards. Cards at each location card move with that location card. 2: Cancel On The Edge. '''Lore:''' By retracting bridges as tactics require, you confuse the enemy and make ordinary operations impossible. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 橋を収納せよ. On The Edge is 「絶体絶命」. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Retract The Bridge]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: Return Of A Jedi (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Return Of A Jedi |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-107o-Video.jpg |lead='''Return Of A Jedi''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_107o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Return Of A Jedi]] (1_107)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[Return Of A Jedi (Unlimited)]] (51_107)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_107o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ジェダイの帰還 |printed_game_text=どちらか選ぶこと。１：オビ＝ワンがロストデッキに送られる際に、１フォース消費して使う。ロストデッキからオビ＝ワンを取り戻す。２：３フォース消費してリザーブデッキから探し出し、手札に加える。その際、デッキは切り直すこと。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-107o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「どこで、あんなおいぼれを見つけたんだ？」「生きているはずなどないさ。」「もう死んでいるはずだ。」「いや、まだ死んではおらんさ。」そう、オビは帰ってきた！'' |translation='''Title:''' Return of a Jedi. '''Card text:''' Choose one. When Obi-Wan is sent to the Lost Pile, use 1 Force to retrieve him. Or use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take Obi-Wan into hand, and shuffle. '''Lore:''' “Where did you dig up that old fossil?” “He can't still be alive.” “He must be dead by now.” “No, he's not dead yet.” Obi is back! '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese numbers the two options. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Return Of A Jedi]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Revolution (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Revolution |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Return Of A Jedi (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[Rycar Ryjerd (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Revolution-Face.jpg |lead='''Revolution''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_62o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Rare1 |rarity_display=Rare1 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unrestricted |destiny=3 |icons=[[Effect]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Revolution]] (1_62)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_62o)
Decipher — [[Revolution (Reflections Gold)|Original playtest]]
[[Revolution (Reflections Gold Remastered)|Remastered]] (15_48) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=革命[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Revolution-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=3フォース消費して、好きな場所に配備する。位置カードの向きを逆転し、アイコンと本文が逆になるようにする（「帝国の拡大」のカードがあれば、それも逆にする）。「革命」がキャンセルされたら、位置カードはもとに戻す。 |printed_lore=反乱軍は、スパイや情報提供者に頼って戦略上の方向を決定する。各地の反乱を扇動し、帝国の活動を妨害してきた。 |translation='''Title:''' Revolution. '''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy at any location. Reverse the location card so icons and text face the other way. Reverse [[Expand The Empire]] there too. If Revolution is canceled, restore the location's original orientation. '''Lore:''' The Rebels rely on spies and informants to determine their strategic direction. They have incited local uprisings and hampered Imperial activities. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to the location card's “text,” where the English says “game texts.” Both printed faces also reverse [[Expand The Empire]] when present and restore the location's orientation if Revolution is canceled.[[:File:Premiere-L-revolution.gif|Revolution original English printed face]]. |sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive], p. 100 (Japanese Premiere checklist). |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Rodian (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Rodian |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Alien]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Rodian-PSA-93071763.jpg |lead='''Rodian''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_104o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |power=2 |ability=1 |deploy=2 |forfeit=2 |uniqueness=Three asterisks |icons=[[Pilot]] |label_icons=Icons |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Rodian]] (2_104o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_104o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Rodian (PC Errata)]] (2_104)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Rodian (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_45)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Rodian (V)]] (1210_20) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ローディアン |printed_game_text=同じ位置カード上の自分のバウンティ・ハンターと密輸屋はそれぞれ戦闘力＋1。ただし「グリード」は逆に戦闘力－1となる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋1。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Rodian-PSA-93071763.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''スークーは典型的なローディアン男性だ。チャッザ族の長、赤のナヴィックの命令でグリードを殺しに来た。ローディアンは“狩り”を好み、多くが暗殺者として雇われている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Rodian. '''Card text:''' Your bounty hunters and smugglers at the same location card are each power +1. Greedo is instead power -1. Adds 1 to the power of any starship he pilots. '''Lore:''' Suku is a typical male Rodian. On orders from Navik the Red, head of the Chattza tribe, he came to kill Greedo. Rodians like the hunt, and many are hired as assassins. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese names Suku (スークー) where English names Thuku, and Greedo as 「グリード」. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Rodian]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: Rogue 1 (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Rogue 1 |side=Light |type=Vehicle |type_display=[[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Rogue-1-PSA-74248139.jpg |lead='''Rogue 1''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_66o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |power=3 |maneuver=4 |landspeed=4 |label_landspeed=Landspeed |deploy=2 |forfeit=6 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Rogue 1]] (3_66)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_66o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ローグ1 |printed_game_text=パイロットと乗客を合計で2名乗せられる。ルークが操縦しているなら耐：損耗＜3。ホスの位置に対してのみリアクションとして移動できる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Rogue-1-PSA-74248139.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''またの名をローグ・リーダー。ホスの戦いでスノースピーダー隊を率いた。密閉型。スカイウォーカー中佐が操縦し、ダク・ロルタが尾砲の砲手を務めた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Rogue 1. '''Card text:''' May carry two pilots or passengers in total. Immune to attrition less than 3 if Luke is piloting. May move as a react only to a Hoth location. '''Lore:''' Also known as Rogue Leader. Led the snowspeeder unit at the Battle of Hoth. Enclosed. Commander Skywalker piloted, with Dack Ralter as tail gunner. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore says またの名を (also known as) rather than “Designated”, and 中佐 rather than Commander. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Rogue 1]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}
