text:
{{Card |title=Rogue 2 |side=Light |type=Vehicle |type_display=[[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Rogue-2-PSA-82917284.jpg |lead='''Rogue 2''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_67o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |power=3 |maneuver=4 |landspeed=4 |label_landspeed=Landspeed |deploy=2 |forfeit=5 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Rogue 2]] (3_67o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_67o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Rogue 2 (PC Errata)]] (3_67) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ローグ2 |printed_game_text=パイロットと乗客を合計で2名乗せられる。ゼヴが操縦しているなら耐：損耗＜3。パイロットが乗っているなら、捜索隊の運命数に2を加えられる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Rogue-2-PSA-82917284.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''密閉型。ホスの寒冷対策に施した改造が成功した最初のスノースピーダー。ゼヴ・セネスカが操縦する。ソロ船長とスカイウォーカー中佐の捜索隊を率いた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Rogue 2. '''Card text:''' May carry two pilots or passengers in total. Immune to attrition less than 3 if Zev is piloting. If a pilot is aboard, may add 2 to search party destiny. '''Lore:''' Enclosed. The first snowspeeder whose Hoth cold-weather modifications succeeded. Zev Senesca pilots it. He led the search party for Captain Solo and Commander Skywalker. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore specifies successful cold-weather modifications rather than being adapted to Hoth's environment, and uses 中佐. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Rogue 2]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

text:
{{Card |title=Rogue 3 |side=Light |type=Vehicle |type_display=[[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Rogue-3-PSA-82917285.jpg |lead='''Rogue 3''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_68o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |power=3 |maneuver=4 |landspeed=4 |label_landspeed=Landspeed |deploy=2 |forfeit=5 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Rogue 3]] (3_68)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_68o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ローグ3 |printed_game_text=パイロットと乗客を合計で2名乗せられる。ウェッジが操縦しているなら耐：損耗＜3。ホスの位置に対してのみリアクションとして移動できる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Rogue-3-PSA-82917285.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''密閉型。ウェッジ・アンティリーズ中佐が操縦する。ウォーカーの脚を絡めることに成功。反乱軍がエコー基地を脱出する際に乗り捨てられた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Rogue 3. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore says it succeeded in tangling a walker's legs rather than “Successful walker tripper”, and uses 中佐. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Rogue 3]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. title: Rogue Bantha (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Rogue Bantha |side=Light |type=Vehicle |type_display=[[Vehicle]] ([[Creature Vehicle]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Rogue-Bantha-PSA-90960113.jpg |lead='''Rogue Bantha''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Creature Vehicle]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_76o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |power=2 |maneuver=2 |landspeed=1 |label_landspeed=Landspeed |deploy=2 |forfeit=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Rogue Bantha]] (2_76o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_76o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Rogue Bantha (PC Errata)]] (2_76) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=はぐれバンサ |printed_game_text=2名までの乗客を追加できる。バンサは能力値＝1/2。“リアクション”として移動できる。屋外の位置カードで戦闘が行われたら、開始時に同じ場所にいるタスケン・レイダーを一名（どれにするかはこちらが選べる）“踏んづける”（即座にロストする）。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Rogue-Bantha-PSA-90960113.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''タスケン・レイダーの若者の扱いのまずさから、荒野に逃げ出してしまったバンサ。モイスチャー・ファーマーが手なずけたため、よそ者にもよくなつくが、タスケン・レイダーだけは見たとたんに攻撃し始める。'' |translation='''Title:''' Rogue Bantha. '''Card text:''' May add up to 2 passengers. Bantha ability equals 1/2. May move as a react. When a battle is fought at an exterior location card, at the start one Tusken Raider at the same place (your choice) is trampled (immediately lost). '''Lore:''' A bantha that fled into the wilderness after a young Tusken Raider handled it poorly. A moisture farmer tamed it, so it is friendly to strangers, but it attacks Tusken Raiders on sight. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore says a moisture farmer tamed it (手なずけた); English says it was raised by a moisture farmer. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Rogue Bantha]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_17o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Rogue Gunner (PC Errata)]] (3_17) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ローグ砲手 |printed_game_text=乗客として宇宙船に乗っているなら、その宇宙船の兵器の武器運命数に1を加える。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Rogue-Gunner-PSA-89232343.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''コルサント出身のケシン・オムニスに代表される砲手たちは、ビークルや宇宙船の後部砲塔の操作を担当する。高度な訓練によって兵器の扱いに精通している。'' |translation='''Title:''' Rogue Gunner. High training has made them skilled with weapons. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text adds その宇宙船の兵器の (that starship's weapon's) before weapon destiny. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Rogue Gunner]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Romas 'Lock' Navander (V)]] (1220_100) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ロマス“ロック”ナヴァンダー |printed_game_text=操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力と回避値に1を加える。相手は彼と同じロケーションに対して、あるいはそこから、リアクションとして移動することができない。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Romas-Lock-Navander-PSA-89232344.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''コレリア人のパイロット。アカデミーを卒業した直後に帝国軍を脱走した。エコー基地の通信技術士官。近隣の反乱軍の宇宙船に通信を中継する。'' |translation='''Title:''' Romas 'Lock' Navander. '''Card text:''' Adds 1 to power and maneuver of a starship he pilots. Opponent may not move as a react to or from the same location as him. '''Lore:''' A Corellian pilot. He defected from the Empire just after graduating from the Academy. Communications technician at Echo Base. He relays communications to nearby Rebel starships. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title uses “ロック” in double quotes. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Romas 'Lock' Navander]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. text:

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Rug Hug (V)]] (1283_23) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=毛皮の抱擁 |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：ルークとチューイーが一緒に戦闘に参加しているなら、戦闘運命数を余分に2枚加えることができる。2：自分の反乱軍とエイリアンが一緒に戦闘に参加しているなら、戦闘力に4を加えることができる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Rug-Hug-PSA-82917282.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ウーキーは豊かな感情を持ち、家族や友人を護ることで知られている。チューバッカはいつしかルークを自分の家族の一員として扱うようになっていた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Rug Hug. '''Card text:''' Choose one. If Luke and Chewie are in a battle together, you may add two extra battle destiny. If you have a Rebel and an alien in a battle together, you may add 4 to power. '''Lore:''' Wookiees have rich emotions and are known for protecting family and friends. Chewbacca had come to treat Luke as a member of his own family. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is 毛皮の抱擁. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Rug Hug]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. (V)]] (1273_37) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=走れ、ルーク、走るんだ！ |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。１：隣接する位置で戦闘が宣言された時に使う。フォースの消費なしで、ルークをその位置へ移動させる。ベイダーがその戦闘に参加しているか、戦闘が行われる位置の隣接位置に配備されていない限り、その戦闘中、ルークの戦闘力は＋２となる。２：「ベイダーの執念」をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Run-Luke-Run-SWCA-97588.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ベイダーがオビ＝ワンを倒すのを見て、ルークは我を忘れてブラスターを乱射した。老ジェダイ・マスターの、「走れ、ルーク、走るんだ！」という声を聞いて正気に戻るまで。'' |translation='''Title:''' Run, Luke, Run! '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Use when a battle is declared at an adjacent site. Move Luke there without using Force. Unless Vader is in that battle or deployed at a site adjacent to the battle, Luke is power +2 for that battle. 2: Cancel “Vader's Obsession”. '''Lore:''' Seeing Vader strike down Obi-Wan, Luke lost himself and fired his blaster wildly, until the old Jedi Master's voice, “Run, Luke, run!”, brought him back to his senses. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Run Luke, Run!]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. text:
{{Card |title=Rycar Ryjerd |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-63o-Face.jpg |lead='''Rycar Ryjerd''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_63o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Rycar Ryjerd]] (1_63o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_63o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ライカー・ライジャード |printed_game_text=密輸屋ではないキャラクターに配備して、密輸屋の技能を与える。または、密輸屋に配備すると、戦闘力に＋１（「意識操作」のカードの影響を受けない）。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-63o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ビムの商人で宇宙船用兵器の密輸屋。誰も信用しないくせに、誰とでも取引する。密輸の技術を教えている。ジャワ語に熟達している。'' |translation='''Title:''' Rycar Ryjerd. '''Card text:''' Deploy on a character who is not a smuggler to give that character the smuggler skill. Or deploy on a smuggler to add 1 to power. Immune to Alter. '''Lore:''' A Bimm merchant and smuggler of starship weapons. Trusts no one but will trade with anyone. Teaches smuggling techniques and is fluent in Jawaese. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Rycar Ryjerd]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. text:
{{Card |title=SW-4 Ion Cannon |side=Light |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Starship Weapon]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-SW-4-Ion-Cannon-PSA-159081628.jpg |lead='''SW-4 Ion Cannon''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Starship Weapon]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_81o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[SW-4 Ion Cannon]] (2_81o)

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_81o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[SW-4 Ion Cannon (Errata)]] (2_81) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=SW－4イオン砲 |printed_game_text=1フォースを使用して任意のYウイングかBウイングに配備する。1フォースを使用して起動する。運命数を引く。運命数＞目標の装甲値または回避値ならば命中する。目標に搭載されたすべての武器／兵器はロストし、目標は装甲値／回避値＝0、航行速度＝0となる。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-SW-4-Ion-Cannon-PSA-159081628.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''アーメックSW－4銃座設置式イオン砲。イオン化されたエネルギー線を放射し、目標の機構やコンピュータ・システムに過負荷を起こさせる。これを使用すれば船を捕獲し、乗り込むことができる。'' |translation='''Title:''' SW-4 ion cannon. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any Y-wing or B-wing. Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. Hit if destiny > the target's armor or maneuver. All weapons aboard the target are lost, and the target's armor/maneuver = 0 and hyperspeed = 0. '''Lore:''' An ArMek SW-4 turret-mounted ion cannon. It fires ionized energy and overloads the target's machinery and computer systems. Using it lets you capture a ship and board it. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[SW-4 Ion Cannon]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

text:
{{Card |title=Sabotage |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Sabotage-SWCA-67673.jpg |lead='''Sabotage''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_56o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Sabotage]] (2_56)

'''Virtual Original''' — [[Sabotage (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_19)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Sabotage (V) (Virtual Block 1)]] (1210_162)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Sabotage (V)]] (201_15) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=妨害工作 |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分の支配フェイズに、自分の潜伏中のスパイと同じ位置カードにある武器、アイテム、ビークルを1つ目標として定める。運命数を引く。運命数＞目標の配備コストなら、目標はロストする（スパイが盗賊でもあるなら、ロストさせるかわりに盗むことができる。2：「情報提供者」をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Sabotage-SWCA-67673.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''装備に劣る反乱軍は、帝国軍の物量に対し、秘密工作で反撃するしかなかった。コンピュータの暗号を解読したり、システムを改竄するのは最も効果的な手法であった。'' |translation='''Title:''' Sabotage. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: During your control phase, target one weapon, device, or vehicle at the same location card as your undercover spy. Draw destiny. If destiny is greater than the target's deploy cost, the target is lost (if the spy is also a thief, you may steal it instead of making it lost). 2: Cancel Informant. '''Lore:''' Poorly equipped Rebels had no choice but to strike back at the Empire's numbers with secret operations. Decoding computer ciphers and tampering with systems was the most effective method. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Informant is 「情報提供者」. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Sabotage]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Card text:''' May carry up to eight passengers. Deploy at a Tatooine site. May move only to planet sites. When at an exterior site, Jawas there have forfeit +1. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Scanning-Crew-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]]. |printed_lore=帝国軍は高感度な器材を使用して、捕えた宇宙船の閉ざされた区画を探査する。探査部隊ＢＴ－445はミレニアム・ファルコン号を調べようとした。 |translation='''Title:''' Scanning Crew. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese calls the destination the Used Deck, while the English calls it the Used Pile. The Japanese lore describes closed compartments rather than shielded compartments, and says that BT-445 tried to inspect the ship rather than planned to search it.[[:File:Premiere-D-scanningcrew.gif|Scanning Crew original English printed face]]. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Scanning Crew]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. '''Card text:''' USED: Cancel Solo Han, Warrior's Courage, or I Know. LOST: Use when Han and Leia are in a battle together. Draw two destiny. Wha... you stuck-up, inconsiderate, scruffy-looking nerf herder! '''Comparison with the English printing:''' USED names 「孤独なハン」, 「戦士の勇気」, and 「知ってるさ」 for Solo Han, Warrior's Courage, and I Know. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Numbered modes 1 and 2 replace the English OR. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Self-Destruct Mechanism]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. text:
{{Card |title=Send A Detachment Down |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] - [[Utinni Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Scanning Crew (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[Sense (Dark) (Premiere) (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-send-a-detachment-down-PSA-original-Face.jpg |lead='''Send A Detachment Down''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_229o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Rare1 |rarity_display=[[Rarity|Rare1]] |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unique (1) |destiny=4 |icons=[[Effect]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Send A Detachment Down]] (1_229)

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Send A Detachment Down (V)]] (221_29) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=捜索隊を降下させよ |printed_game_text=２フォース消費して任意のタトゥイーンの位置カード（ドッキング・ベイを除く）に配備する。デス・スターにいる任意の兵員／トルーパーを対象として選ぶ。対象がこのカードと同じ位置に移動して、そこにい続ける限り、タトゥイーンで戦闘が起こる際、相手の損耗値はすべて＋１される。 |printed_lore=''ベイダーはストームトルーパーをタトゥイーンの地表に派遣して、盗まれたデス・スターの設計図を探索させた。「今度という今度は誰にも邪魔させぬぞ。」'' |translation='''Title:''' Send the search party down. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on any Tatooine site (except a docking bay). Choose any soldier/trooper on the Death Star as the target. Once the target moves to the same site as this card and remains there, all attrition against the opponent in battles on Tatooine is increased by 1. '''Lore:''' Vader dispatched stormtroopers to the surface of Tatooine to search for the stolen Death Star plans. "This time, I will not let anyone interfere." '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title calls the detachment a search party. Its game text says soldier/trooper and refers to the same site as this card; the English says trooper and names the Utinni Effect. Both specify 2 Force, a non-docking-bay Tatooine site, a target on the Death Star, and the continuing +1 attrition condition.[ Japanese printed face], PSA. [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/9/9a/Premiere-D-sendadetachmentdown.gif English printed face]. |sources=* [ Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA. * [ Send A Detachment Down Japanese printed face], PSA. * [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 100 (Japanese Premiere checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to choose one opposing character as a target. Draw destiny. If the destiny is greater than the character's ability, that character immediately returns to the opponent's hand. All cards deployed on that character also return to hand. '''Lore:''' "...Bring the crew to me. Alive!" Imperial soldiers set their blasters to stun (unconsciousness) mode when they need to capture prisoners alive for interrogation. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese parenthetical says that the attached cards return to hand without specifying whose hands; the printed English expressly says owners' hands. The Japanese lore refers to the crew rather than the English passengers and omits the English reference to using the stun setting for intimidation.[[:File:Premiere-D-setforstun.gif|Set For Stun original English printed face]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Card text:''' When you declare a battle at the same location as Shawn, your personnel or troopers at adjacent locations may immediately move there. Only those who have not battled this turn may move. Force for this movement is consumed as usual. '''Lore:''' An experienced evacuation officer. Leader of the Echo Base troopers. He is trained to evacuate Rebel facilities at maximum efficiency and shorten the time. A poet and a musician. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses 位置 for site and 兵員／トルーパー for troopers. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Shawn Valdez]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_110o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=スカイウォーカー（空駆ける者）たち |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。１：ルークとレイアが一緒に戦闘している場合、戦闘運命数にを２回引いて加える。２：「完全防備の壁」「行き止まり」「橋を収納せよ」のいずれかをキャンセルできる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-110o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ルークとレイアは、保安網に探知されないように、デス・スター内の未使用区画へ逃げ込んだ。収納された橋の一端から、敵の射線を潜りつつ、綱を握りしめて向こう側へと跳んだ。'' |translation='''Title:''' The Skywalkers (ones who run the sky). '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: If Luke and Leia are in battle together, draw and add two battle destiny. 2: May cancel Imperial Barrier, Wrong Turn, or Retract The Bridge. '''Lore:''' Luke and Leia fled into an unused section of the Death Star to stay off the security net. From one end of a retracted bridge they swung across on a line through enemy fire. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Option 2 names 完全防備の壁, 行き止まり and 橋を収納せよ for Imperial Barrier, Wrong Turn and Retract The Bridge. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Skywalkers]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Sniper (Errata)]] (2_139) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=狙撃手 |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズに武器を使用する（フォースは通常通り使用する）。使用しているのが"ア'ウァア'ゥア'ウウ"なら、運命数に2を加えられる。シーカーを目標とすることもできる。シーカーは回避値4としてあつかう。命中を受けた目標は即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Sniper-SWCA-67754.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''タスケン・レイダーはしばしば、一人で砂漠を旅する旅行者を長距離から狙い撃ちする。元来が臆病なため、直接相手と一戦交えるよりは、奇襲や待ち伏せを好む。'' |translation='''Title:''' Sniper. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, fire a weapon, using Force as usual. If URoRRuR'R'R is firing, you may add 2 to destiny. A seeker may be targeted. Treat a seeker as maneuver 4. A hit target is immediately lost. '''Lore:''' Tusken Raiders often snipe lone desert travelers at long range. Being cowardly by nature, they prefer ambush to a direct fight. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese adds フォースは通常通り使用する, absent from the English original. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Sniper]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. {{Card |title=Snowtrooper Officer |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) |set=Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese) |set_display=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Snowtrooper-Officer-SWCA-100678.jpg |lead='''Snowtrooper Officer''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1363_92o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |power=2 |ability=1 |deploy=3 |forfeit=3 |uniqueness=Three asterisks |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Snowtrooper Officer]] (3_92)
'''Decipher (ESB Two-Player)''' — [[Snowtrooper Officer (ESB Two-Player)]] (63_92)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1363_92o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Snowtrooper Officer (Japanese)]] (1303_92o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=スノートルーパー士官 |printed_game_text=ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。同じ位置に配備するならスノートルーパーは配備コスト－1。自分の兵員／トルーパーはホスの同じ位置に向かってリアクションとして移動できる。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Snowtrooper-Officer-SWCA-100678.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''スノートルーパーのエリート士官。帝国陸軍の士官の常として、反乱軍の戦法には精通している。歩兵とAT-ATを連係させる要として働く。'' |translation='''Title:''' Snowtrooper Officer. '''Card text:''' Deploy only on Hoth. Thereafter, may move anywhere. Snowtroopers deploy for 1 less at the same location. Your troopers may move as a react to the same Hoth location as the officer. '''Lore:''' An elite Snowtrooper officer. Like other Imperial Army officers, he is well versed in Rebel tactics. He serves as the link between the infantry and the AT-ATs. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses 位置 where the English says site. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Snowtrooper Officer]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

title: Solo Han (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Solo Han |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-111o-Video.jpg |lead='''Solo Han''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_111o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Solo Han]] (1_111o)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[Solo Han (Unlimited)]] (51_111)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_111o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=孤独なハン |printed_game_text=どちらか選ぶ。１：戦闘の際、ハンが位置カードを独りで守っている時に使用できる。戦闘運命数を２枚多く引いて足せる。２：戦闘の際、エイリアンが位置カードを独りで守っている時に使用できる。戦闘運命数を１枚多く引いて足せる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-111o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''くつろいでいるように見えても、ソロは密輸屋として常に周囲に気を配らなくてはならない。バウンティ・ハンターたちは、コレリアの宇宙海賊の首にかけられた賞金に群がる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Solo Han. '''Card text:''' Choose one. If Han is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny. If an alien is defending a battle alone, add one battle destiny. '''Lore:''' Even when he looks relaxed, Solo as a smuggler has to watch his surroundings. Bounty hunters flock to the price on the Corellian pirate's head. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese numbers the two options. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Solo Han]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

{{Card |title=Solomahal |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Solomahal-SWCA-67716.jpg |lead='''Solomahal''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_38o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Solomahal]] (2_38o)

'''PC Errata''' — [[Solomahal (PC Errata)]] (2_38)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Solomahal (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_21)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Solomahal (V)]] (1210_139) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ソロマハール |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：任意の戦士に配備して偵察兵の能力を与える。その戦士は"リアクション"として隣接する位置カードに移動できる。2：任意の偵察兵に配備する。その偵察兵は"リアクション"を行う場合、戦闘力＋2となる。このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Solomahal-SWCA-67716.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''旧共和国の古参士官であったが、クローン大戦の後で前線を退いた。アウターリムで偵察技術を教えて生計をたてている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Solomahal. '''Card text:''' Choose one. Deploy on any warrior to give scout skill; that warrior may move to an adjacent location card as a react. Or deploy on any scout; that scout is power +2 when reacting. This Effect is not affected by Alter. '''Lore:''' A veteran officer of the Old Republic who left the front after the Clone Wars. He makes a living in the Outer Rim teaching scouting skills. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Functions are numbered 1/2 under どちらかを選ぶ instead of OR. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Solomahal]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: SoroSuub V-35 Landspeeder (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=SoroSuub V-35 Landspeeder |side=Light |type=Vehicle |type_display=[[Vehicle]] ([[Transport Vehicle]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-151o-Video.jpg |lead='''SoroSuub V-35 Landspeeder''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Transport Vehicle]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_151o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |power=0 |maneuver=4 |landspeed=3 |label_landspeed=Landspeed |deploy=2 |forfeit=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[SoroSuub V-35 Landspeeder]] (1_151o)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[SoroSuub V-35 Landspeeder (Unlimited)]] (51_151)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_151o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[SoroSuub V-35 Landspeeder (PC Errata)]] (1_151) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Vehicle]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=ソロスーブ V-35 ランドスピーダー |printed_game_text=乗員4名まで。オーウェン・ラーズ、ベルー・ラーズ、ルークのいずれかが乗っていれば、移動コスト不要。戦闘または、フォース消耗に対するリアクションとして移動してよい（移動力が足りるなら）。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-151o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''旧型の長距離用ランドスピーダーで、ラーズ家でもアンカーヘッドへの遠出に使用していた。貨物積載区画を持つ。コクピットは密閉型である。'' |translation='''Title:''' SoroSuub V-35 Landspeeder. '''Card text:''' May carry 4 passengers. Moves free if Owen Lars, Beru Lars, or Luke is aboard. May move as a react to a battle or Force drain if within range. '''Lore:''' An older long-range landspeeder the Lars family used for trips to Anchorhead. It has a cargo bay. The cockpit is enclosed. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[SoroSuub V-35 Landspeeder]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Sorry About The Mess |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Sorry-About-The-Mess-SWCA-67676.jpg |lead='''Sorry About The Mess''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_57o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Sorry About The Mess]] (2_57o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_57o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Sorry About The Mess (Errata)]] (2_57) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=やっかいかけたな |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズに武器を使用する（フォースは通常通り使用する）。使用しているのがハンなら、運命数に1を加えられる。（シーカーを目標とすることもできる。シーカーは回避値4としてあつかう）命中を受けた目標は即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Sorry-About-The-Mess-SWCA-67676.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「おまえを殺すのを楽しみにしてたんだ」「ああ、察しがつくぜ」ハンはグリードとの交渉に荒っぽく片をつけ、ウーハーに後始末料を投げてよこした。'' |translation='''Title:''' Sorry About The Mess. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, fire a weapon, using Force as usual. If Han is firing, you may add 1 to destiny. A seeker may be targeted. Treat a seeker as maneuver 4. A hit target is immediately lost. '''Lore:''' I've been looking forward to killing you. Yeah, I figured. Han ended the talk with Greedo roughly and tossed Wuher a cleanup fee. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is やっかいかけたな. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Sorry About The Mess]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: Spaceport Speeders (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Spaceport Speeders |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] - [[Used Interrupt|Used Interrupt]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[SoroSuub V-35 Landspeeder (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[Special Modifications (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Spaceport-Speeders-Face.jpg |lead='''Spaceport Speeders''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt|Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_112o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Uncommon2 |rarity_display=Uncommon2[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 100 (Japanese Premiere checklist). |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unrestricted |destiny=6 |icons=[[Interrupt]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Spaceport Speeders]] (1_112o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_112o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Spaceport Speeders (Errata)]] (1_112) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=スペースポート・スピーダーズ[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Spaceport-Speeders-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=「モス・アイズリー」か、「ワイオスリー」がいる位置カードで使用できる。ビークルかドロイドをひとつ売ることができる。2枚引いて運命数を求めよ（ルークのX－34ランドスピーダーの場合3枚）。その合計が“売り値”になる。その数だけフォースを“起動”する。売ったビークルかドロイドはロストデッキへ。 |printed_lore=スペースポート・スピーダーズは、浮遊式ビークルの取引業者団体だ。中でもワイオスリーは抜け目無いことで有名。ルークはX－34スピーダーを売って2000クレジットを得た。 |translation='''Title:''' Spaceport Speeders. '''Card text:''' May be used at [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley|Mos Eisley]] or a location card where [[Wioslea]] is present. You may sell one vehicle or droid. Draw two destiny cards (three for [[Luke's X-34 Landspeeder]]). Their total is the “selling price.” Activate that much Force. The sold vehicle or droid goes to the Lost Pile. '''Lore:''' Spaceport Speeders is a group of dealers in floating vehicles. [[Wioslea]] in particular is known for being shrewd. Luke sold his X-34 speeder for 2,000 credits. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese does not explicitly restrict the sale to one of your vehicles or droids, as the English does. It calls the total the selling price rather than an offer that must be accepted. Both physical faces identify Luke's speeder as X-34 in the lore.[[:File:Premiere-L-spaceportspeeders-decipher-archive.gif|Spaceport Speeders original English printed face]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Special Modifications (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Special Modifications |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Spaceport Speeders (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[Surprise Assault (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Special-Modifications-Face.jpg |lead='''Special Modifications''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_65o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Uncommon1 |rarity_display=Uncommon1[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 100 (Japanese Premiere checklist). |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=3 |icons=[[Effect]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Special Modifications]] (1_65o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_65o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Special Modifications (PC Errata)]] (1_65)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Special Modifications (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour)]] (1102_23)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Special Modifications (V)]] (1210_140) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=特別改造[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Special-Modifications-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=1フォース消費して任意の宇宙船に配備する。装甲値または回避値に＋2。ミレニアム・ファルコンに配備した場合、ハン、ランド、チューイーのいずれかが操縦していれば、さらに戦闘力と没収値に＋2。 |printed_lore=ハンがミレニアム・ファルコンに施した「特別改造」には、保安装置の追加、防御シールド、船体装甲、ハイパードライブの速度向上、武器の強化などがある。 |translation='''Title:''' Special Modifications. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any starship. Add 2 to its armor or maneuver. If deployed on the [[Millennium Falcon]] while [[Han Solo|Han]], [[Lando Calrissian|Lando]], or [[Chewbacca|Chewie]] is piloting, also add 2 to power and forfeit. '''Lore:''' Han's “special modifications” to the [[Millennium Falcon]] include added security equipment, defensive shields, hull armor, a faster hyperdrive, and improved weapons. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese retains the English printed cost and bonuses, including the additional power and forfeit bonus for [[Millennium Falcon]] with [[Han Solo|Han]], [[Lando Calrissian|Lando]], or [[Chewbacca|Chewie]] piloting.[[:File:Premiere-L-specialmodifications-decipher-archive.gif|Special Modifications original English printed face]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

title: Spice Mines Of Kessel (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Spice Mines Of Kessel |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Spice-Mines-Of-Kessel-PSA-156625015.jpg |lead='''Spice Mines Of Kessel''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_125o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Spice Mines Of Kessel]] (2_125o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_125o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Spice Mines Of Kessel (PC Errata)]] (2_125)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Spice Mines Of Kessel (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_46)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Spice Mines Of Kessel (V)]] (1210_49) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ケッセルのスパイス鉱床 |printed_game_text=ケッセルに配備する（移動不可）。捕虜を1名と、その護衛として兵員／トルーパーを1名、目標として選ぶ。目標がウーティーニー・エフェクトに到達したら、捕虜の没収値と同じ数だけフォースを再使用する（捕虜とウーティーニー・エフェクトはロストする）。到達する前に兵員／トルーパーがロストしたなら、捕虜は解放される。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Spice-Mines-Of-Kessel-PSA-156625015.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ケッセルのスパイス鉱床に送られた囚人は、密輸屋や犯罪王たちが銀河中に売りさばくスパイス、グリッタースティムを掘って余生を過ごすことになる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Spice Mines Of Kessel. '''Card text:''' Deploy on Kessel (cannot move). Target one captive and one soldier/trooper as escort. When the targets reach the Utinni Effect, reuse Force equal to the captive's forfeit; the captive and Utinni Effect are lost. If the soldier/trooper is lost before arrival, the captive is released. '''Lore:''' Prisoners sent to the Kessel spice mines spend the rest of their lives digging glitterstim, a spice smugglers and crime lords sell across the galaxy. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Escort is 兵員／トルーパー, not bare trooper. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Spice Mines Of Kessel]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Stormtrooper-C1G.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]]. |printed_lore=''皇帝に完全な忠誠を誓う精鋭突撃部隊の名も無き一員。命令には無条件で従い、任務のために命を投げ出すことを厭わない。最前線の速攻部隊。'' |translation='''Title:''' Stormtrooper. '''PC Errata''' — [[Stormtrooper Backpack (PC Errata)]] (1_206) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ストームトルーパー・バックパック |printed_game_text=任意の兵員／トルーパーに配備する。その兵員には武器やアイテムをいくつでも配備できる。惑星の位置カードにいるなら、その兵員は耐：損耗＜３を持つ。 |printed_lore=''帝国軍の標準支給品で、サバイバル用品と野営用装備がおさまっている。遠征用に、弾薬や食料も貯蔵可能。これさえあれば、単独でも自給できる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Stormtrooper Backpack. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any soldier/trooper. Any number of weapons and devices may be deployed on that soldier. While at a planet site, that soldier is immune to attrition less than 3. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says any number of weapons and devices may be deployed on the soldier. The English printed face says the trooper may carry and use any number of weapons and devices. Both give immunity to attrition less than 3 at a planet site. The Japanese calls the eligible character soldier/trooper.[ Japanese printed face], PSA; [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a9/Premiere-D-stormtrooperbackpack-decipher-archive.gif English printed face]. |sources=* [ Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA. * [ Stormtrooper Backpack Japanese printed face], PSA. * [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 100 (Japanese Premiere checklist). '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Stunning Leader (V)]] (1240_46) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=気絶に陥るリーダー |printed_game_text=屋内の位置カードで戦闘が宣言された直後に使用する。1フォース消費して、双方の側のすべてのリーダーと能力値＞2のキャラクターを完全にその戦闘から切り離す。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Stunning-Leader-SWCA-67793.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ストームトルーパーは重要な目標を殺さずにスタン（気絶）させる訓練を受けている。これは敵軍を分断し、リーダーを捕まえて尋問するためである。スタンに後遺症はなく、その後の尋問にも支障は出ない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Stunning Leader. '''Card text:''' Play immediately after a battle is declared at an interior location card. Spend 1 Force to cut all leaders and characters with ability greater than 2 on both sides completely out of that battle. '''Lore:''' Stormtroopers train to stun, not kill, priority targets, to split the enemy and capture leaders for interrogation. Stun has no aftereffects and does not hinder later interrogation. On Hoth, the temperature drops to extremes. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Sunsdown]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Huge generators supply energy to the terrifying planet-destroying weapon. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Surface Defense Cannon (Errata)]] (3_80) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=対地防衛用砲塔 |printed_game_text=1フォース消費して任意の宇宙戦闘機に配備する。あるいはフォースを消費せずにミレニアム・ファルコンに配備する。同じ位置のキャラクターを目標として1フォース消費して起動する。運命数を引く。キャラクターには運命数＋1＞能力値で命中する。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Surface-Defense-Cannon-PSA-85187827.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ブラステックＡｘ－１０８“グラウンド・バザー”ブラスター砲。宇宙船の引込み式ガン・ポッドから降下させて使用する。照準には動体センサーを使用。360°の射撃範囲を持つ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Surface Defense Cannon. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any starfighter. Or deploy on Millennium Falcon without using Force. Target a character at the same location and use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny +1 exceeds ability. '''Lore:''' BlasTech Ax-108 Ground Buzzer blaster cannon. It is dropped from a retractable gun pod on a starship for use. Targeting uses a motion sensor. It has a 360-degree firing arc. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 位置 for site and 起動 for fire. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Surface Defense Cannon]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Surprise Assault (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)]] (1371_113o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=急襲 |printed_game_text=1フォース消費して、1つの場所のフォース消耗を、キャンセルできる。相手の持つキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークル、一つごとに、運命数を1枚引く。引いた運命数の合計と、相手の戦闘力の合計を比較する。低いほうが、その差の分だけフォースを失う。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Surprise-Assault-SWCA-100710.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''厳格な軍規の元に行動する帝国軍兵士達は、反乱軍の機転をきかせた待ち伏せ、突然の反撃、妨害行動に、しばしば不意をつかれた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Surprise Assault. '''Card text:''' Spend 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at one location. Draw one destiny for each of the opponent's characters, starships, and vehicles. Compare that destiny total to the opponent's power total. The player with the lower total loses Force equal to the difference. '''Lore:''' Imperial soldiers acting under strict military rules were often caught off guard by Rebel ambushes, sudden counterattacks, and sabotage. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese does not require the opponent's cards to be present. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Surprise Assault]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. '''PC Errata''' — [[Swilla Corey (PC Errata)]] (2_126) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=スウィラ・コアリー |printed_game_text=どちらか選ぶこと。1：盗賊でないキャラクターに配備して、盗賊技能を持たせる。自分の支配フェイズに同じ位置カード上のアイテムを1つ目標として選ぶ。運命数を引く。運命数＜目標の運命数なら、目標を“盗む”。2：武器に配備して、盗まれるのを防ぐ。このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Swilla-Corey-SWCA-67794.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''銀河中にいる小悪党たちは、時として新参者に悪事のコツを教えて小金を稼ぐ。帝国の圧政が強まるにつれ、盗賊の数も増えていった。'' |translation='''Title:''' Swilla Corey. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Deploy on a non-thief character to give thief skill. During your control phase, target one item on the same location card. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than the target's destiny, steal the target. 2: Deploy on a weapon to prevent it from being stolen. This Effect is not affected by Alter. '''Lore:''' Petty criminals throughout the galaxy sometimes earn extra money by teaching newcomers the tricks of crime. As Imperial oppression tightens, the number of thieves also grows. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses アイテム and 位置カード where English says device and same site. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Swilla Corey]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Card text:''' * Replaces 3 TIE/LN at one location (the TIE/LN go to the Used Pile). Permanent pilots aboard provide total ability 3. '''Lore:''' The Empire prefers quantity tactics. The pilots' morale is never high, but “wolfpack” group tactics make up for it. {{Card |title=Tactical Re-Call |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-231o-Face.jpg |lead='''Tactical Re-Call''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_231o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Tactical Re-Call]] (1_231)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_231o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=戦術用通信 |printed_game_text=どこかで戦闘に勝利した直後に、任意のヤヴィン４の位置カードに配備する。戦闘に参加した戦士を１名対象として選ぶ。対象の戦闘力と没収値は、－２（レイアなら－３）される。その対象がこのカードの位置までたどり着けば、ウーティーニー・エフェクトはキャンセルされる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-231o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''絶滅したマサッシ族の遺跡には、高性能の通信装置が隠されている。この装置により、反乱軍の統制が行われ、士官たちに状況が報告される。'' |translation='''Title:''' Tactical Communications. '''Card text:''' Immediately after winning a battle, deploy at any Yavin 4 site. Target one warrior who participated. The target is power and forfeit −2, or −3 if Leia. If the target reaches this card's site, the Utinni Effect is canceled. '''Lore:''' High-performance communications equipment is hidden in the ruins of the extinct Massassi. The Rebels use it to coordinate operations and report the situation to their officers. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Tactical Re-Call]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_160o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=タッグ・シーカー |printed_game_text=１フォース消費して、未踏査の位置カードの、相手側に配備できる。自分の支配フェイズに、キャラクターと同じようにフォースを消費して移動させることができる。タッグまたは能力値＜３の戦士と同じ場所についたら、そのうち１枚を選んで、ロストデッキへ送る。タッグ・シーカーもロストデッキに行く。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-160o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''軍用リモート。特定の個人や、条件を指定しての追跡をプログラムされている。熱光学センサーできわめて正確に対象を追跡する。宇宙船に潜り込ませることも可能。'' |translation='''Title:''' Tagge Seeker. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy to your opponent's side of an unoccupied site. During your control phase, you may use Force to move it like a character. If it reaches the same location as Tagge or a warrior with ability below 3, choose one such card and send it to the Lost Pile. Tagge Seeker is also lost. '''Lore:''' A military remote programmed to track particular people or pursue targets that meet specified conditions. Thermo-optical sensors let it track a target with great precision. It can also be slipped aboard a starship. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Tagge Seeker]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Takeel (Errata)]] (1_269) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=タキール |printed_game_text=戦闘で、双方のプレイヤーが運命数を１つずつ引いた時に使う。１フォース消費してその値を取り替えることができる。Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Takeel-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Takeel (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text. [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Takeel-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]]. |printed_lore=タキールは落ち目のスニヴィアン傭兵であり、裏切り者としても知られる。スパイス中毒者で、カンティーナで仕事をあさっている。犯罪者を帝国軍に売り渡すこともある。 |translation='''Title:''' Takeel. The Japanese lore calls Takeel down-on-his-luck and a traitor, while the English calls him burned-out and a double-crosser.[[:File:Premiere-D-takeel.gif|Takeel original English printed face]]. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Takeel]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. title: Tallon Roll (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Tallon Roll |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Takeel (Japanese)]] · [[Premiere (Japanese)]] · [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere) (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Tallon-Roll-Face.jpg |lead='''Tallon Roll''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_270o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Common2 |rarity_display=Common2[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 100 (Japanese Premiere checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |uniqueness=Unrestricted |destiny=4 |icons=[[Interrupt]] |label_icons=Icons |versions='''Decipher''' - [[Tallon Roll]] (1_270o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1301_270o)
'''Decipher Errata''' - [[Tallon Roll (Errata)]]
'''PC Errata''' - [[Tallon Roll (PC Errata)]] (1_270)
'''Reflections Gold (original playtest)''' - [[Tallon Roll (Reflections Gold)]]
'''Reflections Gold Remastered''' - [[Tallon Roll (Reflections Gold Remastered)]] (15_288) |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=Subtype[[Used Interrupt]] |printed_title=タロン・ロール[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Tallon-Roll-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=同じ星系にいる宇宙戦闘機を２機（１機は反乱軍、もう１機は帝国軍）選ぶ。各プレイヤーは運命数を引く。運命数と宇宙戦闘機の戦闘力、および回避値を合計し、相手の運命数と宇宙戦闘機の戦闘力の合計と比べる。合計値の低かったほうが即座に宇宙戦闘機を失う。 |printed_lore=宇宙戦闘機の戦闘に革命をもたらした旧共和国の戦術家エイダー・タロンにちなんで名付けられた戦法。速度と照準ロックを保ちながら、旋回する敵機を追い続ける戦法。 |translation='''Title:''' Tallon Roll. '''Card text:''' Choose two starfighters at the same system, one Rebel and one Imperial. Each player draws destiny. Add your destiny, the starfighter's power and its maneuver, and compare that with the opponent's total of destiny and starfighter power. The side with the lower total immediately loses its starfighter. '''Lore:''' A maneuver named after Adar Tallon, the Old Republic tactician who revolutionized starfighter combat. It involves continuing to pursue a turning enemy fighter while maintaining speed and target lock. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese states the two totals as a comparison, while the original English separately instructs the opponent and the player to calculate them. The Japanese lore describes pursuing an enemy fighter that is turning; the English says that the pursuing fighter rolls and turns.[[:File:Premiere-D-tallonroll-decipher-archive.gif|Tallon Roll original English printed face]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

X is the ability of one AT-AT pilot. Y equals Y equals the total number of Hoth locations you control. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The weapon is AT-ATレーザー砲, not AT-AT Cannon. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Target The Main Generator]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on any starship. If that starship uses a weapon in battle, it may fire twice. It may attack two targets, or add the destiny draws against one target. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English adds 1 to maneuver. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Targeting Computer]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. '''PC Errata''' — [[Tarkin Seeker (PC Errata)]] (1_161) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ターキン・シーカー[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Tarkin-Seeker-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=1フォース消費して、未踏査の位置カードの、相手側に配備できる。自分の支配フェイズに、キャラクターと同じようにフォースを消費して移動できる。ターキンまたは能力値<3のエイリアンと同じ場所についたら、そのうち1枚を選んで、ロストデッキへ送る。このカードもロストデッキへ。 |printed_lore=軍用リモート。特定の個人や、条件を指定しての追跡をプログラムされている。熱光学センサーできわめて正確に対象を追跡する。宇宙船に潜り込ませることも可能。 |translation='''Title:''' Tarkin Seeker. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on the opponent's side of an unexplored location card. During your control phase, it can move by using Force like a character. When it reaches the same location as Tarkin or an alien with ability less than 3, choose one of them and send it to the Lost Pile. This card also goes to the Lost Pile. '''Lore:''' A military remote. Programmed to pursue specified individuals or targets meeting specified conditions. Heat and optical sensors track targets with extreme accuracy. It can also be slipped aboard a starship. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says an unexplored location card; the English says an unoccupied site. The Japanese does not include the English word “immediately” when the target is lost. The English lore says “secondary targets” and “fatal accuracy”; the Japanese instead describes specified conditions and extreme accuracy.[[:File:Premiere-L-tarkinseeker-decipher-archive.gif|Tarkin Seeker original English printed face]]. |sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Tauntaun (Errata)]] (3_70) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=トーントーン |printed_game_text=乗客を1名乗せられる。ホス上にのみ配備できるが、それ以降はどこにでも移動させてもよい。能力値＝1/4。リアクションとして戦闘から移動して逃げることができる。犠牲にする（ロストさせる）ことによって、乗客をそのターンの間「凍死」の影響を受けないようにすることができる。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Tauntaun-SWCA-100693.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ホスで最初に発見された土着生物。氷原を群れをなして移動する。気が短くて臆病。体表は猛烈な獣の臭いを放つ。反乱軍のパトロール用に飼いならされている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Tauntaun. '''Card text:''' May carry 1 passenger. May deploy only on Hoth, but may move anywhere after that. Ability equals 1/4. May move and flee from a battle as a reaction. You may sacrifice (lose) it to make the passenger immune to "freezing death" this turn. '''Lore:''' The first native creature found on Hoth. They travel the ice fields in herds. Short-tempered and timid. Their bodies give off a fierce animal smell. They have been tamed for Rebel patrols. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore describes a fierce animal smell and taming for patrols. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Tauntaun]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Tauntaun Bones (V)]] (1240_90) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=トーントーンの骨 |printed_game_text=1フォース消費して場に配備する。相手が運命数を引くごとに、その値に応じて以下の指示に従う。0：ユーズドデッキの一番上のカードを手札に加える。2：1フォース失う。2：1フォース起動する。3：このエフェクトをロストする。4：ロストデッキの一番上のカードを再使用する。5：キャラクターを1人、フォース消費なしで配備する。6+：なにもなし。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Tauntaun-Bones-PSA-170462293.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''トーントーンの骨は死と生を共に表している。獲物の死と捕食者の生である。世の万物にまつわるフォースの満ち引きを象徴する。'' |translation='''Title:''' Tauntaun Bones. Two again: Activate 1 Force. Three: Lose this Effect. Four: Retrieve the top Lost Pile card. Five: Deploy one character without spending Force. Six or more: Nothing. '''Lore:''' The bones of a tauntaun represent both death and life. They are the death of the prey and the life of the predator. They symbolize the ebb and flow of the Force in all things. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is エフェクト. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Tauntaun Bones]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Virtual Modern''' — [[Tentacle (V)]] (221_39) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=触手 |printed_game_text=相手がインタラプトを使用した直後に、1フォースを使用して場に配備する。そのインタラプトは通常通りの効果を及ぼすが、その後で触手に“巻きつかれる”（その場に置かれ、ゲームからは除外される）。同じ名前のインタラプトは今後すべて単一（＊）カードとなる。このエフェクトは「コントロール」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Tentacle-SWCA-67795.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ダイアノーガは7本の触手を使って獲物を探し、捕える。幸運にもこの攻撃を生き延びた者たちによれば、この触手は水圧クランプなみの怪力を持っているという。'' |translation='''Title:''' Tentacle. '''Card text:''' Just after the opponent plays an Interrupt, use 1 Force to deploy on table. That Interrupt still has its usual effect, then is entwined by the tentacle. It is placed here and removed from the game. All Interrupts of the same name become unique cards. This Effect is not affected by Control. '''Lore:''' A dianoga uses its seven tentacles to find and catch prey. Survivors of such attacks say a tentacle has the monstrous strength of a hydro-clamp. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 即効エフェクト. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Tentacle]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. title: Thank The Maker (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Thank The Maker |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-PSA-16-Face.jpg |lead='''Thank The Maker''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_114o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Thank The Maker]] (1_114)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=メーカーに感謝 |printed_game_text=相手の支配フェイズ、５フォース以上の消耗を受け、なおかつ、場に自分のドロイドがいる場合に、１フォース消費して使用できる。運命数を引く。その数の分だけロストデッキからランダムに選んで再使用してよい。 |printed_lore=''ドロイドにとって、“創りしもの”への情熱は、神や宗教に匹敵する存在である。Ｃ－３ＰＯは、待望のオイルバスにありついた時、このフレーズを使った。'' |translation='''Title:''' Thank the Maker. '''Card text:''' During the opponent's control phase, if you have suffered a drain of 5 or more Force. Have your droid on the table, you may spend 1 Force to use this. Draw destiny. You may randomly select that number from the Lost Pile and reuse them. '''Lore:''' For droids, devotion to ‘the one who creates’ is comparable to God or religion. C-3PO used this phrase when he obtained a long-awaited oil bath. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says the randomly selected cards may be reused, while the English says they are retrieved from the Lost Pile. The Japanese lore calls the bath long-awaited; the English describes a much-needed cleansing oil bath. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Thank The Maker]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[ Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

(Errata)]] (3_137) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=間違いない、反乱軍の秘密基地だ！ |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズに自分の宇宙船を1隻、通常どおりにフォースを消費して、自分のプローブ・ドロイドがいる位置と同じ星系に移動させる。ただし航行速度で到達できる場合に限る。その宇宙船はそのターンにはもはや移動することはできない。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Thats-It-The-Rebels-Are-There-PSA-151452828.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「この星系だ。間違いなくスカイウォーカーも一緒に居る」'' |translation='''Title:''' That's It, The Rebels Are There!. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, move one of your starships, spending Force as usual, to the same system as a location where you have a Probe Droid. Only if it can be reached by hyperspeed. That starship can no longer move this turn. '''Lore:''' This is the system. Skywalker is certainly with them as well. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Movement is to the system matching the Probe Droid’s 位置, limited by 航行速度, not “if within range.” |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[That's It, The Rebels Are There!]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

title: The Circle Is Now Complete (Japanese Reflections III Foil)
text:
{{Card |title=The Circle Is Now Complete |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty |set_display=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |language=ja |language_display=Japanese |label_language=Printed language |navigation=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |image=Japanese-The-Circle-Is-Now-Complete-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg |lead='''The Circle Is Now Complete''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]]. |rarity=VR |rarity_display=[[Rarity|VR]] |destiny=6 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[The Circle Is Now Complete]] (1_271o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[The Circle Is Now Complete (Japanese)]] (1301_271o)
'''Decipher (Japanese Reflections III foil)''' — '''this printing''' |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=FinishFoil |printed_title=いよいよ決着をつける時が来た |printed_game_text=ベイダーとオビ＝ワンが同じ位置カード上にいる時に使う。1フォース消費して決闘を行う。ライト・セーバーを持っているジェダイは戦闘値が＋2される。敗者は除外カードとなり、残りのゲームの間、同じ人物を表すカードは配備できなくなる。 |printed_lore=''ベイダーとオビ＝ワン・ケノービは、デス・スターのハンガー・ベイ327付近にてライトセーバーで最期の決闘を行った。「修行半ばで貴様の下を去ったが、今やすべてを極めた。」'' |translation='''Title:''' The Time Has Finally Come to Settle This. '''Card text:''' Use when Vader and Obi-Wan are at the same site. Use 1 Force to duel. A Jedi with a lightsaber adds 2 to their duel total. The loser is placed out of play, and cards representing the same person cannot deploy for the rest of the game. '''Lore:''' Vader and Obi-Wan Kenobi fought their final lightsaber duel near Death Star Hangar Bay 327. “I left you before my training was complete, but now I have mastered everything.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title paraphrases the English title as the time to settle the matter. |notes='''The Circle Is Now Complete (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[The Circle Is Now Complete|The Circle Is Now Complete]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[The Circle Is Now Complete (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R41 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R41. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[[:File:Japanese-The-Circle-Is-Now-Complete-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins. |see_also=* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese foils|Japanese foils]] |see_also_heading=See Also |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

(V)]] (1261_88) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=最初の輸送艇が突破しました！ |printed_game_text=任意の星系上（ホス以外）に配備する。ホスの位置にいる任意の中型輸送艇を目標とする。目標がウーティーニ・エフェクトに到達したら、Xフォースを再使用する。X＝乗客の人数の2倍である。ウーティーニ・エフェクトをホス星系に移動する。ホスの位置カードでの戦闘時に自分の合計戦闘力に＋2される。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-The-First-Transport-Is-Away-PSA-148375110.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「エネルギー・シールドを抜けたら、真っ直ぐランデブー・ポイントに向かいなさい。いいわね？ 幸運を祈ってるわ」'' |translation='''Title:''' The First Transport Is Away!. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any system except Hoth. Target any Medium Transport at a Hoth location. When the target reaches this Utinni Effect, retrieve X Force. X is twice the number of passengers. Relocate the Utinni Effect to the Hoth system. Your total power is +2 in battles at Hoth location cards. '''Lore:''' Once you have passed through the energy shield, proceed straight to the rendezvous point. All right? I'm wishing you luck. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Timer Mine (Dark) (Errata)]] (1_322) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=タイマー地雷 |printed_game_text=自分の地雷敷設ドロイドがいる位置カードの相手の側に配備する。次の自分のターンに「爆発」する。運命数を引く。そこにいる相手のキャラクターが運命数の数だけ即座にロストする（誰をロストするかは敵が選べる）。その時点でタイマー地雷もロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Timer-Mine-Dark-SWCA-100703.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''地雷敷設用ドロイドによって仕掛けられる時限式の爆弾。鉱脈やスパイス鉱山の爆破用に開発されたが、軍用に改造されている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Timer Mine (Dark). '''Card text:''' Deploy on the opponent's side of a location card where one of your mine-laying droids is present. It "explodes" on your next turn. Draw destiny. '''PC Errata''' — [[Tractor Beam (PC Errata)]] (2_115) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=牽引ビーム |printed_game_text=2フォース消費してスター・デストロイヤーに配備する。戦闘の終了時に、そこにいる宇宙船を1つ選んで目標とする。ただし、モン・カラマリ・スター・クルーザーは目標にできない。2フォース消費して運命数を引く。運命数の合計＞装甲値または回避値なら、目標を捕まえる。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Tractor-Beam-PSA-90960101.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''敵船に乗込むためには、まず牽引ビームでの捕獲が不可欠だ。イオン砲と組み合わせれば、どんなに敏捷な宇宙船でも捕獲することができる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Tractor Beam. Combined with an ion cannon, even the most agile starship can be captured. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is アイテム. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Tractor Beam]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Tusken Breath Mask (V)]] (1240_92) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=タスケン呼吸マスク[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Tusken-Breath-Mask-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_game_text=タトゥイーンの位置カードで、戦闘に勝利した時に、その場所に配備する。タトゥイーン上にいないキャラクターを対象にする。対象が到着したら、マスクを手に入れたことになる。タトゥイーンにいる間、対象の戦闘力と没収値は＋2、さらに耐：損耗<3を得る。 |printed_lore=サンド・ピープルは、特殊なマスクを着用し、暑く不快なタトゥイーンの環境に散在した水分を回収している。吹き込む砂を取り除き、過剰な熱を発散させて体を守る働きがある。 |translation='''Title:''' Tusken Breathing Mask. '''Card text:''' When you win a battle at a Tatooine location card, deploy at that location. Target a character not on Tatooine. When the target arrives, it has obtained the mask. While on Tatooine, the target's power and forfeit are increased by 2, and it also gains immunity to attrition less than 3. '''Lore:''' Sand People wear special masks to recover moisture scattered in Tatooine's hot, unpleasant environment. They protect the body by removing blowing sand and dispersing excess heat. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese grants immunity to attrition less than 3; the English grants immunity to attrition of exactly 3. The Japanese says to target a character not on Tatooine, without the English restriction “one of your characters.” The Japanese uses location card where the English specifies a site. The Japanese lore describes moisture in the environment, rather than the English “exhaled moisture.”[[:File:Premiere-L-tuskenbreathmask.gif|Tusken Breath Mask original English printed face]]. |sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 100 (Japanese Premiere checklist). |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

{{Card |title=URoRRuR'R'R |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Alien]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-URoRRuRRR-PSA-93071765.jpg |lead='''URoRRuR'R'R''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_108o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |power=1 |ability=1 |deploy=3 |forfeit=4 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[URoRRuR'R'R]] (2_108)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_108o)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[URoRRuR'R'R (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)]] (1108_46)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[URoRRuR'R'R (V)]] (1210_25) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ア'ウァア'ゥア'ウウ |printed_game_text=タトゥイーンにしか配備できないが、そこからなら好きなところへ移動できる。他のタスケン・レイダーと同じ位置にいるなら、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、1枚引ける。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-URoRRuRRR-PSA-93071765.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''タスケン・レイダー部族のリーダー。機械を恐れない。優れた狩人にして銃の名手。水を奪いにモイスチャー・ファームを襲撃する。不用心な旅行者を求めてジャンドランドの荒地を徘徊する。'' |translation='''Title:''' URoRRuR'R'R. '''Card text:''' May deploy only on Tatooine, but from there may move anywhere. If at the same location as another Tusken Raider, may draw one battle destiny even when otherwise unable to. '''Lore:''' Leader of a Tusken Raider tribe. Unafraid of machines. A skilled hunter and marksman. Raids moisture farms for water. Roams the Jundland Wastes seeking unwary travelers. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face adds that after deploying on Tatooine he may move anywhere. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[URoRRuR'R'R]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

title: URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle |side=Dark |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-URoRRuRRRs-Hunting-Rifle-SWCA-67758.jpg |lead='''URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_162o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle]] (2_162o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_162o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle (Errata)]] (2_162) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ア'ウァア'ゥア'ウウの狩猟用ライフル |printed_game_text=1フォース消費してア'ウァア'ゥア'ウウかバスト隊長に配備する。あるいは3フォース消費してドロイド以外のキャラクター（戦士以外でも可）に配備する。1フォース消費して起動する。運命数を引く。キャラクターは運命数－1＞能力値なら命中する。生物は運命数＋2＞防御値なら即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-URoRRuRRRs-Hunting-Rifle-SWCA-67758.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''タスケンの社会では、狩猟用ライフルを所有している者は地位が高い。ア'ウァア'ゥア'ウウはアンカーヘッド付近に墜落した宇宙船からこの武器を回収した。'' |translation='''Title:''' URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle. '''Card text:''' Spend 1 Force to deploy on URoRRuR'R'R or Chief Bast. Or spend 3 Force to deploy on a non-droid character (even a non-warrior). Spend 1 Force to activate it. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny minus 1 is greater than ability. A creature is immediately lost if destiny plus 2 is greater than defense value. '''Lore:''' In Tusken society, owning a hunting rifle marks high status. URoRRuR'R'R recovered this weapon from a starship that crashed near Anchorhead. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 起動する (activate) where the English original says may target using 1 Force. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

text:
{{Card |title=Ubrikkian 9000 Z001 |side=Dark |type=Vehicle |type_display=[[Vehicle]] ([[Transport]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-310o-SWCA.jpg |lead='''Ubrikkian 9000 Z001''' is a [[Dark]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Transport]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_310o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |power=2 |maneuver=6 |landspeed=3 |label_landspeed=Landspeed |deploy=2 |forfeit=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Ubrikkian 9000 Z001]] (1_310o)
