'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_310o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Ubrikkian 9000 Z001 (Errata)]] (1_310) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Vehicle]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=ユブリッキアン9000 Z001 |printed_game_text=３名までの乗客を乗せられる。また、移動範囲内であれば、戦闘およびフォース消耗に対するリアクションとして移動を行うことができる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-310o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''密閉型の反重力ランドスピーダー。球状の外殻にマイクロ・スラスターが配置されている。３人乗りで、機動力が高い。最高時速は１６０キロ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Ubrikkian 9000 Z001. '''Card text:''' May carry up to three passengers. May move within range as a react to a battle or Force drain. '''Lore:''' An enclosed antigravity landspeeder with microthrusters mounted on its spherical shell. It seats three, maneuvers well, and reaches 160 kilometers per hour. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English may move as a react only to a battle or Force drain; the Japanese omits only. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Ubrikkian 9000 Z001]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Under Attack |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |label_type=Card type |set=Hoth (Japanese) |language=ja |language_display=Japanese |label_language=Printed language |lead='''Under Attack''' is a Japanese [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. [[File:Japanese-Hoth-Under-Attack-PSA-157878142.jpg|thumb|center|340px|Japanese Under Attack printing.]] |gemp_id=1303_50o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Uncommon1 |rarity_display=Uncommon1 |edition=[[Hoth (Japanese)]] |border_finish=Black border / nonfoil |release=September 1998 |destiny=6 |uniqueness=No printed uniqueness marker |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Under Attack]] (3_050o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this page''' (1303_50o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Under Attack (Errata)]] (3_050) |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=Printed subtypeユーズド・インタラプト Subtype[[Used Interrupt]] Copyright year1998 |printed_title=下面からの攻撃. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title. |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズに自分の戦士と同じ位置にいる装甲値を持ったビークルを目標とする。運命数を引く。戦士が「コンカッション・グレネード」かライトセーバーを持っているなら、運命数に3を加える（両方持っているなら7）。運命数の合計＞装甲値ならビークル（とグレネード）はロストする。 |printed_lore=反乱軍は資源が乏しく、人員も不足している。そのため、しばしば一か八かの戦法を取らざるを得ない。 |translation='''Title''' — Under Attack. '''Lore''' — The Rebellion is short of resources and personnel. It therefore often has no choice but to use all-or-nothing tactics. '''Game text''' — During your control phase, target a vehicle with armor at the same location as one of your warriors. Draw destiny. If the warrior has a Concussion Grenade or a lightsaber, add 3 to destiny (7 if both). The vehicle and grenade are lost if total destiny exceeds armor. |translation_note=The title means “attack from below.” Lore uses all-or-nothing tactics for desperate strategies. Game text uses 位置 for site; grenade is quoted and lightsaber is not.[[:File:Hoth-L-underattack-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Under Attack]]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

title: Undercover (Dark) (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Undercover (Dark) |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Undercover-Dark-SWCA-67769.jpg |lead='''Undercover (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_129o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Undercover (Dark)]] (2_129o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_129o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Undercover (Dark) (PC Errata)]] (2_129) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=潜伏 |printed_game_text=位置カード上にいる自分のスパイに配備する。スパイはその位置の敵側に移動する。スパイは潜伏状態となる。自分の配備フェイズにどこかの位置にいるならば、"正体を現す"ことを選択できる（このエフェクトはロストする）。このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Undercover-Dark-SWCA-67769.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国は常にスパイ網を維持し、反乱同盟への潜入や自らの作戦行動に関する偽情報の流布を企てている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Undercover (Dark). '''Card text:''' Deploy on your spy at a location card. The spy moves to the opponent's side of that location. The spy becomes undercover. During your deploy phase, if it is at a location, you may choose to reveal its identity (this Effect is lost). This Effect is not affected by Alter. '''Lore:''' The Empire always maintains a spy network. It plots infiltration of the Rebel Alliance and the spread of false information about its own operations. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face prints immunity to Alter. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Undercover (Dark)]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face prints immunity to Alter. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Undercover]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. text:
{{Card |title=Vader |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) |set=Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Vader-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg |lead='''Vader''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1401_5o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=1 |power=4 |ability=6 |deploy=7 |forfeit=5 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Vader]] (101_5)

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Vader (V)]] (219_26) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ベイダー |printed_game_text=必ずデス・スター上に配置する。それ以降は好きなところへ移動できる。ただし場に敵の単一（＊）キャラクターが２人以上いる場合、配置することができない。戦闘に参加して敗れた場合は、運命数を引くこと。運命数＞４ならば、帝国軍の人員を一人“窒息させる”（ロストする）。誰をロストするかは自分で選択できる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Vader-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ジェダイを一人残らず滅ぼさんとした男。かつてはオビ＝ワン・ケノービの弟子だったが、フォースのダークサイドに引き込まれてしまった。'' |translation='''Title:''' Vader. '''Card text:''' Must deploy on the Death Star. After that he may move anywhere. May not deploy if two or more of the opponent's unique (＊) characters are on the table. If he takes part in a battle and loses, draw destiny. If destiny > 4, “choke” (lose) one Imperial personnel. You choose whom to lose. '''Lore:''' The man who set out to destroy every last Jedi. Once Obi-Wan Kenobi's apprentice, he was drawn to the dark side of the Force. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Vader]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. title: Vader's Custom TIE (Japanese)
text:

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_306o)

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Vader's Custom TIE (V)]] (206_14) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Starship]] [[Nav Computer]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=ベイダー専用タイ・ファイター |printed_game_text=パイロットを１名乗せることができる。パイロットがベイダーなら、専用タイは耐：損耗＜４を持つ。パイロットがいなければ、戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使えない。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-306o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''タイ・アドバンストｘ１の試作限定生産の初号機。後継機タイ・インターセプター開発の基礎となった。ベイダーの要請に応え、ハイパードライブが組み込まれている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Vader's Personal TIE Fighter. '''Card text:''' May carry one pilot. If Vader is the pilot, this TIE is immune to attrition less than 4. Without a pilot, it cannot use its power, maneuver, or hyperspeed. '''Lore:''' The first of a limited run of TIE Advanced x1 prototypes. It formed the basis for the later TIE Interceptor. A hyperdrive was installed at Vader's request. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Vader's Custom TIE]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_277o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Vader's Eye (Errata)]] (1_277) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ベイダーの目 |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。１：ベイダーが特定の位置カードで単独で戦闘を防衛している時に使う。戦闘力を＋１し、戦闘運命数を１回加えることができる。２：その他の能力値＞２の帝国軍が特定の位置カード上で、単独で戦闘を防衛している場合に、戦闘運命数を１回加えることができる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-277o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''装甲マスクと生命維持システムで完全防備のダース・ベイダーは、そのダーク・ジェダイの技とあいまって、決闘や戦闘では脅威的な防御力を発揮する。'' |translation='''Title:''' Vader's Eye. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Use when Vader is defending alone at a site. You may add 1 to power and add one battle destiny. 2. If another Imperial with ability greater than 2 is defending alone at a site, you may add one battle destiny. '''Lore:''' Darth Vader's armored mask and life support protect him fully. Combined with his Dark Jedi skills, they give him formidable defenses in duels and battles. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Vader's Eye]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Modern (ALT)''' — [[Vader's Lightsaber (V) (ALT)]] (219_27^) |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=FinishFoil |printed_title=ベイダーのライトセーバー |printed_game_text=必ずベイダーに配備すること（コストなし）。このカードがある場所のフォース消耗に＋1できる。武器使用時は、コストなしで1名のキャラクターに対して起動できる。運命数を2回引き、運命数の合計＞能力値なら、そのキャラクターに命中し、没収値＝0にできる。 |printed_lore=''ダース・ベイダーの自作。クローン大戦の後、彼はこの武器を振るってジェダイたちを狩りたてた。他のライトセーバーの刃以外なら、何でも切断できる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Vader's Lightsaber. '''Card text:''' Deploy only on Vader at no cost. You may add 1 to the Force drain where this card is. You may fire at one character at no cost. Draw destiny twice. If total destiny exceeds the character's ability, it is hit and its forfeit can be reduced to 0. '''Lore:''' Built by Darth Vader. After the Clone Wars he used it to hunt Jedi. It can cut anything except another lightsaber blade. |notes='''Vader's Lightsaber (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Vader's Lightsaber|Vader's Lightsaber]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Vader's Lightsaber (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R50 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R50. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[[:File:Japanese-Vaders-Lightsaber-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins. |see_also=* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese foils|Japanese foils]] |see_also_heading=See Also |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Vader's Obsession |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Vaders-Obsession-SWCA-97585.jpg |lead='''Vader's Obsession''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1401_6o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=6 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Vader's Obsession]] (101_6)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1401_6o)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Vader's Obsession (V)]] (221_41) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ベイダーの執念 |printed_game_text=自分の移動フェイズに、ベイダーが隣接位置からルークのいる位置へ移動した時に使う。二人の間で決闘を行う。双方ともに、運命数を２回引いて、戦闘力に加える。勝者は点数の差の分だけ、失ったフォースを回復させることができる。敗者は同数のフォースを失い、戦闘を行ったキャラクターをロストデッキへ送る。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Vaders-Obsession-SWCA-97585.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ベイダーはすべてのジェダイを狩り出し、抹殺しようとした。最後の一人、オビ＝ワンを倒した彼は、若きスカイウォーカーに目を転じた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Vader's Obsession. '''Card text:''' Use during your move phase when Vader moves from an adjacent site to Luke's site. The two fight a duel. Each player draws two destiny and adds them to power. The winner may recover lost Force equal to the difference. The loser loses the same amount of Force and sends the character who fought to the Lost Pile. '''Lore:''' Vader hunted down every Jedi to wipe them out. Having struck down the last, Obi-Wan, he turned his eyes to young Skywalker. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Vader's Obsession]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_41o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ヴァーポレーター |printed_game_text=１フォース消費して、タトゥイーンの位置カードのどれかに配備する。移動不可。同じまたは隣接した位置カードにいるすべてのキャラクターは、「砂岩嵐」から防御される。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-41o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''砂漠の惑星には必要不可欠。大気中から水蒸気を凝集させる機械。浄化フィルターと冷却剤タンク付き。干ばつや苛酷な環境への対抗手段。'' |translation='''Title:''' Vaporator. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy at any Tatooine location. Cannot move. All characters at the same or an adjacent location are protected from Sandwhirl. '''Lore:''' An essential machine on desert planets that condenses water vapor from the air. It has a purification filter and coolant tank, and helps people cope with drought and harsh conditions. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Vaporator]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. title: Vehicle Mine (Dark) (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Vehicle Mine (Dark) |side=Dark |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Automated Weapon]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Vehicle-Mine-Dark-PSA-159563449.jpg |lead='''Vehicle Mine (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Automated Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_162o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Vehicle Mine (Dark)]] (3_162o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_162o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Vehicle Mine (Dark) (PC Errata)]] (3_162) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=対ビークル地雷 |printed_game_text=自分の地雷敷設ドロイドの1体と同じ屋外の位置に配備する。宇宙戦闘機か生物以外のビークルがその位置に配備されるか移動してきた場合、あるいはその位置を通過した場合に“爆発”する。運命数を引く。運命数＋2＞装甲値か回避値なら、ビークルはロストする。運命数＞3なら宇宙戦闘機はロストする。対ビークル地雷もロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Vehicle-Mine-Dark-PSA-159563449.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''附近を通過する金属塊や接近するスピーダーのリパルサーリフト・フィールドに反応して射出され、爆発する。榴散弾はどんなに素早い機体でもかわすことができない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Vehicle Mine (Dark). '''Card text:''' Deploy at the same exterior location as one of your mining droids. It explodes if a starfighter or non-creature vehicle deploys, moves to, or passes that location. Draw destiny. The vehicle is lost if destiny plus 2 exceeds armor or maneuver. The starfighter is lost if destiny exceeds 3. The Vehicle Mine is also lost. '''Lore:''' It launches and explodes in response to a passing metallic mass or an approaching speeder's repulsorlift field. Even the quickest craft cannot dodge the shrapnel. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 位置 for site, 地雷敷設ドロイド for mining droids, and the Japanese title in the last sentence. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Vehicle Mine (Dark)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_155o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ヴィクトリー級スター・デストロイヤー |printed_game_text=4名のパイロット、6名の乗客、1台のビークル、3機のTIEを乗せられる。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値1の専属パイロットが乗っている。同一星系のすべての位置における合計戦闘力が＋1される。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Victory-Class-Star-Destroyer-PSA-135901783.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''クローン・ウォーの末期に旧共和国が発注した。レンディリ製ヴィクトリー級スター・デストロイヤーは、大気圏突入が可能なかわりに、通常航行速度が劣る。'' |translation='''Title:''' Victory-class Star Destroyer. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_32o) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Droid]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=ＷＥＤ－９－Ｍ１ “バンサ” ドロイド |printed_game_text=同じ位置カードにいるすべてのビークルとドロイドは、耐：損耗＜２。“バンサ”ドロイドがドッキング・ベイにいれば、同じ星系カードにいるすべての宇宙戦闘機は、耐：損耗＜３。「予期せぬ損傷」のカードをキャンセルできる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-32o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ジャワがパーツを寄せ集めて作った、地上にただ一台のトレッドウェル・ドロイド。今はドッキング・ベイ９４の管理者、デマルズが所有している。鈍重で頑固な性格から、“バンサ”と呼ばれている。'' |translation='''Title:''' WED-9-M1 “Bantha” Droid. '''Card text:''' All vehicles and droids at the same site are immune to attrition less than 2. If Bantha Droid is at a docking bay, all starfighters at the same system are immune to attrition less than 3. May cancel Unexpected Damage. '''Lore:''' A one-of-a-kind Treadwell droid assembled from parts by Jawas. It now belongs to Demalz, the overseer of Docking Bay 94. Its sluggish, stubborn nature earned it the name Bantha. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[WED-9-M1 'Bantha' Droid]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. text:
{{Card |title=Walker Barrage |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Walker-Barrage-PSA-88099884.jpg |lead='''Walker Barrage''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_140o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Walker Barrage]] (3_140o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_140o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Walker Barrage (Errata)]] (3_140) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ウォーカーの猛攻 |printed_game_text=パイロットが搭乗している自分のＡＴ－ＡＴが位置にいるなら、同じ位置か屋外の隣接位置にある固定兵器を目標とする。運命数を引く。運命数＋1＞没収値なら目標はロストする。さらに運命数＋1＞6なら目標と同じ位置にいる相手のキャラクターも1名ロストする（複数いるなら無作為に選ぶ）。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Walker-Barrage-PSA-88099884.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ＡＴ－ＡＴに満載された兵員が実際に外に出て敵と交戦する前に、ウォーカーは反乱分子の防御装置を破壊しておかなければならない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Walker Barrage. '''Card text:''' If you have a piloted AT-AT at a location, target an artillery weapon at the same location or an adjacent exterior location. Draw destiny. The target is lost if destiny +1 exceeds forfeit. One opponent's character at the target's location is also lost if destiny +1 exceeds 6, chosen at random if more than one is there. Japanese uses 位置 for site and 固定兵器 for artillery weapon. Lore says 反乱分子 rather than Rebel traitors. Destiny +1 thresholds match the English face. '''Lore:''' Before the troops packed into an AT-AT actually go outside and fight the enemy, the walker must destroy the Rebel elements' defenses. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses 位置 for site and 固定兵器 for artillery weapon. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Walker Barrage]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

text:
{{Card |title=Walker Garrison |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese) |set_display=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Walker-Garrison-PSA-104758251.jpg |lead='''Walker Garrison''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1404_7o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Walker Garrison]] (104_7)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1404_7o)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Walker Garrison (V) (Virtual Block 6)]] (1263_13)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Walker Garrison (V)]] (222_17) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ウォーカー制圧部隊 |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：ヴィアーズがホスの屋外位置にいる場合に使用する。2フォース消費し、自分のリザーブデッキのなかからＡＴ－ＡＴを1枚探してきて手札に入れることができる。その後デッキをシャッフルし、カットして元の場所に置く。2：ホスの3箇所以上の異なった位置にそれぞれ自分のＡＴ－ＡＴがいる場合に使用する。このターン、ホスのロケーションにおける自分のフォース消耗はそれぞれ＋2となる。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Walker-Garrison-PSA-104758251.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ＡＴ－ＡＴ部隊を効果的に展開することにより、広範囲な地域を素早く制圧することができる。帝国が惑星を占領する際に用いる、きわめて有効な戦術だ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Walker Garrison. '''Card text:''' Choose one. (1) Play if Veers is at an outdoor Hoth location. Spend 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck for one AT-AT and put it into your hand. Shuffle, cut and replace the deck. (2) Play if your AT-ATs occupy three or more different Hoth locations. Each of your Force drains at Hoth locations is +2 this turn. '''Lore:''' Deploying AT-AT units effectively makes it possible to seize control of a wide area quickly. The Empire uses this highly effective tactic when occupying a planet. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 位置 (location) for those conditions and explicitly says three or more. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Walker Garrison]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-premium.png|20px|link=Premium (icon)]] [[Premium (icon)|Premium]] }}

'''Virtual Modern Errata''' — [[Walker Sighting (V) (Errata)]] (208_22) — current |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=敵ウォーカーを確認 |printed_game_text=敵が惑星位置にＡＴ－ＡＴを配備するか移動した直後に使用する。自分のリザーブデッキの中から最大で3枚までのその惑星の屋外位置を探し出し、即座に配備する。その後リザーブデッキをシャッフルし、カットしてもとの場所に置く。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Walker-Sighting-PSA-96471721.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「エコー・ステーション。3TA。インペリアル・ウォーカーを確認」　反乱軍はウォーカーと反乱軍兵員の間にできるだけ距離を取り、防衛の準備を整えるという戦術に出た。'' |translation='''Title:''' Walker Sighting. '''Card text:''' Use immediately after the opponent deploys or moves an AT-AT to a planet location. Search your Reserve Deck for up to three exterior locations of that planet and deploy them at once. Then shuffle, cut, and return the Reserve Deck to its place. '''Lore:''' "Echo station. 3TA. Imperial walker confirmed." The Rebels adopted a tactic of putting as much distance as possible between walkers and Rebel troops and preparing a defense. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 惑星位置 and 屋外位置 for planet site and exterior sites, and says return the Reserve Deck to its place. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Walker Sighting]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Wall Of Fire (Errata)]] (3_141) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=炎の壁 |printed_game_text=パイロットが搭乗している自分のＡＴ－ＡＴが位置にいるなら、同じ位置か隣接する屋外位置にいる兵員／トルーパーを好きなだけ目標として選ぶ。運命数を引く。運命数＞目標とした兵員／トルーパーの人数なら、それらは全員即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Wall-Of-Fire-PSA-88099885.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ウォーカーにかかれば歩兵部隊など数秒でまるごと灰と化してしまう。反乱軍の兵員たちはこの苛烈な弾幕を“炎の壁”として恐れている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Wall Of Fire. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is 炎の壁. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Wall Of Fire]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Wampa (V)]] (1220_21) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ワンパ |printed_game_text=＊凶暴性＝3＋運命数。生息地：ホスの位置。「ワンパの雪洞」か未踏査のマーカー位置にのみ配備する。負けたキャラクターは食べられるか、あるいは「ワンパの雪洞」に移される（犠牲者の相手プレイヤーが選択する）。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Wampa-PSA-92654369.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''雪に被われたツンドラを徘徊する狡猾な肉食獣。ワンパはしばしば獲物を自分の巣に持ち帰って保存する。屍肉よりも生きたままの獲物を好んでむさぼり食うのだ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Wampa. '''Card text:''' * Ferocity = 3 + destiny. Habitat: Hoth locations. Deploy only to Wampa Cave or an unexplored marker location. A defeated character is eaten or moved to Wampa Cave. The victim's opponent chooses. Printed subtype is 寒冷地生物, not Snow. Habitat uses 位置. Deploy restriction uses 未踏査 rather than unoccupied. Vicious Howl is printed 血も凍る叫び声 3. Lore prints 被われた. '''Lore:''' A cunning carnivore that prowls snow-covered tundra. Wampas often drag prey to their dens for storage. They prefer to devour living prey rather than carrion. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 寒冷地生物, not Snow. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Wampa]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Brave and resourceful Rebels often defeat Imperial forces. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Warrior's Courage]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. title: Wedge Antilles (Japanese Reflections III Foil)
text:
{{Card |title=Wedge Antilles |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] |set=Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty |set_display=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |language=ja |language_display=Japanese |label_language=Printed language |navigation=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |image=Japanese-Wedge-Antilles-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg |lead='''Wedge Antilles''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]]. |rarity=SR |rarity_display=[[Rarity|SR]] |destiny=4 |power=2 |ability=2 |deploy=2 |forfeit=6 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Wedge Antilles]] (2_023o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Wedge Antilles (Japanese)]] (1302_23o)
'''Decipher (Japanese Reflections III foil)''' — '''this printing'''
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Wedge Antilles (Errata)]] (2_023) |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=FinishFoil |printed_title=ウェッジ・アンティリーズ |printed_game_text=彼の操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に3を加える。レッド2に搭乗しているなら、さらに回避値に2を加え、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も1枚引ける。1フォース消費して自分のリザーブ・デッキの中から「コレリアン・スリップ」を1枚探して手札に入れることができる。その後デッキをシャッフルし、カットして元の場所に置く。 |printed_lore=''コレリア人の英雄。ヤヴィンの戦いでレッド2を駆る。事故で失った両親の遺産が充分にあり、貨物船を購入することができた。当初は武器の密輸屋として同盟軍に荷担していた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Wedge Antilles. '''Card text:''' Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. When aboard Red 2, also adds 2 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. May use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Corellian Slip into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace. '''Lore:''' A Corellian hero. He flew Red 2 at the Battle of Yavin. The inheritance from his parents, lost in an accident, was enough that he could buy a freighter. At first he aided the Alliance as a weapons smuggler. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names コレリアン・スリップ for Corellian Slip. |notes='''Wedge Antilles (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Wedge Antilles|Wedge Antilles]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Wedge Antilles (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R75 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R75. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[[:File:Japanese-Wedge-Antilles-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins. |see_also=* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese foils|Japanese foils]] |see_also_heading=See Also |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_23o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Wedge Antilles (Errata)]] (2_023)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Wedge Antilles (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)]] (1115_34)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Wedge Antilles (V)]] (202_3) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ウェッジ・アンティリーズ |printed_game_text=彼の操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に3を加える。レッド2に搭乗しているなら、さらに回避値に2を加え、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も1枚引ける。1フォース消費して自分のリザーブ・デッキの中から「コレリアン・スリップ」を1枚探して手札に入れることができる。その後デッキをシャッフルし、カットして元の場所に置く。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Wedge-Antilles-PSA-71262995.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''コレリア人の英雄。ヤヴィンの戦いでレッド2を駆る。事故で失った両親の遺産が充分にあり、貨物船を購入することができた。当初は武器の密輸屋として同盟軍に荷担していた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Wedge Antilles. '''Card text:''' Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. If aboard Red 2, also adds 2 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny even when otherwise unable to. You may spend 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck for one Corellian Slip and take it into hand. Then shuffle, cut, and replace the deck. '''Lore:''' A Corellian hero. He flies Red 2 at the Battle of Yavin. After losing his parents in an accident, he had enough inheritance to buy a freighter. He first sided with the Alliance as a weapons smuggler. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore calls him a Corellian hero. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Wedge Antilles]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Virtual Original''' — [[Wes Janson (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)]] (1115_35) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ウェス・ジャンソン |printed_game_text=宇宙船に乗客として搭乗しているなら宇宙船の兵器の武器運命数に1を加える。ローグ3にウェッジかジェックとともに搭乗しているなら武器運命数に3を加える。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Wes-Janson-PSA-86099780.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''長年友人のジェック・ポーキンズと共にティアフォン・イエロー・エーシズに属し、砲手を務めてきた。彼の射撃の腕は初期の同盟軍にいくつかの勝利をもたらした。'' |translation='''Title:''' Wes Janson. '''Card text:''' If aboard a starship as a passenger, add 1 to that starship's weapon destiny. If aboard Rogue 3 with Wedge or Jek, add 3 to weapon destiny. '''Lore:''' For years he served as a gunner with his friend Jek Porkins in the Tierfon Yellow Aces. His marksmanship brought the early Alliance several victories. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' English wiki text is Rogue 3 or with Wedge or Jek. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Wes Janson]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

text:
{{Card |title=Who's Scruffy-Looking? |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Whos-Scruffy-Looking-PSA-85187824.jpg |lead='''Who's Scruffy-Looking?''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_52o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=6 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Who's Scruffy-Looking?]] (3_52)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_52o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=誰がみすぼらしいって？ |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：「みすぼらしいナーフ飼い」、「ウーキーとキスする方がましだわ」、「毛むくじゃら、おかんむり」、「こんなはずじゃあ…」、「死の烙印」、「悲しみの雄叫び」、「タキール」、「ケット・マリス」のいずれかをキャンセルする。2：このターンの終わりまでレネックの戦闘力を2倍にする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Whos-Scruffy-Looking-PSA-85187824.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「照れてるのさ。図星をつかれて怒ったんだ。だろ？」'' |translation='''Title:''' Who's Scruffy-Looking?. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Cancel Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder, I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee, Furry Fury, This Is Just Wrong, Death Mark, Mournful Roar, Takeel, or Ket Maliss. 2: Double Rennek's power until this turn ends. '''Lore:''' "She's just embarrassed. I hit the mark, so she got angry. Right?" '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese names the eight cancel targets, including 死の烙印 and 悲しみの雄叫び. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Who's Scruffy-Looking?]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

title: Wioslea (Japanese)
text:
{{Card |title=Wioslea |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-PSA-07-Face.jpg |lead='''Wioslea''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_33o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |power=2 |ability=1 |deploy=1 |forfeit=2 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher Errata''' — [[Wioslea (Errata)]] (1_33-DE)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing'''
'''PC Errata''' — [[Wioslea]] (1_33) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Alien]][[:File:Japanese-Premiere-PSA-07-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=ワイオスリー |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズの間、１フォース消費して、同じ位置カードにいる相手のビークルまたはドロイドを対象にして“購入”してよい。運命数を引く。運命数＞対象の運命数ならば、対象の配備コストと等しいフォースを“支払って”（消費して）、その対象を手にいれる。 |printed_lore=''ルークのランドスピーダーを買ったスペースポート・スピーダーズのヴーヴリアン女性。ジャバ・ザ・ハットに1000クレジットの借金があるギャンブラー。多くの言語を話す。'' |translation='''Title:''' Wioslea. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, you may spend 1 Force to target an opponent's vehicle or droid at the same location card for ‘purchase.’ Draw destiny. If it is greater than the target's destiny number, ‘pay’ (spend) Force equal to the target's deploy cost and obtain that target. '''Lore:''' A Vuvrian woman of Spaceport Speeders who bought Luke's landspeeder. A gambler who owes Jabba the Hutt 1,000 credits. Speaks many languages. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese calls the amount owed a debt; the English identifies it as a wagering debt. The Japanese describes obtaining the target after paying its deploy cost; the English says to take the target. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Wioslea]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Wookiee Roar |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Wookiee-Roar-PSA-89673882.jpg |lead='''Wookiee Roar''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_58o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Wookiee Roar]] (2_058o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_58o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Wookiee Roar (PC Errata)]] (2_058)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Wookiee Roar (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)]] (1116_20)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Wookiee Roar (V) (Virtual Block 5)]] (1250_69)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Wookiee Roar (V)]] (216_47) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ウーキーの雄叫び |printed_game_text=いずれか1つを選ぶ。1：チューバッカが特定の位置カードで単独で戦闘を防衛している時に使う。戦闘運命数を2回加えることができる。2：3フォース消費して自分のリザーブ・デッキの中から「チューバッカ」を探して手札に入れる。その後デッキをシャッフルし、カットして元の場所に置く。3：場に出ている“マウス”ドロイドを1体脅かす（ロストさせる）。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Wookiee-Roar-PSA-89673882.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''チューバッカの雄叫びに一喝されれば、マウス・ドロイドさえ一目散にその場を立ち去る。'' |translation='''Title:''' Wookiee Roar. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Use when Chewbacca is defending a battle alone at a specific location card. You may add two battle destiny. 2: Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck for Chewbacca and take it into hand. Then shuffle the deck, cut, and replace. 3: Threaten (lose) one "mouse" droid on table. '''Lore:''' If Chewbacca's roar rebukes them, even a mouse droid flees that spot at once. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore describes Chewbacca's roar scattering a mouse droid; English lore is only the roar onomatopoeia. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Wookiee Roar]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

text:
{{Card |title=Wrong Turn |side=Dark |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-232o-Face.jpg |lead='''Wrong Turn''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_232o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Wrong Turn]] (1_232)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_232o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=行き止まり |printed_game_text=３フォース消費して、場の相手の側に配備する。相手の戦士の配備コストはすべて＋１される。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-232o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''帝国軍の兵員は、逃亡者を分断し、立ち往生させる戦術を取った。ルークとレイアが切り抜けるには、勇気と大胆な行動力が必要だ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Dead End. '''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy on your opponent's side of the table. All of your opponent's warriors are deploy +1. '''Lore:''' Imperial troopers used tactics that separated fugitives and left them stranded. Luke and Leia would need courage and bold action to get through. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Wrong Turn]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Wuher |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-198o-Face.jpg |lead='''Wuher''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_198o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |power=2 |ability=1 |deploy=2 |forfeit=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Wuher]] (1_198)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_198o) |label_versions=Versions |icons=[[Alien]] |label_icons=Icons |printed_title=ウーハー |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズの開始時に、ウーハーと同じ位置カードにある武器とドロイドは、すべてロストする。カンティーナにいる場合、フェイズに関わらず、すべての武器とドロイドが即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-198o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''無愛想で冷淡なバーテン。店内にブラスターとドロイドは御法度。「ドロイドに出す酒はねぇ。」ジャバ・ザ・ハットの専属バーテンになるため、彼には常に最高の飲み物を出す。'' |translation='''Title:''' Wuher. '''Card text:''' At the start of your control phase, all weapons and droids at Wuher's site are lost. At the Cantina, all weapons and droids there are lost immediately regardless of the phase. '''Lore:''' An unfriendly, aloof bartender. Blasters and droids are forbidden in his establishment. “I don't serve drinks to droids.” He always serves Jabba the Hutt his finest drinks in hopes of becoming Jabba's personal bartender. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Wuher]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

{{Card |title=Wyron Serper |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Wyron-Serper-PSA-89232348.jpg |lead='''Wyron Serper''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_26o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |power=1 |ability=2 |deploy=2 |forfeit=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Wyron Serper]] (3_26o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_26o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Wyron Serper (Errata)]] (3_26)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Wyron Serper (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)]] (1104_24) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ワイロン・サーパー |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズに相手の手札から無作為にX枚のカードを選んで見ることができる。X＝同じ位置の[Dark Side Force]の本数である。さらに、自分が運命数を引いた場合、カード名にスキャン／スキャナー／探査が含まれるカードの運命数は＋2となる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Wyron-Serper-PSA-89232348.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''反乱軍のスパイ。スター・デストロイヤー・アヴェンジャーにセンサー技師として潜伏していた。ホス星系の小惑星を通して帝国軍艦をスキャンする任務に就いている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Wyron Serper. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, you may look at X cards chosen at random from opponent's hand. X is the number of Dark Side Force icons at the same location. Also, when you draw destiny, a card whose title contains scan, scanner, or probe is destiny +2. '''Lore:''' A Rebel spy. He was undercover as a sensor technician on the Star Destroyer Avenger. He is assigned to scan Imperial ships through the asteroids of the Hoth system. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Destiny bonus lists スキャン／スキャナー／探査 rather than 'scan' in the title. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Wyron Serper]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_142o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ヤッグル、ガックル |printed_game_text=生物と同じ位置にいる乗用生物を目標とする。凶暴性＞目標の回避値＋移動速度なら、乗用生物は食べられる。生物の凶暴性に２を加える（累積可能）。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Yaggle-Gakkle-PSA-80497039.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「落ち着け。おい！ 落ち着きなよ。いったい何だい？ 何かを嗅ぎつけたのか？」'' |translation='''Title:''' Yaggle Gakkle. '''Card text:''' Target a creature vehicle at the same location as a creature. If ferocity exceeds the target's maneuver plus landspeed, the creature vehicle is eaten. Add 2 to the creature's ferocity (cumulative). Title prints a Japanese comma (ヤッグル、ガックル) for the English space. Lore omits English girl and uses 位置 for site. +2 ferocity is a following sentence, not attached to the eaten clause. '''Lore:''' Calm down. Hey! Calm down. What is it? Did you smell something? '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese comma (ヤッグル、ガックル) for the English space. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Yaggle Gakkle]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_68o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ヤヴィンの歩哨 |printed_game_text=２フォース消費し、任意のヤヴィン４の位置カードに配備する。“歩哨”が警戒している間、その場所及び、隣接した位置カードに、次のいずれかの効果を適用できる。１：相手の配備コストに＋１。２：相手が、戦闘運命数を引くのに必要な能力値に＋１。３：自分の合計戦力に＋１。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-68o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''反乱軍の歩哨たちは、高所センサー・プラットフォームにて任務につき、帝国の偵察隊等の危険に備える。収集された追加データは、ヤヴィン基地のメインセンサーに送られる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Yavin Sentry. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy at any Yavin 4 site. While the sentry is on watch, you may apply one effect there and at adjacent sites. 1. Opponent's deploy cost +1. 2. Ability opponent needs to draw battle destiny +1. 3. Your total power +1. '''Lore:''' Rebel sentries serve on elevated sensor platforms to watch for Imperial scouts and similar threats. The additional data they collect is sent to Yavin Base's main sensor. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Yavin Sentry]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

text:
{{Card |title=Yerka Mig |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) |set=Premiere (Japanese) |set_display=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Premiere-1301-69o-Face.jpg |lead='''Yerka Mig''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1301_69o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Yerka Mig]] (1_69)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1301_69o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ヤーカ・ミッグ |printed_game_text=任意の場所に配備できる。ミッグを移動させる時はキャラクターとして扱う。相手のキャラクターを一人、対象として選ぶ。選ばれたキャラクターはミッグのいる位置カードに到達すると、ミッグを捕まえる（キャンセルする）。それまでは、ミッグのいる、または隣接する位置カードでの戦闘は全て、相手の合計戦力に－１。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-69o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''高度の軍事機密に通じた帝国官僚だったが、故郷の惑星ラルティアが占領され、良心の呵責から辞職し、逃亡した。現在はＩＳＢに追われる身。'' |translation='''Title:''' Yerka Mig. '''Card text:''' May deploy anywhere. Treat Mig as a character for movement. Target one opposing character. If that character reaches Mig's location, they catch and cancel him. Until then, subtract 1 from your opponent's total power in all battles at Mig's location or an adjacent location. '''Lore:''' An Imperial official with access to highly classified military information. After his homeworld Ralltiir was occupied, his conscience led him to resign and flee. The ISB is now pursuing him. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Yerka Mig]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_53o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=貴様の失策につきあうのもこれが最後だ |printed_game_text=場にベイダーが出ている場合に、相手が戦闘を宣言した直後に使用する。戦闘に参加している運命数＜6の相手のリーダーを目標とする。相手が戦闘に勝利しなかったなら、目標は没収値＝0となり、即座にロストする。オゼルであれば除外カードとなる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-You-Have-Failed-Me-For-The-Last-Time-PSA-85187828.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「ベイダー卿。艦隊は光速を脱し、これより……うわっ……うぐ……ぐえっ」'' |translation='''Title:''' You Have Failed Me For The Last Time. '''Card text:''' If Vader is on table, play just after the opponent declares a battle. Target an opponent's leader in that battle with destiny less than 6. If the opponent did not win, the target's forfeit becomes 0 and it is immediately lost. If it is Ozzel, it becomes an excluded card. '''Lore:''' Lord Vader. The fleet has left lightspeed, and from now... whoa... ugh... gueh. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is a translated movie line, not a literal English title. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[You Have Failed Me For The Last Time]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_27o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Zev Senesca (Errata)]] (3_027) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ゼヴ・セネスカ |printed_game_text=操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２を加える。ローグ２を操縦するなら回避値に３を加え、戦闘運命数を引けない場合にも１枚引ける。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Zev-Senesca-PSA-85187817.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ベスティーン星系に近いケスティック・ステーションの出身。あらゆる機種を乗りこなす温和なパイロット。ホスの氷原でルークとハンを発見した。ホスの戦いではローグ2を操縦。'' |translation='''Title:''' Zev Senesca. '''Card text:''' Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Rogue 2, also add 3 to maneuver, and may draw one battle destiny even if not able to otherwise. '''Lore:''' Born at Kestic Station near the Bestine system. A mild-mannered pilot who can handle every craft. He found Luke and Han on Hoth's ice plains. He piloted Rogue 2 at the Battle of Hoth. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore calls him 温和な (mild-mannered); English says daring. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Zev Senesca]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Zutton (Revised)]] (52_24)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_24o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊ザットン |printed_game_text=配備されているロケーションで、敵が戦闘運命数を引く直前に、1フォースを消費して、敵の戦闘運命数の合計から1を引くことができる（戦闘運命数の合計は0を下回ることはない）。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Zutton-PSA-164793248.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''“そっ歯”のあだ名を持つスニヴィアン。苦悩する芸術家。他のスニヴィアンと同様、自らの作り出した物語の世界を生き抜くはめとなる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Zutton. '''Card text:''' Where he is deployed, just before opponent draws battle destiny, you may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from opponent's total battle destiny (cannot fall below 0). '''Lore:''' A Snivvian nicknamed “Snaggletooth.” A tortured artist. Like other Snivvians, he is driven to live out the stories he creates. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore uses そっ歯 for Snaggletooth. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Zutton]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}
